items.title: The inbox dropdown you asked for already exists; check it is easy to find
items.detail: You asked for a dropdown to pick All or a single account, plus add a temporary or a permanent address. Commit 1c4be58 already added this: an inbox picker with All, each mailbox with its unread count and problems, temporary addresses, and an add-an-address option. It replaced the long list. If you still see the old list, the picker may be hard to spot or not on every screen size. Fix: Open Mail at 375px, 820px and 1440px and confirm the picker shows in the list header everywhere. Show the current choice as the title with a chevron, like Gmail's account switcher. Make 'Add an address' open a choice between a temporary and a permanent address. (git commit 1c4be58 (Mail: inbox picker); the Mail list header in src/components/mail/)

items.title: On desktop, deleting a login uses the browser's own confirm box
items.detail: The native confirm() box ignores the app's theme and motion and looks out of place. On phones the app shows its own sheet, so the two sizes behave differently. Fix: Use the same confirm sheet (or a centred modal on desktop) that phones get through setConfirmDel. Add Undo to the 'Login deleted' toast. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:309 and :562) | Round 4: Desktop no longer uses confirm(). askDelete always opens the shared confirmSheet, which shows as a bottom sheet on phones and a centred panel on desktop. It is rendered in both branches, and the desktop row menu's Delete now goes through askDelete. Undo was not added because the server deletes the login outright, so there is nothing to restore.

items.title: Copied usernames are never cleared from the clipboard
items.detail: Passwords clear after 30 seconds, but usernames do not. This is inconsistent with the promise shown in the vault footer. Fix: Copy usernames through the same copy-and-clear helper at line 71, or reword the footer so it only promises clearing for passwords. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:319 and :491) | Round 4: copyUsername and the desktop row's username button now use copySecret, which clears the clipboard after 30 seconds, as the footer promises.

items.title: The login detail screen has an empty title
items.detail: PushScreen is given title="". Users lose track of which login they are looking at, and screen readers announce no heading. Fix: Pass it.meta.title as the title, letting it fade in as the page scrolls if the large header should stay. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:757) | Round 4: VaultItemScreen passes title={it.meta.title} to PushScreen.

items.title: Deleting a team uses the browser's own confirm box and has no Undo
items.detail: It is a destructive action, and the native dialog does not match the app. Deleting a whole team deserves a proper sheet. Fix: Use a confirm sheet or modal that names the team and how many tasks move, with a red Delete button and Cancel. (src/components/teams/TeamsApp.tsx:730) | Round 4: Delete team now opens ConfirmSheet (from chat/Sheets). It names the team and says how many tasks leave it, with Cancel and a red Delete team button. This replaces the native confirm(). Indonesian strings are in src/i18n/id/teams.ts.

items.title: Deleting your account asks with the browser's own confirm box
items.detail: This is the most destructive action in the app, and it gets a plain dialog with no typed confirmation, unlike Google or 1Password. Fix: Use a modal where the user types their email or DELETE to enable a red button, and list what stays and what goes. (src/components/SettingsPage.tsx:1002 and :1017) | Round 4: Removed both browser confirm() calls. Desktop (DeleteAccountRow in SettingsPage.tsx) and phone (DeleteAccountPhone in SettingsPhone.tsx) now show a DeleteFacts list of what goes and what stays. The red button stays disabled until the password is entered and DELETE (or HAPUS) is typed. Added id strings and .delete-facts styles in src/mobile/settings.css. The new desktop form was not screenshotted; the fold opens inside a scrolling pane.

items.title: Phone drawer still lists every inbox; it needs the same dropdown as desktop
items.detail: The desktop sidebar already has a dropdown for choosing an inbox (InboxSwitcher), but the phone drawer still shows a flat list of All inboxes, each mailbox and each temporary address above the folders. With several addresses the folders get pushed below the fold, and choosing an inbox works differently on phone and desktop. This is the problem the user described. Fix: Replace the Inboxes nav group in the phone drawer with a switcher row like InboxSwitcher, placed under gm-drawer-head: the current inbox's icon, address and unread count, with a chevron. Tapping it opens the useActionMenu list as a bottom sheet with All inboxes, the mailboxes, the temporary addresses, New temporary address and Add an email address. Keep the tabNav and Assigned to me rows below it. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:352-360)

items.title: Phone drawer hides All inboxes when there is one mailbox plus temporary addresses
items.detail: The drawer shows All inboxes only when boxes.length > 1, while the desktop shows it when there are several mailboxes or any temporary address (many = boxes.length > 1 || temps.length > 0). On a phone, a user with one mailbox and a temporary address can never view both together. Fix: Use the same condition as the desktop, boxes.length > 1 || temps.length > 0, or let the shared switcher component decide. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:353 (compare src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:34))

items.title: Add an email address is missing from the phone drawer
items.detail: The desktop menu offers admins Add an email address (onAddAccount). The phone drawer only offers Temporary address, so on a phone the only way to add a permanent mailbox is buried in Settings, which is the opposite of what the user asked for. Fix: Put both New temporary address and Add an email address in the add group of the shared switcher menu, and pass onAddAccount to the drawer. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:388-396 (desktop has it at src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:41))

items.title: New temporary address is filed under Projects/Clients in the phone drawer
items.detail: The Temporary address row is rendered inside the nav labelled with the projects term (term.Many), and that group also appears when no projects exist. People look for it next to their inboxes, as on the desktop, not among clients. Fix: Move it into the inbox switcher's add group and remove props.onNewTemp from the condition that shows the projects group. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:388-396)

items.title: On a phone, picking a folder silently resets the inbox to All
items.detail: In the drawer, pick() calls onAccountFilter('all') whenever a folder is chosen. Someone viewing their work inbox who taps Sent sees Sent from every account, with nothing telling them it changed. Gmail keeps the chosen account while you move between folders, and the desktop does not reset it. Fix: Keep activeAccount when a folder is picked. Once the switcher shows the current inbox, people can choose All themselves. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:337-340)

items.title: Temporary addresses shown as a cut-off 'name@' on the phone
items.detail: In the drawer, temporary inboxes are labelled a.email.split('@')[0] + '@', so two addresses on different domains look the same and the label reads like an unfinished string. The desktop shows the full address and how long it has left (lifeLeft). Fix: Show the full address and put lifeLeft(a) as the hint line, as InboxSwitcher's subOf does. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:358)

items.title: Phone mailbox rows read 'My inbox' instead of the address
items.detail: When there are several mailboxes, the drawer names your own mailbox 'My inbox' and only shared or delegated ones by name. With two personal addresses, both rows say 'My inbox' and cannot be told apart. Fix: Label each row with a.email, as the desktop does (InboxSwitcher.tsx:38), and put Shared or Delegated in the hint line. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355)

items.title: Inbox problems (sync or auth errors) are not shown on the phone
items.detail: The desktop menu shows each account's error state under the address (state[a.id].label). The drawer's item() does not receive accountState, so on a phone a disconnected mailbox looks fine. Fix: Use the shared subOf hint, or pass accountState to the drawer and show a warning dot with the label. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355 (desktop: src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:30))

items.title: No inbox indicator in the phone list header
items.detail: On a phone, the search pill avatar opens account and companies, not inboxes, so nothing on the list screen says which inbox is filtered. After the drawer closes, users cannot tell whether they are looking at All or one address. Fix: Show the current inbox's name as a small tappable chip under the search pill when activeAccount is not 'all', and have it open the switcher sheet. (src/components/MessageList.tsx:335 and src/components/mail/MailTop.tsx:11-35)

items.title: Desktop menu with a single inbox and no temporary addresses still opens a near-empty menu
items.detail: When many is false, the menu contains only the one mailbox plus the add actions, so the chevron suggests a choice that does not exist. Fix: When there is one mailbox, keep the button but rename the menu header to 'Add an address'. Alternatively, show the chevron only when many is true or an add action exists. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:34-44) | Round 4: InboxSwitcher: with a single mailbox and no temporary addresses the menu is titled 'Add an address' instead of 'Inboxes'

items.title: Temporary address actions sit behind a separate small icon
items.detail: The copy/share/delete button only appears next to the switcher when a temporary inbox is active, and it is a 15px icon. Users who want to copy the address while on All cannot find it. Fix: Show a trailing more button on each temporary row inside the menu (as Gmail does for account management), and keep the one next to the switcher. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:62-66) | Won't fix: A more button inside each menuitem would nest interactive controls in role=menuitem and ActionSheet has no slot for it. Copy, share and delete stay one tap away once a temporary address is picked.

items.title: Temporary addresses and mailboxes have no group headings in the menu
items.detail: The menu items have group keys ('boxes', 'temp', 'add') but no visible headings, so a temporary address looks like an ordinary mailbox, apart from its icon. Fix: Add small section headings 'Inboxes' and 'Temporary' (if useActionMenu supports group labels), or a divider with a caption. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:38-41) | Round 4: ActionSheet gained an optional `heading` on SheetAction (rendered with the existing .as-group caption at the start of a group). InboxSwitcher now labels its groups 'Mailboxes' (only when there are temporary addresses) and 'Temporary addresses' (id: Alamat sementara, added to src/i18n/id/mail.ts)

items.title: Brand colour dot only on desktop
items.detail: The desktop switcher shows a brand-dot for the current inbox, but the phone rows do not, so the same colour cue that ties mail to a brand is missing on a phone. Fix: Pass brandColor into the phone switcher row. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:54 vs src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355)

items.title: Switcher duplicated in two implementations
items.detail: The inbox choice is built twice (InboxSwitcher for desktop, an item() list for the phone drawer), and every difference above comes from that. Keeping two copies means they will keep drifting apart. Fix: Render InboxSwitcher in the drawer too, with a 'sheet' option on phones (useActionMenu already supports sheets), and delete the boxes/temps item code. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:326-360 and src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx)

items.title: Switcher button spacing is tight against Compose
items.detail: The .inbox-switch margin is 12px 0 4px, and the Folders heading follows right after, so the switcher card visually merges with the folder list. Fix: Use a margin of 12px 0 12px, or add a hairline separator before the Folders heading, so the switcher reads as its own control. (src/shell.css:2775-2780) | Round 4: shell.css .inbox-switch margin changed from 12px 0 4px to 12px 0 12px

items.title: Activity chips have no hover state on desktop
items.detail: Every other desktop control in Chat responds to hover. The All/Mentions chips on the Activity page don't, so they look static and it's unclear they are clickable. Fix: Inside @media (hover: hover) add `.page-activity .act-chip:not(.on):hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); }`. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1595-1611 (.page-activity .act-chip, no :hover rule anywhere in the file)) | Round 4: chat.css: added a hover:hover rule for .page-activity .act-chip:not(.on):hover (background --hover, text --text)

items.title: Reduced motion does not cover huddle tile and floater entrances
items.detail: Users who ask for reduced motion still see the tiles scale in, the tiles fade, and the reaction floaters slide in and out during a huddle. These are the busiest animations in the app. Fix: Add .ht-tile, .ht-* fade elements and the hf-in/hf-out elements to a prefers-reduced-motion block with `animation: none`. Keep a 0.15s opacity transition so they still fade both ways. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1330 (ht-in), 1354 (ht-fade), 1419 (hf-in), 1428 (hf-out); the reduce blocks at 1009, 1256 and 1516 omit them) | Round 4: chat.css reduce block now also covers .is-leaving.huddle-full (it beat .huddle-full on specificity, so hf-out still ran) and keeps a 0.15s opacity transition; .ht-tile/.ht-video/.huddle-full were already there

items.title: Reaction float is disabled under reduced motion by class name only, not by keyframe
items.detail: The rule turns off `.huddle-float` but the animated element uses huddle-float as its keyframe. If that element's class differs, emoji still fly up the screen for users who asked for less motion. Fix: Check the selector at line ~598 that owns the animation and add it to the reduce block at line 1009. Better, replace the travel with a short opacity-only fade. (src/components/chat/chat.css:604 (animation: huddle-float) vs 1012 (.huddle-float selector))

items.title: Message column is up to 1200px wide on desktop
items.detail: At 1440px with the sidebar open, message lines can run past 120 characters, which is hard to read. Slack and Discord let bubbles stretch, but text width stays near 720-800px. Fix: Keep the container at 1200px for attachments, and cap message text at about 72ch (`.msg-text { max-width: 72ch }`). Or lower the container to 960px. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1463 (max-width: 1200px)) | Round 4: chat.css: .chat-msg .cm-text max-width 72ch at >=768px; attachments keep the full column

items.title: Activity feed is capped at 760px and left-aligned on wide screens
items.detail: At 1180px and 1440px the feed sits on the left with a large empty area to its right. The page looks unbalanced next to the full-width conversation view. Fix: Add `margin: 0 auto` to .page-activity .act-feed, or match the conversation container width so switching pages doesn't jump. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1587-1589) | Round 4: chat.css: .page-activity .act-feed gets margin-inline: auto so it is centred

items.title: The 'View:' picker uses jargon and sits below the page list
items.detail: 'View: Company default' is not a term from Slack. New users can't tell it reorders the sidebar sections, and it sits below Activity, Catch up and the other pages instead of next to the channel list it controls. Fix: Turn it into a small 'Sort / Group' icon menu on the Channels section header, like Slack's sidebar sort options. Rename the options to 'Sections (default)', 'Unread first', 'Recent'. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:443-463 (view-bar) and 230-235 (viewOptions labels)) | Round 4: Renamed the jargon option 'Company default' to 'Sections (default)' (id: 'Bagian (bawaan)'). The picker stays where it is for now

items.title: Custom views duplicate Slack-style sections
items.detail: 'Create a view…' with its own sections and channels overlaps the admin-set sections and the per-channel section moves. Users end up with two ways to group channels and get confused about which one they are editing. Fix: Hide custom views behind a setting or remove them. Let users make personal sections directly in the sidebar, which is Slack's model. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:234 ('__new' option), 237-240 (pickView), 1394 (view modal)) | Left: Removing custom views, or hiding them behind a setting, is a product decision: they feed the phone title switcher, the DM filter sheet and the view editor. Needs an owner call

items.title: Status button sits above the page navigation
items.detail: In Slack and Discord your status lives with your avatar, at the top-right or bottom-left. Here a large emoji button is the first item in the Chat sidebar, which pushes Activity down and treats a rare action as primary. Fix: Move status into the user/avatar menu, or pin it to the bottom of the sidebar. Show only the emoji next to the avatar. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:418-424) | Left: Moving status into the avatar/account menu means changing the shared shell account menu used by every app. Status already works from the phone You tab; on desktop the button now shows only the emoji when collapsed (P30)

items.title: Redundant sb-label class on the status button and its child
items.detail: The button and its inner span both carry sb-label. When the sidebar collapses to icons, the whole button, emoji included, is hidden, so collapsed users lose access to status. Fix: Remove sb-label from the button (line 418) and keep it only on the text span, so the emoji stays visible when the sidebar is collapsed. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:418 and 420) | Round 4: ChatApp.tsx: removed sb-label from the status button so the emoji stays visible when the sidebar collapses; only the text span hides

items.title: Phone filter button changes meaning by tab
items.detail: The same spot shows 'Filter' on DMs and 'Mark all as read' on Activity, and it disappears on Activity when there is nothing unread. That makes the header jump, and mark-all-read happens on one tap with only a toast and no undo. Fix: Put mark-all-read in an overflow menu or show it as a text button 'Mark all read', and add Undo to the toast. Keep the slot's width reserved so the header doesn't shift. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:397-401 and 491) | Round 4: Activity's mark-all-read button stays in its slot (disabled when nothing is unread) on both the TopBar and switch row, so the header no longer jumps; the toast now has Undo

items.title: Mark all as read has no undo
items.detail: One accidental tap clears every unread notice. The toast only confirms the action. Fix: Pass an undo action to the toast that calls onReadNotices(ids, false) with the ids it just cleared. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:398 (toast({ text: t('All marked as read') }))) | Round 4: The toast now has an Undo action that calls onReadNotices(ids, false) with the ids it just cleared (App.tsx's chat handler respects the read flag)

items.title: Phone home tab stacks up to five overlapping sections
items.detail: Tiles, the huddle banner, Unread DMs, Mentions, recent Direct messages and Starred all render above the channels. The same conversation can show up in Catch-up tiles and in the unread lists, so channels end up far below the fold at 375px. Fix: Show tiles collapsed by default, or keep only 'Unread' plus channels. Move Mentions to the Activity tab, where Slack puts them, and drop the recent DMs slice since there is already a DMs tab. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:497-530) | Round 4: Phone home: removed the Mentions section (mentions live on the Activity tab and mentioned channels stay in their sections with a badge) and the recent-DMs slice (the DMs tab covers it). Left: tiles, the huddle banner, Unread DMs, Starred and the channels

items.title: Recent DMs on the phone home list are silently capped at 3
items.detail: The list stops at three with no 'See all' link, so users don't know more exist. Fix: Add a 'See all DMs' row that switches to the DMs tab, or remove this section. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:521-526 (.slice(0, 3))) | Round 4: The capped recent-DMs section was removed (see P33)

items.title: Tiles are only reordered by long-press or a buried editor
items.detail: Hold-to-move is not discoverable, and the only hint is help text inside the tile settings. Fix: Drop tile reordering and keep just show/hide, or show an 'Edit' link at the end of the tile row. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:1100-1108 (Tile useLongPress) and 1154) | Won't fix: On phones, tiles now show only when something is waiting, and show/hide/order is in the You tab's 'Tiles on top' editor. Long-press is the standard gesture in CLAUDE.md (useLongPress)

items.title: /kudos is a niche feature in the main composer
items.detail: Kudos adds a separate form (Who? / For what?) to the conversation view. It isn't in Slack or Discord as a core action and adds clutter for most teams. Fix: Keep it as a slash command only, with no persistent UI, or move it behind a workspace setting that is off by default. (src/components/chat/Conversation.tsx:416 (/kudos) and 788-789 (form)) | Won't fix: Kudos is already slash-command only (/kudos) plus one row in the + sheet. The form only appears when invoked, with no persistent UI

items.title: Huddle live dot pulses forever in the sidebar
items.detail: An endlessly pulsing green dot next to each live huddle pulls the eye constantly while users are trying to read. Fix: Pulse 3 times (`animation-iteration-count: 3`), then stay solid. Reduced motion already turns it off. (src/components/chat/chat.css:520 (animation: conn-pulse 1.4s infinite)) | Won't fix: The live huddle dot is live status, which CLAUDE.md's Calm rule allows to loop, and reduced motion already turns it off

items.title: Huddle panel is a fixed 320px wide
items.detail: On iPad portrait (820px) with the sidebar open, a fixed 320px panel squeezes the conversation to about 250px. On desktop it doesn't grow. Fix: Use `width: clamp(280px, 28vw, 380px)`. Below 900px, show it as an overlay sheet instead of a side column. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1531-1533) | Won't fix: The huddle is now a floating card docked bottom-left (round2.css .huddle, position fixed), not a side column, so it does not squeeze the conversation

items.title: Tablet breakpoints are missing; only 767px is used
items.detail: Chat CSS only switches at 767/768px, so the 820px and 1180px iPad layouts get the full desktop sidebar, conversation and details panes at once and become cramped. Fix: Add a breakpoint at max-width 1100px that collapses the details pane into an overlay and narrows the sidebar to about 240px. (src/mobile/chat.css:5 and 17; src/components/chat/chat.css:1586)

items.title: Status picker explains automation in a paragraph
items.detail: The 'In a meeting is set for you automatically' footnote is long helper text inside a small popover. It adds noise every time someone opens it. Fix: Remove the line and show the automatic status as a preset row with a calendar icon and an 'Auto' label when it's active. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:1146) | Round 4: Removed the 'In a meeting is set automatically' paragraph from StatusPicker

items.title: Sidebar has 10 views; Todoist has 4
items.detail: My tasks, Today, Upcoming, Supervising, My teams, My projects, Assigned by me, Briefs, Everything and Projects x teams all sit at the same level. A new user can't tell which one is home, and the three that matter get lost. Fix: Keep Today, Upcoming and My tasks at the top. Move Supervising, Assigned by me, My teams, My projects, Briefs, Everything and Projects x teams into a collapsible 'More views' fold (.fold plus .rot-chev) that is closed by default and whose open state is saved. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:62-85) | Round 4: TasksSidebar: Today, Upcoming and My tasks stay at the top. The other views moved into a 'More views' fold (.nav-more-head, .fold, .rot-chev). It is closed by default, its state is saved in s2g-tasks-more, and it opens on its own while one of its views is in use.

items.title: Brain dump is the main button instead of Add task
items.detail: In Todoist the top action is 'Add task'. Here the compose button opens an AI brain-dump, so people looking for the plain way to add one task can't find it. Fix: Make the compose button 'Add task' (open QuickAdd), and offer Brain dump as a secondary menu item next to it, the way the phone already does at TasksView.tsx:388. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:57-60) | Round 4: The compose button is now 'Add task' (new onAddTask prop; App bumps setTaskAdd and falls back to My tasks from grid, briefs or past). Brain dump is a secondary row right under it.

items.title: Tasks sidebar still contains a full copy of the projects list and add form
items.detail: When projectsApp is false, Tasks shows the same project list, type chips, past toggle and add-project form as ProjectsSidebar. That's two places to create a project, and the two can drift apart. Fix: Delete this block. If projects are needed in Tasks, list them as filter rows only, with no add form, and link 'Manage projects' to the Projects app. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:111-174) | Won't fix: The block renders only when the Projects app is off (projectsApp false). In that case Tasks is the only place to create a project, so it is not a duplicate. The shared-key drift is fixed by P54.

items.title: The same red count badge means four different things
items.detail: Today counts late or due today, Supervising counts tasks to review, Assigned by me counts late tasks only, and Teams counts unassigned tasks. All use .warn-count, so a red '3' can't be read without knowing the rules. Fix: Keep red only for late work. Show to-review and unassigned counts as neutral .count, and give every count a title tooltip like the team and project rows already have. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:65-70,99-101) | Round 4: Only late work is red. Today is red only when something is late, Assigned by me counts late tasks, and the to-review and team not-assigned counts use the neutral .count. Every count has a title tooltip.

items.title: Smart-view counts have no tooltip
items.detail: The badges on Supervising and Assigned by me show a number without saying what it counts. Team and project badges do have a title. Fix: Add a fourth tuple field with the tooltip text and render <span className='count' title={hint}>. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:83) | Round 4: Each row tuple now has a hint field, rendered as the count's title (for example 'Waiting for your review' or 'Late').

items.title: 'Projects x teams' and 'Briefs' don't belong in the main Tasks nav
items.detail: The project-by-team grid is an admin report, and briefs belong to a project. Both add noise to a personal to-do app. Fix: Move the grid to Projects (as a 'Grid' view toggle on the home) or to Admin. Show Briefs inside a project's Tasks tab only, or under the 'More views' fold. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:71,75) | Round 4: Briefs and the Projects x teams grid moved out of the main nav into the closed-by-default More views fold. This is the fold option the finding allowed.

items.title: Phone and desktop list the views in a different order
items.detail: The desktop sidebar goes My tasks, Today, Upcoming. The phone browse list goes Today, Upcoming, My tasks. Someone who uses both has to relearn the order. Fix: Use the Todoist order everywhere: Today, Upcoming, My tasks. Build both lists from one shared array. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:64-66 vs src/components/TasksView.tsx:319-321) | Round 4: The desktop sidebar now goes Today, Upcoming, My tasks, the same order as the phone Browse list.

items.title: The task header has too many buttons
items.detail: On a project's task page the title row holds the type select, the status select, Stages, End work, people, the layout and Display slot, Template, Brain dump and Open the project. There is no clear primary action, and it wraps to two lines at 820 and 1180 px. Fix: Keep the title, people, the slot (layout, Display, New task) and one overflow menu. Move Stages, Template, Brain dump and End work into the overflow (useActionMenu). (src/components/TasksView.tsx:723-742,784-798)

items.title: Template button shows in every view
items.detail: 'Template' shows on Today, Upcoming and My tasks, where starting from a project template makes no sense. Fix: Render it only when client or project is set (wrap it in {(client || project) && ...}). (src/components/TasksView.tsx:786-788) | Round 4: TasksView: the Template button renders only when a client or project is set, so it is gone from Today, Upcoming and My tasks.

items.title: Reduced motion is respected for only one animation
items.detail: The only reduced-motion rule in tasks.css turns off .tbr-group. The fadeIn entrances at lines 869 and 1332 and the bulk-bar bulkUp/bulkDown animations still run for people who asked for less motion. Fix: Add those selectors to the reduced-motion block (animation: none), or use one global rule that sets animation-duration to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion. (src/mobile/tasks.css:1435-1439 (also 869,1272-1275,1332)) | Round 4: src/mobile/tasks.css reduced-motion block now also covers .tdp-row, .task-bulk and .task-bulk.is-leaving. It uses animation-duration 0.01ms so exits still finish.

items.title: Type filter chips are smaller than the 12 px minimum
items.detail: The chips use 11.5 px text and 2 px vertical padding. That's below the CLAUDE.md minimum of 12 px for labels and far below a 44 px tap target on iPad touch. Fix: Use font-size 12px and padding 4px 10px, and set min-height var(--tap) under (pointer: coarse). (src/polish.css:1155-1164) | Round 4: polish.css .type-chips buttons: 12px text, 4px 10px padding, and min-height var(--tap) under pointer: coarse.

items.title: Empty state uses a text checkmark instead of an icon
items.detail: icon='✓' renders a glyph that doesn't match the lucide icons used in the other empty states, so this one looks unfinished. Fix: Use icon={<CircleCheck size={20} />}. (src/components/tasks/TaskViews.tsx:460) | Round 4: TaskViews empty states use the lucide CircleCheck icon instead of the text checkmark.

items.title: 'Brain dump' isn't explained anywhere
items.detail: The name doesn't say what the button does (turn free text into tasks with AI). The empty state is the only place that hints at it. Fix: Add a hint line in the menu item, such as 'Paste notes, get tasks', or rename it to 'Add from notes'. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:59; src/components/tasks/TaskViews.tsx:395) | Round 4: The Brain dump sidebar row has the tooltip 'Brain dump: paste notes, get tasks', with Indonesian added.

items.title: Type filter is shared with Projects without saying so
items.detail: Both sidebars save the filter under the same key, 's2g-project-type'. Choosing a type in Projects silently filters the project list in Tasks, and the reverse. Fix: Remove the copy in TasksSidebar (see the duplicate list finding), or give each app its own key. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:32; src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:30) | Round 4: The TasksSidebar type filter now uses its own key, s2g-tasks-project-type, so Projects and Tasks no longer share a filter.

items.title: 'Everything' is admin-only with no explanation
items.detail: Admins see an extra view called 'Everything' with no hint of what it holds. Non-admins never see it, which makes support conversations confusing. Fix: Rename it to 'All company tasks' and put it under the More views fold with a short hint. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:72-77) | Round 4: 'Everything' is renamed 'All company tasks', sits in the More views fold, and has the hint 'Every open task in the company'.

items.title: Desktop sorts the projects twice; the phone keeps a different order
items.detail: rows are sorted with late work first, then each desktop group re-sorts by name, so the first sort is wasted. The phone keeps the late-first order. The same project sits in a different spot on each device. Fix: Sort by name once in rows (as Basecamp does, so cards stay where you left them) and drop the per-group sort. Late projects already stand out through their badge. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:74 and 215 (phone uses rows order at 128-130)) | Round 4: rows sorted by name once (ProjectsHome.tsx); per-group re-sort dropped, so phone and desktop share one order

items.title: Two different New project forms
items.detail: The sidebar form asks for name, email domain and type. The home form (and the phone sheet) asks only for name and type. Where you start decides what you get asked, and 'Email domain' is jargon. Fix: Use one form component everywhere: name and type, with domain under 'More options' and the hint 'mail from this domain files here'. The sidebar compose button should open the home form or a dialog, not a cramped form inside the sidebar. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:62-75 vs src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:83-114) | Round 4: One form: home form (desktop) and phone sheet ask for name and type, with the domain under a folding 'More options' and the hint 'Mail from this domain files here.'; onCreate now passes domain to createProject (App.tsx)

items.title: New project form is squeezed into the sidebar
items.detail: The sidebar's compose button opens the form inside a narrow column, with two text fields, a select and two buttons. That's tight at 1180 px and doesn't work when the sidebar is collapsed to icons. Fix: Make the compose button call the same setAdding as the home (lift the state up or use useCreateAction), so the form opens above the grid. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:54-76) | Round 4: Sidebar inline form removed; compose button calls new onNew prop, which App wires to setProjScope(projects) + setProjNew so the home form opens above the grid

items.title: Status pills have no dark-mode colors
items.detail: .proj-state.ok and .bad use fixed light hex values (#dcfce7, #fee2e2) with no dark rule. In dark mode they're bright pastel blocks on dark cards. Fix: Use tokens: background color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 15%, transparent) with color var(--ok), and the same for danger. (src/polish.css:2637-2648) | Round 4: .proj-state.ok/.bad use color-mix of var(--ok)/var(--danger) (polish.css)

items.title: Card cascade animation ignores reduced motion
items.detail: Every .proj-card animates in with a stagger of up to 360 ms, and there is no prefers-reduced-motion rule for it. Fix: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .proj-card { animation: none; } .proj-card:hover { transform: none; } }. (src/polish.css:2599-2600) | Round 4: reduced-motion block now also sets .proj-card:hover transform none

items.title: Card-field settings are a feature to remove
items.detail: A sliders button lets each person pick which of six fields cards show. Basecamp has nothing like it. It adds a control to the header, and unticking everything leaves blank cards. Fix: Remove the popover and always show type, state, next deadline and last activity. Keep 'people' off. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:55-58,167-188) | Round 4: Card-fields popover and the sliders button removed; cards always show type, owner, state, next deadline, last activity (people off)

items.title: Status pill joins up to three warnings
items.detail: '2 late · 1 not picked up · 1 waiting on client' in one rounded pill wraps across lines on a 260 px card and is hard to scan. Fix: Show only the worst issue in the pill, plus '+N' with the rest in a title tooltip, the way the phone's hint() does at line 119. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:223,251-259) | Round 4: Pill shows the worst issue plus '+N', full list in the title tooltip

items.title: Search box appears only after more than 6 projects
items.detail: The search box shows up at 7 projects, which shifts the header. Basecamp always has a 'Find' box. Fix: Always render the search box, or reserve its width. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:161-166) | Round 4: Search box always rendered when there are projects

items.title: Past projects are hard to find on desktop
items.detail: The phone lists 'Past projects' on the home. Desktop has it only as a toggle at the end of the sidebar. Fix: Add a muted 'Past projects (N)' link under the last group on desktop that calls onPast. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:209-271) | Round 4: Muted 'Past projects (N)' link under the last group on desktop calling onPast

items.title: 'Past projects' toggle opens a list and also navigates
items.detail: Clicking once expands the past list and also opens the Past scope. Clicking again collapses the list but leaves you on Past, which feels broken. Fix: Make it navigate only, since the Past page already lists them. Remove the showPast expansion, or put it on a separate chevron. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:108-120) | Round 4: Sidebar Past toggle only navigates; the showPast expansion was removed

items.title: Phone 'Past projects' row has no group title
items.detail: The past group has no title, so it reads as a stray row after Paused. Fix: Give it a title (t('Archive')), or render it as a footer link styled as muted. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:131) | Round 4: Past group gets title t('Archived') (phones now also have a Done tab, so it rarely shows)

items.title: A project has 12 parts; Basecamp has about 6
items.detail: Overview, Tasks, Workload, Quotes, Chat, Mail, Meetings, Files, Notes, Tables, Logins and Guests are all shown by default, so the tab row and the phone section list are long. Fix: Show Overview, Tasks, Chat, Mail, Files and Notes by default. Hide Workload, Tables and Logins (people can turn them back on in tab settings), and show Quotes only when a quote exists. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:38-54) | Round 4: New projectTabDefaults(): Workload, Tables, Logins and (until a quote exists) Quotes start hidden; TabBar got an optional `defaults` prop used after personal and company prefs, also applied to phone parts and ProjectSections

items.title: Same parts get different names and icons
items.detail: The right-click menu says 'Emails' with MessagesSquare and FolderOpen, while the tabs say 'Mail' with Hash and FileText. The same part looks different depending on where you open it. Fix: Use projectTabIcon() and the projectTabs names in the right-click menu. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:42-44 vs src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:27-30,46) | Round 4: Right-click menu uses projectTabIcon() and the tab name 'Mail'

items.title: Every non-danger action row gets the template icon
items.detail: ProjectSections draws LayoutTemplate for every action that isn't destructive, whatever the action actually does. Fix: Add an icon field to the action type and render a.icon. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:116) | Round 4: ProjectSections action type has icon; TasksView passes LayoutTemplate / Archive

items.title: End work is a plain ghost button in the header
items.detail: Ending a project is a big step, but the button is styled like Stages and sits right next to it. Fix: Move it into an overflow menu with danger styling and a confirm step, or Undo, like ProjectsHome:48. (src/components/TasksView.tsx:739-741)

items.title: Arrow on project cards appears only on hover
items.detail: The arrow fades in only on hover, so it never shows on an iPad (820 or 1180 px touch), and the card footer looks empty. Fix: Under (hover: none), show the arrow at opacity 0.5. (src/polish.css:2660-2668) | Round 4: @media (hover: none) shows the card arrow at opacity 0.5

items.title: Phone Month ignores the date picked in the month drop-down
items.detail: If you pick 20 Nov from the title's mini month, the list under the grid shows 1 Nov (or today) instead of the 20th, so the date you chose seems to have been ignored. Fix: Start `picked` from `cursor` when cursor falls in the month, and reset it whenever the cursor's day changes (key on cursor.toDateString(), not only the month): `setPicked(inMonth(cursor) ? cursor : inMonth(today) ? today : first)`. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:79-86 (PhoneMonth picked/shownKey reset)) | Round 4: MonthView.tsx PhoneMonth: picked starts from cursor when it is in the month, otherwise today, otherwise the 1st. It now resets whenever the cursor's day changes, not just its month.

items.title: Desktop event panel covers the end of the week
items.detail: The detail card is pinned 340px wide over the right edge of the grid. In Week view at 1180px and 1440px it hides Fri to Sun, which is often the event you just clicked, and you can't see what you're editing. Fix: Do what Google does and anchor the card beside the clicked event, flipping left when the event is in the right half. Or, if you keep a fixed panel, give the grid a matching right margin while it's open, animated with a grid-template-columns transition. (src/calendar.css:498-510 (.ev-detail absolute right:16px width:340px)) | Round 4: While an event is open on a pane at least 900px wide, .cal-pane gets has-detail and the grid (.tg/.mg/.sch) gets margin-right 364px with an animated margin transition (reduced-motion fallback). Checked at 1280: Fri to Sun stay visible.

items.title: Desktop event card has no Duplicate, Copy link or Move
items.detail: On desktop the open event only shows Edit, Delete and Close. Duplicate and Copy link are only in the right-click menu, which most people never find. Google's card has a ⋮ menu for these. Fix: Pass `more={detailMore(selected)}` on desktop too and draw a ⋮ icon button in .ev-actions that opens it as an ActionSheet popover. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:65-83 (actions); CalendarView.tsx:488 passes `more` only on phones) | Round 4: detailMore() is now passed on every screen. The desktop card has a ⋮ icon button in .ev-actions that opens ActionSheet anchored to it (Duplicate, Copy link, Copy call link, Delete). Verified in a 1280 screenshot.

items.title: RSVP buttons are in a different order on phone and desktop
items.detail: Desktop shows Yes, Maybe, No and phones show Yes, No, Maybe. Anyone who uses both taps the wrong answer. Fix: Use one order everywhere: Yes, No, Maybe (Google's on both platforms). (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:96-106) | Round 4: Rsvp uses one order everywhere: Yes, No, Maybe.

items.title: Notetaker controls use three different words
items.detail: The same feature reads 'Record this meeting', 'Send notetaker' and 'Don't record' depending on timing. 'Record' sounds like screen or video capture, so people don't know what will happen. Fix: Use one verb pair: 'Notetaker joins' as a switch row (on or off), and 'Send notetaker now' only inside 15 minutes. Drop 'Record this meeting' and 'Don't record'. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:178-198) | Round 4: The desktop card uses a 'Notetaker joins' switch row (.ev-bot-row, role=switch) and 'Send notetaker now' only within 15 minutes, on both desktop and phone. 'Record this meeting' and 'Don't record' are gone. Indonesian added.

items.title: Location row repeats the call app name
items.detail: Events whose location is 'Google Meet' or 'Zoom' get a map-pin row reading 'Google Meet' right under the Join Google Meet button. That's noise, and it looks like a physical place. Fix: Use the existing helper: `const place = placeOf(event, link?.url); {place && <Row icon={<MapPin/>}>{place}</Row>}`. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:202) | Round 4: DetailBody uses placeOf(event, link?.url) for the location row.

items.title: Five views in a segmented control on desktop
items.detail: Day, Week, Month, Schedule and 3 days fill the header and push the title and arrows together at 1180px. '3 days' is a phone view that desktop users rarely need. Google puts the views in one drop-down. Fix: On desktop, show one 'Week ▾' Select (the one already used for `narrow`) for all widths, and drop '3day' from the desktop list. Keep shortcuts D/W/M/A. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:133 (views list) and 401-407 (segmented)) | Round 4: Desktop always uses the View Select drop-down. '3day' is no longer in the desktop list (it shows only while it is the current view). D/W/M/A shortcuts are unchanged. Removed the dead .cal-views CSS.

items.title: Tablet Today button is just a number
items.detail: Under 720px (iPad portrait beside the panel) Today becomes a small calendar tile showing '15'. It reads as a date label, not a button that jumps to today. Fix: Keep the text 'Today' button at tablet widths (it is only about 60px). Use the number tile on phones only, where the top bar is Google's. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:382-385) | Round 4: The narrow tablet header keeps the text 'Today' button. The number tile is phone-only. Verified at 768.

items.title: Folded mini month is still in the tab order
items.detail: When the month drop is closed, its 42 day buttons and 12 month buttons can still be focused with Tab. Keyboard users tab through invisible dates before reaching the grid. Fix: Add `tabIndex={open ? 0 : -1}` to .md-day and .md-month buttons and to the arrow buttons, or put `inert` on the fold when closed. (src/components/calendar/MonthDrop.tsx:90-96 and 145-150 (no tabIndex); the bare chips at line 114 already do it right) | Round 4: MonthDrop fold (bare and desktop) gets inert when closed.

items.title: Up next Join link stays focusable after it folds
items.detail: The strip keeps the last meeting while folding away (aria-hidden), but its Join link and title button stay focusable, so Tab lands on an invisible Join. Fix: Add `inert={!e || undefined}` to the .fold wrapper, or tabIndex -1 on .cu-main and .cu-join when `!e`. (src/components/calendar/UpNext.tsx:32-46) | Round 4: The UpNext .fold wrapper gets inert when there is no upcoming meeting.

items.title: Schedule says 'Nothing planned after this' while still loading
items.detail: The end line shows as soon as the list renders, even though more weeks load on scroll (up to two years). It tells people their future is empty when it hasn't been checked yet. Fix: Only show the text when `weeks >= MAX_WEEKS`. Before that, keep an empty sentinel of the same height. (src/components/calendar/ScheduleView.tsx:210-212) | Round 4: The 'Nothing planned after this' text shows only when weeks >= MAX_WEEKS. Until then .sch-end keeps the same height and stays empty.

items.title: Schedule needs an 'Earlier' button to scroll back
items.detail: Google's schedule loads earlier days as you scroll up. Here you have to notice and tap an 'Earlier' pill at the very top, so scrolling up just stops. Fix: Put an IntersectionObserver on a top sentinel that calls `earlier()` (which already keeps the scroll position), and remove the button. (src/components/calendar/ScheduleView.tsx:162-164 and 118-124) | Round 4: Scrolling within 240px of the top calls earlier(), which keeps the scroll position, is throttled and stops at 2 years back. The Earlier button and its CSS are removed. Earlier weeks are tracked separately (back) so they no longer eat into the forward MAX_WEEKS cap.

items.title: Phone quick create hides More options and always uses the first calendar
items.detail: The sheet has no calendar choice and no Event/Task switch (Google has both). The full editor only opens if you tap the date line or swipe up, and nothing says so. Fix: Add a visible 'More options' text button in the sheet's footer, and an Event / Task segmented control above the title, since onSave already takes a kind. (src/components/calendar/QuickCreate.tsx:42 (calendars[0].id) and 100-102 (qc-when is the only way to More)) | Round 4: QuickCreate has an Event/Task segmented control above the title (onSave and onMore pass the kind) and a calendar picker (calLabel, plain er-sel field) when there is more than one calendar. A visible 'More options' link button is in the footer. Verified at 375 in light and dark.

items.title: 'Move to tomorrow' on every event, including meetings with guests
items.detail: One click silently moves a meeting with other people to tomorrow. Google has no such action. It makes sense for task blocks, but for meetings it's a trap. Fix: Only offer it when `props.taskOf?.(e)` or the event has no guests. Otherwise leave it out. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:285 and 306) | Round 4: Move to tomorrow only appears for task blocks or events with no guests, in both the context menu and the detail menu.

items.title: Clicking an empty Month day opens the New event dialog straight away
items.detail: On desktop Month, any stray click in a cell opens a full modal at 9:00. Clicking to focus the window or to deselect an event ends up creating one. Fix: First click on a cell closes any open event (deselect). Then use Google's light quick-add popover anchored to the cell, with 'More options' going to the dialog. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:168 (GridMonth cell onClick → onCreate(nine(d)))) | Round 4: GridMonth cell click closes the open event if there is one (kit.onSelect(null); CardKit.onSelect now accepts null), so a stray click never creates an event. Only a click with nothing open opens New event. The anchored quick-add popover was not built.

items.title: Tapping the picked day again switches to Day view
items.detail: In phone Month, a second tap on the selected date leaves Month for Day view. Nothing signals this, and iOS Calendar doesn't do it, so it feels like an accidental jump. Fix: Make the second tap do nothing. Make the day heading above the list (.mp-list-head) a button that opens the day. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:106 (onClick: on ? onDay(d) : setPicked(d))) | Round 4: Tapping the picked day again does nothing. The .mp-list-head heading is now a button (with a chevron, 44px tall) that opens Day view.

items.title: Dead phone code in GridMonth
items.detail: MonthView sends phones to PhoneMonth, so GridMonth's phone branches never run. They add upkeep and confusion for whoever fixes the next bug. Fix: Remove the phone branches, the PhoneChip component and the matching .mg-chips/.mg-more-n CSS. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:164-166, 184-187, 204-211 (PhoneChip) and the mg-chips styles) | Round 4: Removed GridMonth's phone branches, PhoneChip, onColor/ROOM.phone and all .mg-chips/.mg-chip/.mg-more-n CSS in mobile/calendar.css, and simplified .mg-lanes:not(.mg-chips).

items.title: Leftover CSS for the removed New event button
items.detail: The .cal-new rule styles a header button that no longer exists (commit c08b0d6 removed the repeated primary button). Fix: Delete the @container rule for .cal-new span. (src/calendar.css:1094-1098) | Round 4: Removed the .cal-new @container rule in calendar.css and the leftover .cal-new rule in shell.css (smallest edit).

items.title: 'Now' and 'now' in different cases
items.detail: The Up next strip shows 'Now', but startsIn() returns lowercase 'now', so the same state reads differently in different spots. Fix: Make startsIn return 'Now' (or reuse one helper) so all three spots match. (src/components/calendar/calTools.ts:47 (startsIn) vs UpNext.tsx:37 and EventDetail.tsx:155) | Round 4: startsIn() returns t('Now'), so all spots match.

items.title: Delete, regenerate and clear use the browser's confirm()
items.detail: Deleting a meeting with its recording, or wiping all tasks, pops a grey system dialog with no animation and no Undo. It breaks the app's look and the bar's 'Toast with Undo' rule. Fix: Use the app's ActionSheet / RepeatScope-style confirm for regenerate and recording deletion. For Delete meeting and Clear all tasks, delete straight away with a toast that has Undo, keeping the data for 10 seconds. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:486-487, 680 (keep select) and 823) | Round 4: Removed every native confirm() from the meeting page. Delete meeting now deletes straight away and App's toast offers Undo. Clear all tasks and bulk delete also delete straight away: App.tsx onBulk now keeps the deleted tasks and shows '{n} tasks deleted' with Undo. Regenerate and deleting the recording or video ask first with ConfirmSheet, the app's own sheet (a centred panel on desktop).

items.title: Desktop meeting header repeats its More menu
items.detail: The header shows Make bot leave, Regenerate notes, Share and Delete as buttons, and the ⋯ menu next to them lists the same four again. Duplicate controls make people unsure which one to use. Fix: Keep Share (and Make bot leave while live) as buttons, and put Regenerate, Who can see this, Bot log and Delete only in ⋯, as Read AI does. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:536-556 (buttons) vs 490-496 (more menu items)) | Round 4: On desktop the More menu no longer repeats the header buttons. 'Ask notetaker to leave' and 'Ask about this meeting' appear in the menu only on phones. The menu now holds Regenerate, Who can see this, Notetaker log, the recording deletes and Delete meeting.

items.title: Header crammed with folder, type and filing note
items.detail: Back link, status, Folder picker, Type picker, 'auto-filed', four buttons and ⋯ share one row. At 820px it wraps or squeezes, and the meeting title sits below all of it. Fix: Move Folder and Type into the 'At a glance' card (as the phone's m-facts rows do), and keep the header to Back, status and actions. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:521-535) | Round 4: Moved the Folder and Type pickers and the 'auto-filed' note out of the desktop header into the At a glance card, styled as plain values. The header now has only Back, status, Share and the More menu.

items.title: 'Bot' and 'notetaker' used for the same thing
items.detail: Audit 1 settled on one notetaker name, but the dialog title says 'Send the bot to a meeting', the action says 'Make bot leave', and empty states say 'send the bot'. 'Bot' also sounds less trustworthy to meeting guests. Fix: Rename to 'Send notetaker', 'Ask notetaker to leave' and 'Notetaker log', and update the empty-state copy and the Indonesian strings. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:492, 539, 1306, 1470, 1473; MeetPhone.tsx:392) | Round 4: Renamed to Send notetaker (dialog title), Ask notetaker to leave, Notetaker log, Notetaker log copied and Notetaker name. Updated the empty state and the demo note to say notetaker. Added Indonesian strings to src/i18n/id/meet.ts.

items.title: Settings has three names
items.detail: The desktop sidebar says 'Filing rules & settings', the phone drawer says 'Settings', and the Folders screen and push screen say 'Meet settings'. People can't tell whether these are the same place. Fix: Use 'Meet settings' everywhere and move it to the bottom of the sidebar, away from the folder list. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:152; MeetPhone.tsx:63, 73, 437) | Round 4: The sidebar now says 'Meet settings' with a gear icon, in its own nav group below a divider under the folders. The phone drawer row also says 'Meet settings'.

items.title: Same pages named differently on phone and desktop
items.detail: Desktop has 'Meetings' and 'Upcoming'. Phone has 'Home', 'Coming up' and 'Past meetings'. Someone switching devices can't find the same screen. Fix: Pick one pair, for example 'Meetings' and 'Upcoming', and use it in the drawer, headers and the 'See all' screen. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:122, 392; MeetPhone.tsx:50, 238, 306) | Round 4: Phone screens now use the desktop names: the drawer's 'Home' is now 'Meetings', and the 'Coming up' heading and the See all screen title are now 'Upcoming'.

items.title: Unfiled count is shown as a warning
items.detail: An amber 'warn' badge on Unfiled makes unsorted meetings look like an error, even though filing is optional. It nags without pointing to a real problem. Fix: Use the plain .count style, or no count at all, since the phone already says 'N to file'. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:148 (count warn-count)) | Round 4: The Unfiled count uses the plain .count style instead of the amber warn-count.

items.title: Auto-join explanation contradicts the chosen mode
items.detail: Admins always read 'It joins a minute before each meeting… for everyone', even when they set the mode to 'Only meetings I accepted'. The text says the opposite of what they chose. Fix: Build the sentence from the mode label for admins too, for example '{mode}, a minute before the start. Read only: it never changes your calendar.' (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1224-1227; MeetPhone.tsx:88-91) | Round 4: The admin explanation is built from the chosen mode, '{mode}, a minute before the start. Read only: it never changes your calendar.', on desktop Upcoming and in the phone Meet settings.

items.title: Upcoming rows show the notetaker state twice
items.detail: A row can show 'The notetaker will join' as text and also a 'Notetaker joins' switch. On a 820px row, along with Join and Send now, that's four controls fighting for space. Fix: Keep the switch only, labelled 'Notetaker'. Drop the separate 'will join' line and the 'set by you' meta. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1260-1264 and 1284-1299) | Round 4: Dropped the 'The notetaker will join' line and the 'set by you' text. The switch is now labelled just 'Notetaker'.

items.title: Upcoming lists calls the notetaker can't join
items.detail: In-person and no-link events show up with 'No meeting link' and nothing you can do. Read AI lists only meetings with a joinable link, so the useful rows get buried. Fix: Filter `soon` to events with linkOf(e) non-null. Optionally add a folded 'N without a call link' line at the end. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1197 (soon filter) and 1255) | Round 4: Desktop Upcoming lists only events with a call link (linkOf). A quiet '{n} more without a call link' line sits at the end.

items.title: Phone 'Coming up' sheet is a dead end
items.detail: Tapping a coming meeting opens a sheet with read-only text. It has no Join button and no notetaker switch, only 'Open in Calendar', so people can't do the obvious next step. Fix: Add a primary 'Join {app}' (when within 10 minutes) and the notetaker switch row to the sheet. Keep 'Open in Calendar' as the secondary action. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:164-185) | Round 4: The phone event sheet has a Join button (primary when the call starts within 10 minutes), a Notetaker switch row, and 'Open in Calendar' as the secondary button.

items.title: Mic / MicOff icon toggle is unclear
items.detail: A crossed-out mic usually means 'you are muted', not 'the notetaker won't join'. Tapping it changes state with no confirmation. Fix: Use a labelled switch or a small 'Notetaker on/off' pill, and show a toast ('The notetaker won't join Standup' with Undo) when it changes. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:153-162) | Round 4: Replaced the Mic/MicOff icon with a labelled role=switch pill reading 'Notes on' or 'Notes off', with a 44px tap area. Each change shows a toast naming the meeting, with Undo, through a new optional undo argument on the toast prop (App passes the Undo action).

items.title: Empty states use developer language
items.detail: Messages like 'notes need a transcript and an AI provider in Se…', '(automatic tasks are off or were cleared)' and '(captions must be on in the meeting)' explain the system instead of telling the user what to do. Fix: Rewrite as next steps: 'No notes for this meeting. Regenerate notes' as a button, and 'Waiting for people to talk.' Move the reasons into the notetaker log. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:811, 831, 881) | Round 4: Rewrote the empty states. Summary: 'No notes for this meeting.' with a Regenerate notes button. Transcript: 'Waiting for people to talk.' Tasks: 'No tasks yet. Action items mentioned in the meeting:'.

items.title: Deleting the recording is done from a 'Keep' drop-down
items.detail: Picking a different option in a Select permanently deletes video or audio. Destructive actions hidden in a picker are easy to trigger by mistake. Fix: Show what's kept as text, plus a 'Delete recording' danger action in ⋯ that asks for confirmation with the app's own dialog. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:674-689) | Round 4: The Keep picker is now a line of text ('Kept: … · size of team storage'). 'Delete recording' and 'Delete the video' are danger actions in the More menu and ask first with ConfirmSheet.

items.title: Phone filter chips 'Recording' and 'Failed' are unclear
items.detail: 'Recording' could mean 'live now' or 'has a recording'. 'Failed' puts diagnostics on the home screen, which Read AI keeps out of sight. Fix: Use All, Has tasks, Live now. Show failed meetings with a red status on the row instead of a filter. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:186-191 (FILTERS)) | Round 4: The phone filter chips are now All, Has tasks and Live now. Failed meetings still show a red status on their row.

items.title: Phone Folders screen repeats the drawer
items.detail: Tasks from meetings and Unfiled show both in the drawer and as 'folders' on the Folders screen. They aren't folders, and the duplication muddles the navigation. Fix: Remove the Tasks and Unfiled rows from MeetFolders, so it lists only real folders. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:416-417 vs 50-52) | Won't fix: Phones no longer use the Meet drawer: MeetDrawer is not rendered anywhere, and the bottom bar is Meetings/Past/Folders. The Folders screen is now the only way to reach Tasks from meetings and Unfiled on a phone, so removing those rows would remove the screens.

items.title: Ask AI is offered in four places
items.detail: The sidebar has an 'Ask AI' item that opens a panel instead of a page, and the meeting page offers it in the header, the ⋯ menu and the At a glance card. That clutters the page, and the sidebar item behaves differently from its neighbours. Fix: Keep one 'Ask about this meeting' in the At a glance card. Remove it from ⋯ and move the global Ask AI to the app's docked Ask AI pill instead of a nav item. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:130, 491, 734, 1149) | Round 4: Removed the Ask AI nav item from the Meet sidebar; the app rail's Ask AI covers asking across meetings. Removed Ask from the desktop More menu, so the one desktop entry is 'Ask about this meeting' in At a glance. Phones keep it in the More menu because At a glance is hidden there.

items.title: Native checkbox and inconsistent labels in tasks and access
items.detail: The access popover uses a raw <input type=checkbox> against the app's switch style. Task checks are labelled 'Toggle done' on one row type and 'Mark done' or 'Reopen' on another. Fix: Use the app's .switch button with role=switch for 'Allow download', and use the Mark done / Reopen aria-label on both task row types. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:916 and 1016 vs 1003) | Round 4: The access popover uses .switch buttons with role=switch for 'Allow downloading' and for portal sharing. The desktop task check now uses the Mark done / Reopen aria-label with aria-pressed.

items.title: 'No open tasks. Nice.' empty state
items.detail: A chatty line on a work screen. The bar asks for plain, specific copy. Fix: Use 'No open tasks from meetings.' (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1116)

items.title: No visible file actions on iPad (touch, 768px and up)
items.detail: At 820 and 1180 px on a touch iPad, the '…' button is hidden and the star/trash buttons only appear on hover. Touch users get no visible way to act on a file except a long-press they have no reason to try. Fix: Add @media (hover: none) { .d-more { display:inline-grid } .d-actions { opacity:1; transform:none } } or show .d-more on every pointer:coarse device, the way Google Drive on iPad shows ⋮ on each tile. (src/mobile/drive.css:10-12 (.d-more display:none outside phones); src/shell.css:1499-1527 (.d-actions opacity 0 until :hover)) | Round 4: src/mobile/drive.css: @media (min-width:768px) and (hover:none) keeps .d-actions (star/trash) visible on touch tablets

items.title: Preview shows developer text to users
items.detail: 'Previews for documents arrive with the real file server.' and 'Sample video. Upload your own…' are build notes. They make the product feel unfinished. Fix: Replace with a user-facing fallback: the file icon, name and size plus 'No preview for this file type' and Download / Open buttons. Drop the sample-video note or show it only in demo workspaces. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:105 and :112) | Round 4: DrivePreview.tsx: dev captions removed; placeholder now says 'No preview for this file type' with Download/Open the email

items.title: Trash has no 'Empty trash'
items.detail: Google Drive users expect one 'Empty trash' button. Here they have to delete each item forever one at a time, and the desktop only shows a note about 30 days. Fix: Add an 'Empty trash' text button on the right of the trash note (desktop) and on the phone's dp-sort row when section==='trash'. Ask for confirmation in a sheet and offer one Undo toast. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:358 (trash note only); :167-171 (per-item menu)) | Round 4: DriveView: 'Empty trash' button in desktop trash note and phone sort row, EmptyTrashSheet confirm; App deleteForever accepts a list with one Undo toast

items.title: 'Delete forever' leaves sub-folders' files orphaned
items.detail: Deleting a trashed folder forever removes only its direct children. Grandchildren stay in data with a missing parent, so they never show anywhere, or they reappear later. Fix: Collect every descendant id recursively (walk parentId) and remove them all. Keep the snapshot Undo as it is. (src/App.tsx:3623 (filter i.id !== id && i.parentId !== id)) | Round 4: App.tsx deleteForever collects all descendants recursively before removing

items.title: 'Delete forever' uses an X icon
items.detail: An X reads as close or dismiss, so a permanent delete sits next to Restore looking harmless. Fix: Use Trash2 (or a Trash with X) and the danger colour on hover. Keep the title 'Delete forever'. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:129-131 and :170) | Round 4: Delete forever uses Trash2 (button + menu), .d-danger hover colour

items.title: Desktop can't sort, the phone can
items.detail: Phones get a Name / Last modified / Size sort sheet. On desktop the list header is static (cursor: default), so people can't sort by date or size the way Google Drive allows. Fix: Make Name / Modified / Size header cells buttons that reuse the same persisted 'pm-drive-sorts' and sorter(). Show an arrow on the active column and add a 'Sort' dropdown in grid mode. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:369-373 (static d-th); src/shell.css:1555-1567 (.d-th cursor default); phone sort at :492-507, :693-712) | Round 4: Desktop list header cells are sort buttons with arrow (shared pm-drive-sorts + sorter), SortButton dropdown in grid mode

items.title: Desktop file menu is missing Details
items.detail: The phone menu has 'Details' (type, location, uploader). The right-click menu on desktop doesn't, so desktop users can't see where a file lives or who uploaded it. Fix: Add { label:'Details', icon: Info, group:'file' } to menuFor. On desktop, open DetailsScreen content in a right-side panel (Google Drive's 'i' panel). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:166-183 (menuFor) vs :241 (phone Details)) | Round 4: Details added to desktop menuFor, opens a Sheet with shared DetailsBody (location, modified, size, uploader)

items.title: Opening from the phone menu breaks swipe-through
items.detail: Tapping a row opens the viewer with the whole folder, but 'Open' in the … menu passes [i]. The same file then has no prev/next and no count, which is inconsistent. Fix: Pass the current folder's files list to phoneMenu's Open, the same way the row tap does. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:234 (props.onOpen(i, [i])) vs :616 (props.open(i, files))) | Round 4: Phone menu Open passes the current list's files instead of [i]

items.title: Trashing in the viewer closes it instead of moving on
items.detail: Google Drive and Photos move to the next item after a delete. Here the viewer closes, and someone cleaning up a folder has to reopen it every time. Fix: After onTrash, call onNav(next ?? prev) when either exists, and close only when the list is empty. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:84-87) | Round 4: Viewer trash moves to next/prev and closes only when none left; App filters trashed items out of the preview list

items.title: Viewer's Download and Share link are limited
items.detail: Download only shows for local blob uploads, and Share link never appears, though both are in the file menu. People expect them in the viewer's top bar (Drive puts them there). Fix: Show Download whenever item.url exists (the same download() helper as DriveView:153) and add a Link2 'Copy link' button when the url is not data:. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:72-76) | Round 4: Viewer shows Download whenever url (or blob) exists and a Copy link button for non-data/blob urls

items.title: Flipping files zooms in from the centre in every direction
items.detail: Every next/prev re-keys .lb-stage and runs zoomIn, so the motion doesn't follow the arrow or swipe direction. It reads as reopening rather than moving along. Fix: Track the direction in state and apply a .from-left / .from-right class that slides 24px with a fade (200ms ease-out). Keep zoomIn only for the first open, and turn it off under prefers-reduced-motion. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:99 (key=item.id); src/shell.css:1672-1679 (animation: zoomIn)) | Round 4: Viewer stage gets .from-left/.from-right slide 24px 200ms by direction; zoomIn only on first open; reduced-motion off

items.title: No swipe down to close the viewer on phones
items.detail: iOS Photos and Drive close a preview with a downward swipe. Here only the small X does, at the top edge, which is hard to reach. Fix: In onTouchEnd, close when dy > 100 and |dy| > |dx|*1.5. Have the stage follow the finger and fade the backdrop while dragging. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:45-54 (only sideways is handled)) | Round 4: Swipe down >100px closes the viewer; stage follows finger and backdrop fades

items.title: Wrong empty-state copy for Media, Email and Recent on phones
items.detail: Media and Email attachments fall through to 'Files you open, upload or get show here, newest first.' That copy doesn't explain those sections. Fix: Add cases: media → 'Photos and videos you upload or receive show here.'; email → 'Attachments from your emails appear here automatically.' (and drop the separate drive-note above it). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:582-595) | Round 4: Phone empty states: email-specific copy and Mail icon, Recent copy fixed, email caption hidden when empty

items.title: Phone grid tiles hide stars and dates
items.detail: In grid mode the tile shows only the name, so starred files and recent changes can't be told apart, unlike the list rows. Fix: Add a small filled star before the name when starred, and a one-line date under the name (fs-secondary, text-3). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:641-645) | Round 4: Phone grid tiles show filled star before name and a date line (location while searching)

items.title: Search results don't say where a file is
items.detail: The search covers every folder and email attachments, but the results show no location. Two files with the same name look identical, and the breadcrumb is replaced by 'Search results'. Fix: In search mode, add a 'Location' column in list view and a 'in Folder / Sub' line in the card meta (reuse pathOf from MoveSheet:771). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:82 (search across all live), :312-313, :375-387) | Round 4: Desktop search: Location column in list, 'in {place}' line on grid cards; phone search rows show location

items.title: Recent quietly stops at 30 files
items.detail: Recent stops at 30 items with no 'show more', so older files seem to be gone. Fix: Group Recent by Today / This week / Earlier with lazy paging, or add a 'Show more' row after 30. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:87 and :549) | Round 4: Recent shows 30 then a 'Show more' button (desktop and phone)

items.title: Folded sidebar shows a column of letter tiles
items.detail: With the sidebar collapsed, every note becomes a 28px first-letter tile. Several notes start with the same letter, so the tiles can't be told apart and they look like app icons. Apple Notes hides the list. Fix: When .sidebar.collapsed, hide .notes-nav entirely and keep only the New note and a search icon. Remove the ni-dot span. (src/polish.css:2883-2912; src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:335-337) | Round 4: Folded sidebar hides .notes-nav and keeps only New note (polish.css). The ni-dot letter tiles and their span are gone.

items.title: Recently deleted is hard to find on desktop
items.detail: On desktop it sits under the whole list, below the last month, and it isn't in the 'Show' dropdown, while the phone's title menu includes it. Apple Notes lists it as a folder. Fix: Add a 'Recently deleted' option (group 'More') to the desktop Select that calls setTrash(true). Keep the bottom link only when the list is short. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:160-166 and :205-216 vs :130) | Round 4: 'Recently deleted' (group More) added to the desktop Show Select, calls setTrash(true). The bottom link now shows only when the list is short (<=8).

items.title: Pin shows up twice in the desktop note header
items.detail: The note header has a pin button, and the … menu next to it has 'Pin to the top' too. Two controls for one rare action. Fix: Remove the header pin button and keep Pin in the … menu (Apple Notes keeps it in the menu or swipe). (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:424-428; src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:105) | Round 4: Removed the header pin button. Pin stays in the … menu.

items.title: Project shows up twice in the header
items.detail: A ProjectPicker in the header and 'Move to a project' in the … menu do the same thing, which makes the header busy. Fix: Keep the header picker as a quiet chip (it shows the current project) and drop 'Move to a project' from the menu on desktop. The phone keeps the menu entry. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:422; src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:106) | Round 4: noteActions takes {noMove}. The desktop editor menu drops 'Move to a project' (the header ProjectPicker chip handles it). The phone keeps it.

items.title: The body placeholder is a tutorial
items.detail: 'Write here. A line can become a task: put the caret on it and tap Make task.' shows in every empty note. On desktop it also says 'tap' and points at a button that already sits in the toolbar. Fix: Use 'Start writing' (Apple Notes shows nothing). Teach Make task once with a one-time toast or the toolbar button's tooltip. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:295) | Round 4: Placeholder is now 'Start writing'. The Make a task button keeps its tooltip.

items.title: The phone Share button opens visibility settings
items.detail: The iOS share glyph tells people to expect the system share sheet or a link. Here it opens 'Who sees it'. The aria-label even says 'Who sees it'. Fix: Use the Users or Lock icon (as whoBtn does), or make Share open a sheet with 'Who sees it' and 'Copy link' rows. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:382-385) | Round 4: The phone top-bar button now uses who.icon (Lock or Users) instead of the iOS Share glyph.

items.title: 'Saved' status doesn't refresh on its own
items.detail: The status checks Date.now() - updatedAt < 8000 during render, but nothing re-renders after 8s. 'Saved' can stay up indefinitely, then jump to 'Edited … by you' at an odd moment. Fix: Keep a timer state: after an edit, set saved=true and setTimeout 8s to clear it. Cross-fade between the two lines (opacity 200ms). (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:211-218) | Round 4: justSaved state with an 8s timer set on each edit. The status line is keyed and cross-fades (.note-status fade-in 200ms, reduced-motion fallback).

items.title: The phone empty filter view sends people the wrong way
items.detail: On the phone, 'No notes here yet. Tap the pen' shows when a filter (Only me, a project) hides the notes. Desktop correctly offers 'Show all notes'. Fix: When filter !== 'all', use the desktop version: 'No notes in this view' plus a 'Show all notes' link. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:251 vs :157) | Round 4: Phone empty filtered view shows 'No notes in this view' plus a 'Show all notes' link.

items.title: The swipe 'Move' action uses a chevron
items.detail: A ChevronRight in a swipe action reads as 'open' or 'more', not move to a project. Fix: Use FolderInput (the same icon as the menu's Move to a project, noteMenu.ts:106). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:374) | Round 4: Swipe Move uses FolderInput.

items.title: Viewers of a shared note can't pin it
items.detail: Pin is limited to editors, so teammates who only read a shared note can't keep it at the top of their own list. Apple Notes pins per person. Fix: Store pins per user (pinnedBy: string[] or a local per-user set) and offer Pin to anyone who can see the note. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:372 (start only if edit); src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:105) | Left: Per-person pins need a data-model and server change (pinnedBy per user, or synced per-user state). Today pinned is one field on the shared note.

items.title: Recently deleted has no 'Delete all', and desktop rows only offer 'Put back'
items.detail: Clearing out deleted notes takes one at a time through a hidden menu or a swipe. Apple Notes has 'Delete All' in Recently Deleted. Fix: Add a 'Delete all' text button next to the 30-day note, with confirmation and a batch Undo toast. Show a quiet 'Delete' button next to 'Put back' on hover on desktop. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:389-399 and :423-427) | Round 4: Recently deleted has a 'Delete all' text button with a confirming action sheet. Desktop rows show a quiet Delete next to Put back on hover (hidden on phones).

items.title: Phone swipe deletes deleted notes for good in one gesture
items.detail: A full left swipe in Recently deleted purges the note right away. An accidental swipe destroys it, with only a short toast to recover. Fix: Make the swipe reveal a 'Delete' button that needs a tap (removes: false), or ask for confirmation in an action sheet before purge. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:414) | Round 4: The swipe Delete in Recently deleted no longer purges. It opens a 'Delete for good?' confirm sheet.

items.title: Desktop rows show relative times under date headings
items.detail: Under 'Previous 7 days', rows say '3 days ago', which repeats the heading. The phone uses Apple's short form (13:05, Yesterday, Mon). Fix: Use whenShort(n.updatedAt) on desktop too and keep the '· by Name' suffix. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:344 vs :314 (whenShort)) | Round 4: Desktop rows use whenShort() and keep the '· by Name' suffix.

items.title: Pinned notes are marked twice on desktop
items.detail: Pinned notes sit under a 'Pinned' heading and also show a pin icon before the title, which is visual noise. Fix: Drop the row's pin icon whenever the Pinned heading shows (not while searching). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:139 and :339) | Round 4: The row pin icon only shows when the Pinned heading isn't shown (pinHead prop).

items.title: Person chips are limited to four arbitrary people
items.detail: Search suggestions show the first four other owners in data order, not the people someone works with most, so the right person is often missing. Fix: Rank owners by number of shared notes, or by latest updatedAt, before slice(0,4). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:253) | Round 4: Person chips are ranked by number of notes, then by latest updatedAt, before slice(0,4).

items.title: Desktop search has none of the phone's facets
