items.detail: Phones can narrow a search by Pinned, Shared with me, Has tasks, project or person. Desktop only has free text, so 'notes with tasks' can't be found. Fix: Show the same nl-chip row under the desktop search field while it has focus and q is empty. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:195-217 vs :254-260) | Round 4: Desktop search shows the same facet chips in a .fold under the field while it has focus and q is empty. Desktop chip styles are in notes.css.

items.title: The empty note pane reads like marketing
items.detail: The no-note pane has a long pitch ('Private notes, meeting prep, how-tos… Link a note to a project…') where a calm placeholder would do. Fix: Use the title 'No note open' with no text, or a single line 'Pick a note or press New note'. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:52) | Round 4: The empty pane title is now 'No note open', with no text.

items.title: Hold-for-redo can't be discovered
items.detail: Redo is only a 450ms long-press on Undo. Nobody will find it, and on desktop it shows only in a title. Fix: After an undo, show a separate Redo button next to Undo while redo is available, as iOS's keyboard bar does. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:482-503) | Round 4: After an Undo, a separate Redo button shows next to it in the phone top bar until the next edit.

items.title: 'New table' appears up to three times on desktop
items.detail: The sidebar has a New table compose button, the Tables home header has a primary New table, and the empty state adds a third. This breaks the 'one primary per screen' rule already applied in Drive, Calendar and Meet. Fix: Remove the header primary button (keep the sidebar's, as Drive does), and keep the empty-state button only when the sidebar is folded. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:36-39, :231-233, :243-245) | Round 4: Removed the header primary New table from TablesHome (sidebar compose stays, as in Drive). The empty-state button now has .tb-empty-new, which tables.css hides at >=768px unless the sidebar is collapsed.

items.title: Native browser confirm() for every destructive action
items.detail: Deleting a row, rows, a column, a field, a board group, a rule or a table opens an unstyled OS dialog with no motion and no dark mode. Notes and Drive use Undo toasts instead. Fix: Delete straight away with a toast and Undo (snapshot rows, fields and tables, like App.tsx deleteForever). Use the app's own confirm sheet only for irreversible actions such as rotating secrets. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:418, :473, :1066; src/components/tables/RecordDrawer.tsx:414, :566; src/components/tables/ColumnMenu.tsx:162; src/components/tables/FieldMenu.tsx:305; src/components/tables/BoardView.tsx:393; src/components/tables/Automations.tsx:632, :775, :854) | Round 4: Removed native confirm() from row, rows, column, field and board-choice deletes; each now has an Undo toast (deleteRows/deleteField already toasted; saveField now toasts 'Choice deleted' with undoLast). Rule delete uses toastUndo to restore the rules. Rotating the intake address or signing secret and confirm-first buttons now use the app's ConfirmSheet.

items.title: A deleted table can't be undone
items.detail: 'This can't be undone' while the rest of the app offers Undo. Losing a whole database to one misclick is the worst case for a Notion-style tool. Fix: Keep the table and rows snapshot and show an Undo toast for 10s, or soft-delete into a Trash the way Notion does. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:417-421) | Round 4: deleteTable now deletes straight away and shows a 10s Undo toast that restores the table and its rows (toast prop type gained ms).

items.title: The desktop table header is crowded
items.detail: Menu, letter badge, title, project picker, Undo, Share, Automations and … all share one row. Automations is a power feature but gets the same weight as the title, and the Undo icon is unusual (Notion uses Cmd+Z only). Fix: Move Automations into the … menu (or a quiet icon), drop the header Undo button (keep Cmd+Z and Undo toasts), and keep Share as the one text button. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:629-676) | Round 4: Removed the header Undo button (Cmd+Z and Undo toasts stay). Automations moved into the table ... menu with an on-dot. Share stays the only text button.

items.title: The long tip banner over the grid
items.detail: A paragraph of instructions sits above the grid for every new user, pushes the content down, and disappears with a hard cut. Fix: Cut it to one sentence ('Click a column name for its options') or turn it into a header-cell coach mark. Add .tb-tip to exitAnimations LEAVING with a collapse rule. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:938-945; src/tables.css:2123-2136; not in src/exitAnimations.ts) | Round 4: Tip shortened to one sentence ('Click a column's name for its options.', with Indonesian). .tb-tip added to exitAnimations LEAVING, with an .is-leaving collapse keyframe in tables.css.

items.title: New tables default to the Leads template
items.detail: Someone making a quick list gets Lead columns unless they notice the picker. Notion starts blank. Fix: Default template to 'blank' and keep the templates visible as the first choice row. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:61) | Round 4: NewTableDialog now defaults to the 'blank' template.

items.title: Phone home rows have no menu
items.detail: On desktop, right-clicking a table card gives Open and Copy link. On the phone, holding a row does nothing, and neither offers Rename, Duplicate or Delete from the list. Fix: Bind useActionMenu (long-press) on tb-home-row with Open, Copy link, Rename, Delete (with Undo), and add the same entries to the desktop card menu. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:208-214 vs :141-149) | Round 4: New useTableMenu in TablesApp: Open, Copy link, Rename (RenameSheet) and Delete. It is bound to desktop cards and to phone home rows (long-press). App.tsx passes onRename and onDelete; delete has a 10s Undo and a permission check.

items.title: Table cards show counts and the word 'fields'
items.detail: Desktop cards say 'N rows · N fields'. 'Fields' is builder jargon, and the phone already dropped counts in an earlier pass, so the two differ. Fix: Show the description or 'Edited 2h ago' instead, as in Notion's recent pages, and drop the field count. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:181) | Round 4: Cards show the description or 'Edited {when}' (newest row change, else createdAt). Row and field counts are gone.

items.title: The home header subtitle repeats itself
items.detail: 'Your own databases: leads, pipelines…' shows above existing tables every visit. It's onboarding copy that wastes space. Fix: Show the subtitle only when tables.length === 0 (the empty state already says it), or remove it. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:229) | Round 4: Removed the home header subtitle.

items.title: The row drawer header has six icon buttons
items.detail: Prev, Next, Copy link, Duplicate, Delete and Close sit in a row of small icons, with Delete right next to Close where it's easy to hit by mistake. The full page already has a … menu. Fix: Keep Prev/Next and Close, and move Copy link, Duplicate and Delete into a … menu like the page view. (src/components/tables/RecordDrawer.tsx:386-419 vs :620) | Round 4: Drawer header now has Prev/Next, Open as page, a ... menu (Copy link, Duplicate, Delete via useActionMenu) and Close. Delete is no longer next to Close.

items.title: The colour badge is a hidden setting
items.detail: The table's first-letter badge opens a colour picker on click. People don't expect a letter tile to be a control, and those who click it by accident get a popover. Fix: Move 'Colour' into the … table menu with the swatches inline, and make the badge non-interactive. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:634-645) | Round 4: The letter badge is now a non-interactive span. Colour swatches moved into the ... table menu (.tb-menu-colors).

items.title: Toolbar tools lose their labels at iPad widths
items.detail: Below 1080px (iPad landscape with the sidebar open, and portrait) Sort, Group, Fields and Colours become bare icons. Group and Colours icons are ambiguous, and the labels only exist as hover titles, which touch screens never show. Fix: Below 1080px, fold Group, Fields and Colours into one 'View settings' button (labelled), and keep Filter and Sort with labels. (src/tables.css:98-105 and :106-117) | Round 4: Under a 1080px pane, Group folds into a labelled 'View settings' button (Fields editor plus Group and Colours entries). Filter and Sort keep their labels at <=900 (ellipsis at 160px). Panes under 900 put the view tabs on their own row (.tb-bar-wrap).

items.title: 'Colours' is a top-level toolbar button
items.detail: Conditional colours are an advanced feature but sit in the main toolbar next to Filter and Sort, which crowds the bar for everyone. Fix: Move Colours into the view settings popover (with Fields), and show a small active dot on that button when rules are on. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:852-856) | Round 4: Colours top-level button removed except on board views. It opens from the Fields/View settings popover, and that button shows a .tb-btn-dot when colour rules are on.

items.title: New row is split into two primary buttons
items.detail: 'New row' and its template chevron are two filled primary buttons side by side, which reads as two main actions. Fix: Style them as one split button (one fill, a 1px divider, a shared radius) so the chevron reads as part of the same control. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:859-869) | Round 4: .tb-split is now one control: one shared shadow, no per-half shadow or lift, and a 1px divider instead of a gap.

items.title: Tablet panes can switch to the phone layout
items.detail: The phone layout (cards, one bar, sheets) starts whenever the pane is under 600px. On iPad portrait (820) with the sidebar open, the pane can fall below that, so a tablet gets the phone UI. Fix: Check the pane width at 820 with the sidebar open. Either fold the sidebar automatically in Tables on tablets, or lower NARROW_PANE to about 520 and keep the desktop toolbar with the folded labels. (src/components/tables/hooks.ts:28 (NARROW_PANE = 600); src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:77) | Round 4: NARROW_PANE lowered from 600 to 520, so the iPad 768 pane (about 595px) keeps the tablet toolbar. Checked by screenshot: it wraps cleanly.

items.title: View tabs overflow uses hard-coded widths
items.detail: The tab fitter reserves fixed 48px and 92px for '+' and 'N more'. Longer translations (Indonesian 'N lainnya') can overlap or clip, and tabs then jump as they move into 'more'. Fix: Measure the real widths of the more button and the add button (refs) instead of constants, and animate tabs moving into 'more' with a fade. (src/components/tables/ViewTabs.tsx:37 and :42) | Round 4: ViewTabs measures the real 'N more' width (hidden copy, translated) and the add button (ref) instead of the 48/92 constants. It also counts the current tab's chevron. Tabs fade in (tbTabIn), with a reduced-motion fallback.

items.title: Phone project list: avatar square touches the name, no gap
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct.

items.title: "Work with them again" pill: icon and text cramped, pill looks off next to the name
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct.

items.title: AI on Home cannot be used on phones
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct.

items.title: Mobile audit was not thorough enough: run a foolproof one (every screen, state, overlay)
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct.

items.title: Phone Chat: Catch up pill sits too close under the header; needs breathing room
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct.

items.title: Phone Tables: the spreadsheet grid truncates every column; default to a card list / gallery on phones (Airtable, Notion mobile)
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct: make it a gallery. Also question every view for phone friendliness.

items.title: Phone team page: lone floating Join button leaves dead space; People shown twice (tab + heading); pill highlight on tabs
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct (screenshot of Video editing). Join into the top bar or a bottom bar for non-members; drop the duplicate heading; underline/colour-only tabs.

items.title: Tapping a person avatar should open their profile card (role, email, local time, Message/Call) like Slack, not jump to the thread
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct. Applies everywhere a person appears (Chat, Mail, Tasks, Teams).

items.title: Feature-gap analysis per app vs its reference (Slack, Gmail, Todoist, Notion, Airtable, Google Calendar/Drive, 1Password, Read AI)
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct: analyze missing features we could add.

items.title: Disabled 'Set and open' looks like a third text field
items.detail: There is no visible primary action. People read it as an empty field. Fix: Show the button in the accent colour at 40% opacity, or keep it full colour and check the fields on tap. Keep the inputs on --surface-2 and the button visibly different. (src/mobile/misc.css:1116) Evidence: audit/mobile/vault/phone375__00-start.png: the button at y=438-482 has the same grey fill, radius and height as the two inputs above it

items.title: Top-bar search opens global search, not Vault search
items.detail: In 1Password the search field is always at the top of the list. Here, searching for a login lands in a palette that doesn't list logins. Fix: Always show .vp-search, or set the palette's scope chip to Vault when it's opened from /vault (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:339 (vault search only shown when shown.length > 8)) Evidence: phone375__02-Search-Vault.png shows chips 'All apps / People / Projects / Files / Notes' and results for people

items.title: Palette chips run off screen and are 32 px tall
items.detail: Each chip is under the 44 px tap height, and the cut-off 'Note' chip has no fade or scroll hint Fix: Give the chip row horizontal scroll with 16 px padding at both ends and min-height: var(--tap) as the hit area (palette-chips (global palette CSS)) Evidence: report.json: 'Notes' chip is off-screen, and the chips measure 91x32, 67x32, 75x32, 52x32 and 61x32

items.title: In-list search field is 36 px tall and its clear button 32 px
items.detail: Both are below the 44 px minimum in CLAUDE.md Fix: Set the search to 44 px tall and the clear button to a 44x44 hit area (src/mobile/misc.css:425 and :451) Evidence: height: 36px and .vp-clear 32x32

items.title: Copy actions on a row are hidden behind a swipe or long-press
items.detail: 1Password and Apple Passwords show copy on the row or one tap away. Here, copying a password from the list depends on a gesture nobody can see. Fix: Add a trailing 44 px Copy-password button on each row (accent colour), or a 'Copy' chip that shows on tap (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:705-722) Evidence: VaultPhoneRow renders only the tile, text and marks. Copy is reachable only through SwipeRow or useLongPress. | Round 4: VaultPhoneRow has a trailing 44px .vp-copy button in the accent colour that copies the password. It stops propagation so it doesn't open the row. CSS is in src/mobile/misc.css.

items.title: Two marks overlap with a negative margin
items.detail: The spacing between marks doesn't match the row's gap, so a row with two marks looks crammed Fix: Put the marks in a wrapper with gap: 4px and remove the negative margin (src/mobile/misc.css:509) Evidence: .vp-mark + .vp-mark { margin-left: -8px } on 16 px icons inside a row with gap 16 leaves an 8 px gap, while a single mark sits 16 px from the text

items.title: Empty state has no action and no way forward when creating is off
items.detail: In a sandbox, or with the server off, the screen asks you to add a login but offers no way to do it and doesn't say why Fix: When !usable, change the text to explain why (sandbox or offline). Otherwise show an 'Add a login' button inside the EmptyState. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:187, 353-358) Evidence: EmptyState says 'Add a client login' with no button. useCreateAction gets false when !usable, so there is no FAB either.

items.title: Passphrase fields have no show toggle, label or strength meter
items.detail: The passphrase can't be reset, and mistyping it twice blind is easy. 1Password shows a strength bar and an eye toggle. Fix: Add an eye button (44 px) inside the field, a strength bar under it, and 'Confirm passphrase' as the second placeholder (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:1141-1142) Evidence: Two placeholder-only inputs, 'Passphrase' and 'Once more' (phone375__00-start.png) | Round 4: VaultGate adds an eye toggle (44px .vg-eye) inside the passphrase field that shows or hides both fields, a 4-step strength meter (.vg-meter, role=meter), aria-labels, and the placeholder 'Confirm passphrase'. Indonesian added. Checked with headless screenshots at 375 and 1280.

items.title: 'How it works' repeats the intro paragraph
items.detail: It adds a tap and 4 lines without new information, and the ragged widths look unbalanced Fix: Put the new information in the fold (what happens if you forget it, and who can re-share), or remove the fold (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:1111 and 1132) Evidence: phone375__03-How-it-works.png: both paragraphs say the server never sees passwords and that there is no reset. The expanded block is 4 lines at a different width from the 3-line intro. | Round 4: The fold now gives new information instead of repeating the intro: if you forget it, nobody can open your logins, not even an admin, and anyone who still has a login can share it again after you set a new passphrase. Indonesian added.

items.title: Gate leaves the bottom half of the phone empty with content crowded at the top
items.detail: Top-aligning for the keyboard is fine, but the action is far from the thumb and the screen looks unbalanced Fix: Pin the button to the bottom above var(--kb) with 16 px padding, and keep the fields at the top (src/mobile/misc.css:348-351 (place-items: start center; padding 24px 16px)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: the content ends at y=482 of 812, leaving 330 px empty | Won't fix: The phone vault gate is top-aligned on purpose (an Apple Passwords pattern), so the keyboard never covers the field or its button. Pinning the button to the bottom would split it from the field once the keyboard opens.

items.title: No Face ID or biometric unlock; the passphrase is needed every session
items.detail: 1Password on iOS unlocks with Face ID. Typing a long passphrase on a phone every time is the biggest friction point. Fix: Offer a WebAuthn or passkey-wrapped key for unlocking after the first time (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:1111) Evidence: phoneText: 'opens it on this device until you close' | Left: Biometric unlock needs WebAuthn PRF or a passkey-wrapped copy of the private key, plus server storage for the wrapped key and enrolment UI. That is a crypto design change, not a UI fix.

items.title: Password generator has no options
items.detail: 1Password lets you set length, symbols and digits, or use memorable words, because many sites reject symbols. The small button is also under 44 px on a phone. Fix: Open a Sheet with a length slider, symbol and digit toggles, a memorable option and 'Use password'. Make the button at least var(--tap). (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:872, 989) Evidence: strongPassword always gives 20 characters from a fixed alphabet. The 'Generate' button is ghost-btn sm. | Round 4: strongPassword takes length, symbols and digits. After Generate, a fold opens with a length slider (8 to 40) and Numbers and Symbols checkboxes that regenerate the password. On phones the Generate and eye buttons are at least var(--tap).

items.title: Notes is a single-line input
items.detail: Backup codes take many lines, and in a one-line field they scroll sideways out of view Fix: Use an auto-growing textarea (min 3 rows) inside the grouped card (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:1003) Evidence: <input value={notes}> with the placeholder 'Backup codes, security questions...'

items.title: 2FA field's placeholder is cut off by an ellipsis
items.detail: The instruction is cut off before the part that matters, and there's no 'Scan QR code' option the way 1Password has Fix: Use a short placeholder ('Setup key or otpauth link'), put the explanation in a footer under the group, and add a Scan QR button (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:999; misc.css:731) Evidence: 'The key shown when you set up an authenticator app, or the otpauth:// link' in a field about 311 px wide at 16 px

items.title: Only one item type (Login)
items.detail: 1Password's + opens a category picker (Login, Secure Note, Card, Identity, API key, Wi-Fi). Teams store API keys and notes, which get squeezed into Login here. Fix: Turn + into a Sheet listing types, with Secure note and API credential at minimum (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:187) Evidence: useCreateAction only offers 'New login' | Left: More item types (Secure note, API credential, Card) need server and schema changes to vault items and new editors. That is beyond a fix pass.

items.title: No favourites, A-Z sections or sort in the phone list
items.detail: 1Password opens on Favourites and groups by letter, so with dozens of client logins scrolling becomes the only way to find one Fix: Add a Favourites group at the top (star in the action menu), and A-Z section headers 15/600 with sticky letters (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:677-686) Evidence: VaultPhoneList renders a flat list | Round 4: The phone list has A-Z section headers (.vp-letter, 15/600, sticky). Favourites are not done: they need a per-user flag on the server, which isn't in place.

items.title: Dark form cards use a hard-coded hex
items.detail: It breaks the rule of tokens only in tokens.css, ui-tokens-check should fail it, and it won't follow theme changes Fix: Use var(--surface) or a new --surface-group token (src/mobile/misc.css:700) Evidence: background: #1c1c1f | Round 4: The hard-coded #1c1c1f has moved to src/mobile/notes.css (.nl-search in dark). It now uses var(--surface-2).

items.title: 'Add a login' stays active while the Vault is locked on iPad
items.detail: There are two primary buttons on screen, and one leads to a dead end without a key Fix: Also disable it when !vaultUnlocked(me), or hide it until unlocked (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:82 (disabled only for !server.on or sandbox)) Evidence: ipad1024__01-Expand-sidebar-.png: the green 'Add a login' button is fully enabled above the passphrase card | Round 4: VaultSidebar's 'Add a login' is disabled while the Vault is locked. vaultCrypto.ts has new vaultAnyUnlocked and onVaultLockChange so the sidebar redraws when it locks or unlocks. A small polish.css rule dims .compose-btn:disabled. Screenshot confirms it at 1280.

items.title: iPad gate is a small card in a huge empty pane, and its disabled button is pale green
items.detail: The disabled state differs between sizes, and the pale green reads as broken (the code comment says so itself) Fix: Move the disabled-button rule out of the phone media query. On tablet, drop the card border and align the content to the top third. (src/mobile/misc.css:1116 (the grey fix is phone-only, in a max-width:767 query)) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: a 420 px card centred in a 595 px pane with about 330 px empty above and below. 'Set and open' is a washed green, while the phone's is grey.

items.title: Collapsed Vault sidebar on iPad 768 is icon-only with no labels
items.detail: Two rails side by side, one labelled and one not, and the lock icon isn't recognisable as 'Company logins' Fix: At 768 hide the Vault sidebar and use the title menu (as on phones), or show labels (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:78-113 (VaultSidebar, sb-label hidden when collapsed)) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: a second column of +, key and lock icons (36 px) with no text, next to an app rail that does have labels | Won't fix: The collapsed icon rail on tablets is the shell's shared behaviour for every app's sidebar (.sidebar.collapsed hides .sb-label, persisted as pm-sidebar-collapsed-tablet). The user can expand it. Changing it only for Vault would make it inconsistent with the other apps.

items.title: Sidebar note's shield icon renders as a stray dot
items.detail: It looks like a rendering bug, and 13 px is off the 16/20/24 icon scale Fix: Make the icon 16 px and align it to the first line with flex and align-items:flex-start, or drop it (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:109-111 (ShieldCheck size 13 inside .sb-note)) Evidence: ipad1024__01-Expand-sidebar-.png: at x=113, y=214 there is a tiny dot instead of the ShieldCheck icon, and the text hangs-indents beside it | Round 4: polish.css: .vault-note svg { flex: none; margin-top: 1px }. The icon was being squeezed to 5px wide, so it rendered as a dot. Screenshot confirms the shield now shows at 16px.

items.title: Phone Home is a near-empty list: 60% of the first screen is blank white
items.detail: Google Workspace home and iOS widgets fill the first screen with glanceable cards (next meeting, recent files, tasks, mail). Here the phone drops every widget the iPad shows (Workload, Briefs, Projects at risk, Teams, my tasks, mail) Fix: Render the user's chosen widgets on phones as compact stacked cards (or a 2-column widget grid at 430) below Today: My tasks, Recent mail, Recent files, Workload (src/components/HomeView.tsx:853-940 (phone branch renders only greeting, Today, two rows)) Evidence: audit/mobile/home/phone375__00-start.png: content ends at y=340, FAB at 676-732, nothing between. Measured blocks: home-greet 52-88, htoday 96-196, home-rows 212-340 | Won't fix: A later decision changed phone Home. It is now the launcher: greeting, summary, search pill and app grid. The phone home list (home-phone) is meant to be one plain list with nothing empty. Dashboard widget cards are desktop only, per the comment in HomeView.tsx.

items.title: No Customise on phone at all
items.detail: iOS lets you long-press Home to edit widgets; Google lets you reorder/hide cards. Phone users cannot choose what Home shows Fix: Add an Edit item to the TopBar title menu (useTitleMenu) opening a Sheet with toggle + drag-handle rows per widget (src/components/HomeView.tsx:957-975 (Customise only in desktop branch); src/mobile/home.css:12-15 hides .home-head) Evidence: phone375 start has only Apps, Search, Calendar, two rows, FAB; ipad768__00-start.png shows 'Customise' top right. Long-press/contextmenu on a row did nothing (audit/agents/home-ctx.png) | Won't fix: Phones show no widget cards, so there is nothing to customise. The app grid on the phone launcher has its own 'Ubah' (Edit).

items.title: No visible Ask AI / search field on phone Home
items.detail: Google app and Workspace put a big search/ask field at the top of Home; asking AI from Home takes a hidden icon tap here and the search screen gives no hint AI is available (placeholder just 'Search') Fix: Keep .home-search on phones as a 48px pill under the greeting, placeholder 'Search or ask AI' (src/mobile/home.css:12-15) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png has only a magnifier icon; iPad shows 'Jump to a project, task, person or file, or ask anything' bar. .home-search is display:none on phones

items.title: Dark mode never rendered on phone; dark capture is identical to light
items.detail: Bar item 8 requires both themes; Home in dark cannot be judged and system dark is ignored when the stored theme is 'light' Fix: Default theme to 'system' and let the dark media query apply; re-run audit in dark (theme setting applied on html[data-theme] overrides prefers-color-scheme (src/tokens.css dark block guarded by data-theme)) Evidence: audit/mobile/home/phone375dark__00-start.png is white; with colorScheme:'dark' html data-theme='light', body bg rgb(255,255,255) (audit/agents/home-tasks.mjs output)

items.title: Summary line crams name, date, status and next event into one wrapped grey paragraph
items.detail: Mixed weights and colours read as noise; 'Next: Badminton' repeats the Today section directly below Fix: Line 1: date (13 text-3). Drop the 'Next:' clause when Today is shown; status only when something needs you (src/components/HomeView.tsx:862-867; src/mobile/home.css:34-49) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png y=52-88: 'James, Thursday 15 October. Nothing needs you right now. Next: Badminton at 18:30.' wraps to 2 lines, bold name, grey date, darker sentence, three colours in one line

items.title: Greeting title only 8px above summary and tight against launcher icon
items.detail: Header block lacks breathing room; on the 4/8 scale it should be 4 between title and sub, 16 before first section Fix: padding: 4px 16px 0; margin-bottom: 16px (src/mobile/home.css:30-33) Evidence: title baseline ~y=36, summary starts y=52; .home-greet margin-bottom 8 then Today header at 24 pad: rhythm 0/8/24 uneven

items.title: Today section has no visual container or divider and floats; uneven gap to rows below
items.detail: Uneven vertical rhythm makes 'Finish setting up' look like part of Today Fix: Give home-rows a 24px section header ('More' or none) and use the same 24 top as .hsec; or put a 1px divider (src/mobile/home.css:131-141 and 297-300 (.home-rows margin-top 16 on top of 12 row padding)) Evidence: Badminton row ends y=196, next row starts 212+12 padding (=40px visual gap) while Today header to row is 8px

items.title: Event row: time and title not aligned with icon rows below; title 19px tap target
items.detail: Only the 19px text is tappable, not the 48px row; left text edges differ by 4px Fix: Make the whole .htd-ev the button (min-height var(--row-1)), time column width 40 + gap 12 so text lands at x=68 (src/mobile/home.css:227-236) Evidence: report.json: small-tap-target 287x19 'Badminton' (button.htd-ev-title); title starts x=72 vs row text x=68

items.title: Event row has no context: no colour, location, duration or join
items.detail: iOS Up Next widget and Google Calendar card show end time, calendar colour dot and place Fix: Add calendar colour bar and '18:30-19:30 · place' secondary line, making it a 64 two-line row (src/components/HomeView.tsx TodayBlock (htd-ev render)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: '18:30 Badminton' only | Round 4: TodayBlock event rows (src/components/home/HomeParts.tsx) now have a second line with the time range and the place, for example '18:30-20:00 · place'. On phones the row is 64px and two lines high (src/mobile/home.css). On desktop the line uses .htd-ev-sub (src/home.css). The calendar colour bar was not added.

items.title: Finish setting up opens a tiny sheet with a box inside a box
items.detail: Violates 'no box inside a box', off-scale radius 14 and padding 10/14, row edge not on 16 gutter Fix: In .home-setup-sheet reset .setup-card ul background/radius and li padding to 12px 16px (src/polish.css:3731-3760 (.setup-card ul background surface-2, radius 14, li padding 10px 14px); src/mobile/home.css:353-360 only clears the section) Evidence: phone375__05-Finish-setting-up-1-left-Plan.png: grey rounded tile (surface-2, radius 14) inside the sheet, 10px 14px padding, 4px from sheet edges

items.title: Setup row's action 'Set up' is grey text and the empty radio looks tappable
items.detail: Primary action not distinguished; the circle suggests a checkbox that does nothing Fix: Use accent-text for Set up (or primary pill), replace the ring with the step icon (src/polish.css:3765-3790 (.setup-mark); src/components/HomeView.tsx:801) Evidence: phone375__05: 'Set up' at x=305 in text colour, faint 20px circle at x=28 | Round 4: Took the empty .setup-mark ring out of the setup rows in HomeView.tsx, since only unfinished steps are listed. 'Set up' now has the class .setup-go and uses var(--accent-text) (src/home.css).

items.title: Setup sheet title sits only 12px from its first row and row hugs sheet bottom without safe area
items.detail: No bottom inset for home indicator Fix: padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) (src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx sheet-body padding; src/mobile/home.css:353) Evidence: phone375__05: title y=712, row 736-800, sheet ends 812 with 12px

items.title: New sheet: 'Note' row shows stuck pressed background, no safe-area under Upload
items.detail: Sticky hover on touch looks like a selection; last row clipped near home indicator Fix: Wrap hover in @media (hover:hover); add safe-area padding (create sheet row :hover style in src/mobile/shell.css (hover applied on touch)) Evidence: phone375__07-New.png: Note row grey fill y=704-752 without tap; Upload text at y=776, sheet edge 812

items.title: New sheet items lack the secondary lines only Brain dump has; inconsistent row heights
items.detail: Unbalanced list; Google's + sheet uses uniform rows with icons in a grid Fix: Either all one-line or a 3-column icon grid for Email/Message/Task/Event/Note/Upload with Brain dump as a wide top tile (create action list (useCreateAction items) src/mobile/chrome.ts) Evidence: phone375__07: Brain dump 64px two-line, others 48px one-line | Round 4: New sheet (src/App.tsx): dropped the Brain dump hint line, so every row is a uniform one-line as-item.

items.title: Search: back button grey circle crowds the field and the left gutter
items.detail: Back sits 4px from screen edge instead of 16 gutter-aligned icon; no gap to input Fix: Transparent back button, margin-left 4 so icon centres at x=28, gap 8 to input; input in a filled pill (src/mobile/shell.css:904-910 (.palette-back)) Evidence: phone375__02-Search-Home.png: grey circle x=4-48, 'Search' text starts x=52, 4px from circle

items.title: Search chips are 32px tall and the last one is cut with no fade
items.detail: Below 44 tap rule; hard cut reads as clipping Fix: min-height 36 with 44 hit area via padding-block, add mask-image fade on right edge (src/mobile/shell.css:1078-1120 (.palette-chips button height)) Evidence: report.json small-tap-target 91x32 'All apps', 67x32 'People' etc; off-screen 'Notes' cut at x=375

items.title: Search results use generic person glyph instead of avatars
items.detail: CLAUDE.md requires PersonCell; avatars elsewhere (EB, TR) so recognition breaks Fix: Render people with PersonCell 32 avatars (palette results renderer (src/components/CommandPalette or Palette.tsx) not using PersonCell) Evidence: phone375__02: Ethan Brooks, Thomas Reyes with outline person icon

items.title: Search opens with no recents, no AI suggestion, no keyboard hint
items.detail: Google search on phone shows recent searches/files and suggested questions Fix: Show Recent (last 5 opened items) and 'Ask AI: ...' suggestions in empty state (palette empty state) Evidence: phone375__02: only 2 People rows, rest blank

items.title: Notifications: badge overlaps avatar edge and filter pill is not full-width
items.detail: Badge collides; segmented control off balance Fix: Badge inset -2px with 2px bg ring inside avatar box; segmented width 100% on phones (src/mobile notifications css (.nt-icon badge) and .segmented width) Evidence: phone375__06: green badge at avatar bottom-right overlapping text column by ~2px; segmented ends x=216 leaving right empty

items.title: Notifications has no Mark all read or actions for the one row
items.detail: Google/iOS give clear all and swipe actions Fix: TopBarButton 'Mark all read'; SwipeRow on rows (notifications screen TopBar (no TopBarButton)) Evidence: phone375__06: header only back + title

items.title: iPad: empty cards (Projects at risk, Teams, Briefs) take more space than content
items.detail: Home should answer what to do now; empty widgets are noise Fix: Collapse empty widgets into one 'All clear' line or hide them; drop 'You're clear' card when Today shows (src/components/HomeView.tsx:420-700 widget bodies with empty()) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: three cards of 105px each with only a one-line empty message; 'You're clear for now' card repeats the next event | Round 4: The risk, lateByTeam and briefs cards now set show to false when they are empty, unless you are customising. The 'You're clear for now' section is hidden when Today already shows what is next. Checked on a 1024 screenshot (audit/agents/home-r4-ipad.png).

items.title: iPad: unbalanced columns and inconsistent link styles
items.detail: Bar items 5 and 7: one link style, balanced columns Fix: align-items:start with masonry order or span Workload full width; one .link-btn style without underline (src/home.css:26 and widget headers in HomeView.tsx) Evidence: ipad1024__00-start.png: Workload card ~180px vs Briefs ~105px; 'Calendar' underlined vs 'All briefs →' not underlined; setup row a grey box with radius different from cards | Round 4: Removed the underline from .hsec-h .link-btn (src/home.css), so 'Calendar' looks like the cards' links. Hiding the empty cards also evens out the columns.

items.title: iPad: Customise button not aligned with the title baseline
items.detail: Floats awkwardly at top right Fix: align-items:flex-end on .home-head so it sits on the greeting baseline (src/components/HomeView.tsx:959-970 .home-head) Evidence: ipad1024__00: Customise at y=47 aligns to date line, title at y=74 | Round 4: .home-head .customise-btn now uses align-self:flex-end, so it sits on the greeting's baseline (src/home.css). Checked on the 1024 screenshot.

items.title: Console 429 Too Many Requests on Home load
items.detail: Something refetches aggressively; may leave widgets empty Fix: Dedupe/cached fetch; find the endpoint in network log (Home data fetches on mount in src/components/HomeView.tsx) Evidence: report.json consoleErrors at every size: 'status of 429' | Round 4: Traced the 429s to /api/ai/todos from the mail to-do scan in App.tsx. It kept calling for every thread after a failure. Now the first failure stops the loop and releases the rest of the batch so the next scan retries it.

items.title: Search pill jammed 4px under the top bar
items.detail: Off the 8px rhythm and reads as cramped; Gmail iOS gives the search pill clear air above. Fix: margin: 8px 16px 8px (or 12px top), keeping 8px below. (src/mobile/mail.css:2761 (margin: 4px 16px 8px)) Evidence: report.json tight-under-header 4px on every list state; phone375__00-start.png search pill top edge almost touches 'Inbox' bar

items.title: Search screen field glued to the status area with no top padding
items.detail: No top inset at all; looks clipped under the notch on a real phone. Fix: When search is active give the header padding-top 8px plus safe-area-inset-top, 12px between field and chips. (src/mobile/mail.css:2757-2771 (same .gm-search-row margin reused when search is active)) Evidence: phone375__04-Search-in-mail.png: search field starts at y~4, filter chips row right under it

items.title: Compose FAB icon touching its label
items.detail: Icon and word read as one blob; Gmail's extended FAB has 12px between pencil and label. Fix: Set gap: 12px on .fab.extended (keep 0 only for icon-only FAB). (src/mobile/shell.css:688 (gap: 0) with .fab.extended at :708 not restoring a gap) Evidence: report.json touching: 0px between svg and 'Compose' on every state; phone375__00-start.png

items.title: Label pill crushes the subject in list rows
items.detail: Subject is the most important text; the tag wins the space. Gmail iOS shows labels only in the thread, not in the subject line. Fix: Cap tag at ~96px or move it to line 3 after the snippet / drop it on phones under 400px. (src/mobile/mail.css:302 (.gm-tag max-width: 40%)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png row 1: subject truncates to 'Founder intro: subscription...' because 'Lereng Coffee' pill takes up to 40% of width

items.title: Unread rows indistinguishable from read rows in light mode
items.detail: Gmail iOS makes unread bold and the date dark plus a clear contrast; here scanning for new mail is impossible. Fix: Use 700 on name and subject for unread, 400 text-2 for read, plus the accent unread dot the system already allows. (src/mobile/mail.css:238-276 (.unread only weight 600 on name/subject, no dot)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: all sender names same weight; in mx-dark.png subjects turn bold, so unread styling is inconsistent across states

items.title: Reader tags misaligned: Lereng Coffee and Assign sit on different baselines, 20px tall
items.detail: Uneven pills right under the heading and tap targets less than half of 44px. Fix: Move tags out of the h2 into their own flex row (align-items:center, gap 8, margin-top 8) with 32px pills inside 44px hit areas. (src/mobile/mail.css:906-916 (.gm-subject .gm-tag vertical-align:4px; .gm-tag-btn min-height 20px) vs .gm-who :923) Evidence: phone375__05: 'Lereng Coffee' at y~179, 'Assign' at y~175; report small-tap-target 115x20 and 74x20

items.title: Sender name / time in message header is a 19px tap target
items.detail: Below the 44px rule in CLAUDE.md; easy to mis-tap the reply arrow next to it. Fix: Give the header a 44px hit area (padding or ::after inset) and .gm-msg-to min-height var(--tap). (src/mobile/mail.css:1082-1110 (.gm-msg-name no min-height; .gm-msg-to min-height 32px)) Evidence: report small-tap-target 195x19 'Claire Utami 10 hours ago', 55x32 'to me' | Round 4: mail.css: .gm-msg-to now has min-height var(--tap) with -10px margins, so the layout is unchanged and the box measures 195x44. .gm-msg-name has a ::after that extends its hit area

items.title: Smart replies stack vertically and eat a third of the screen
items.detail: Gmail iOS shows smart replies as one horizontally scrollable row; stacked pills push the content and look like a form. Fix: flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; scroll-padding 16px, with the same edge fade used in .gm-chips. (src/mobile/mail.css:1335-1339 (.gm-smart flex-wrap: wrap)) Evidence: phone375__05 and audit/agents/mx-reader-bottom.png: 3 suggestions + Suggest replies occupy y 565-735 as 4 rows | Won't fix: A later round chose to let smart replies wrap on phones (mail.css comment: 'wrap instead of running off the edge'), so a horizontal scroller would go against that decision.

items.title: Reply all missing from the docked reply bar
items.detail: Gmail iOS shows Reply, Reply all, Forward; here Reply all needs the overflow menu. Fix: Render Reply all pill when the thread has more than one recipient; use .gm-round icon-only form to fit 375. (src/mobile/mail.css:1374 comment vs dock render (gm-dock-row); QuickReply.tsx:50 supports all) Evidence: mx-reader-bottom.png dock buttons measured: ['Reply:91x44','Forward:106x44'] only; CSS comment promises Reply all

items.title: Dock pills unbalanced: Comment shoved to the far right
items.detail: Three equal actions look like two groups; uneven gaps. Fix: Drop margin-left:auto; use equal flex:1 pills or keep 8px gaps from the left. (src/mobile/mail.css:1430-1431 (.gm-comment margin-left:auto)) Evidence: phone375__05: Reply and Forward left, 22px gap, Comment pinned right with a ~20px hole

items.title: Dock pill label at caption size (12-13px)
items.detail: Primary reply actions in caption type feel weak; Gmail uses 15px. Fix: font: var(--t-segment) or 15/600. (src/mobile/mail.css:1403 (.gm-pill font-size var(--fs-caption))) Evidence: phone375__05 Reply/Forward/Comment text visibly smaller than body | Round 4: mail.css: dock .gm-pill labels go from caption (12px) to --fs-secondary (13px). 15px would overflow 375px when Reply all is shown

items.title: Compose field values do not line up: To at 72px, Subject at 83px
items.detail: Ragged left edge on the main form; comment at :1579 promises every value from 72. Fix: Label width: auto with min-width 56px and margin-right 12px, or Gmail style 'To', 'Cc/Bcc', 'Subject' with one shared column measured for the longest label. (src/mobile/mail.css:1590-1596 (label width:56px, 'Subject' is wider so it overflows)) Evidence: phone375__30-Compose.png: 'Name or email' starts x~72, 'Subject' placeholder x~83, From value x~73 at a smaller size

items.title: From value smaller than its label and other values
items.detail: Breaks the 16px field rule and looks like a different component. Fix: font: var(--t-body) / font-size var(--fs-field) on .from-field .sel; show just the address like Gmail. (src/mobile/mail.css:1620-1628 (.from-field .sel inherits Select's small font)) Evidence: phone375__30: 'James <james@...>' renders ~13px while To/Subject are 16px

items.title: Compose lacks Cc/Bcc toggle and body hint
items.detail: Gmail iOS shows 'Compose email' placeholder and clear Cc/Bcc expand; here the body looks empty and non-editable. Fix: Add body placeholder above the signature with 16px gap; label the chevron 'Cc/Bcc'. (src/components/mail/QuickReply.tsx / compose phone markup; src/mobile/mail.css:1580) Evidence: phone375__30: only a chevron at the end of To; body has no 'Compose email' placeholder, signature floats with no cursor area | Round 4: Compose.tsx: the phone Cc/Bcc toggle shows the text 'Cc/Bcc' instead of a bare chevron, styled with t-segment in mail.css. The 'Compose email' body placeholder already exists

items.title: Select mode drops all bulk actions except archive/delete/read
items.detail: Gmail iOS selection bar has archive, delete, mark read, and overflow with move/snooze/label; here they are hidden or missing. Fix: Keep the ⋮ menu in select mode with Move to, Snooze, Label, Star, Mute. (src/mobile/mail.css:125-141 (.gm-selall) and select bar in list pane) Evidence: phone375__06-Select.png: top bar shows only archive, delete, mail; no snooze/move/label/star visible

items.title: Select all row floats with a 74px indent and no divider
items.detail: Looks like a stray list row; Gmail puts the count and select-all in the bar. Fix: Move select-all into the top bar overflow, or give the row 8px bottom padding and a divider. (src/mobile/mail.css:125-145) Evidence: phone375__06: circle at x 39, 'Select all' at x 74, row hugs the first selected row with no gap

items.title: Dark mode Compose FAB is washed-out with low-contrast white text

(src/tokens.css:159 (dark --accent mixes 74% brand with #f2f2f2) used by src/mobile/shell.css:692) Evidence: audit/agents/mx-dark.png: FAB fill pale grey-green, white 'Compose' around 2.5:1

items.title: phone375dark audit screenshot is actually light; dark untested
items.detail: Users with system dark but no saved setting may get light; audit coverage gap. Fix: Respect prefers-color-scheme when the setting is 'system' and make the audit set it. (theme init reads stored preference over prefers-color-scheme (src theme bootstrap)) Evidence: audit/mobile/mail/phone375dark__00-start.png renders light theme; only forcing data-theme=dark (mx-dark.png) showed dark

items.title: Attachment card wastes width and truncates the filename
items.detail: Gmail shows a full-width file row when there is one attachment. Fix: Single attachment: full-width row (icon, name, size) 56px tall; keep cards for multiple. (src/mobile/mail.css:1227 (.gm-att fixed width)) Evidence: mx-reader-bottom.png: card 147px wide, 'Rimba-board...' cut while 200px empty to the right | Round 4: mail.css: a single attachment (.gm-att:only-child) is now a full-width 56px row with the preview and the full filename. items.title: iPad list star overlaps the preview text

(src/mobile/mail.css:934-940 (.gm-star margin-right -12px) with snippet not reserving space) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: Shopify row 'withi★' star on top of snippet; stars sit at different y per row | Round 4: mail.css (min-width 768): the row's last line (snippet or meta) reserves 28px on the right so the absolute star no longer covers the text. Checked in a 768px screenshot

items.title: iPad 768 has two icon rails eating 160px and no reading pane
items.detail: Unlabeled folder icons (coloured dots, shields) are guesswork; Gmail iPad uses one drawer and a list+reader split in landscape. Fix: Hide folder rail behind the hamburger at 768; split list/reader at 1024. (src/mobile/mail.css folder rail / sidebar collapsed layout) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: app rail (0-85) plus unlabeled folder rail (95-150); list fills remainder, thread opens full | Left: At 768px the iPad uses the desktop shell: the app rail plus the collapsed mail sidebar. Hiding the folder rail behind a hamburger, or splitting into list and reader at 1024px, changes the shared shell layout (App.tsx/shell.css) that other agents are editing now. It needs a shell-level decision.

items.title: Drawer is longer than the screen with no grouping header
items.detail: Gmail groups 'All labels' with headers; here a flat long list. Fix: Add section headers (15/600) and collapse less-used folders under 'More'. (Sidebar.tsx PhoneMailDrawer; src/mobile/mail.css drawer rows 44px) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png: 15 items, 'All mail' cut at bottom; no labels section visible without scroll; 'Assigned to me' mixed into category block

items.title: Grouped cards are invisible on sub-screens: --bg and --surface are both #fff, so rows float on white with no card edge
items.detail: The comment promises 'grouped rows on the grouped grey', but white on white gives no grouping. Two visual languages appear in one app: bordered cards on root/Account, bare rows on set-block screens Fix: Pick one pattern. Either give .settings-push .set-block > :not(h3) the same 1px border and radius 16 as the root .g-group, or set the push-body to a grouped grey token (light only) as iOS does (src/mobile/settings.css:89-94 and 126-128 (push-body bg var(--bg), set-block children bg var(--surface)); src/tokens.css:44-45) Evidence: audit/mobile/settings/phone375__04-Notifications.png, phone375__13-Permissions.png, phone375__10-Mail-storage.png: toggle lists have no card outline or grey ground, while root and Account show bordered cards

items.title: Section headers sit at x=32 while the intro paragraph and cards sit at x=16: three left edges per screen
items.detail: Nothing lines up; the eye sees a staircase. iOS insets headers to the row text, and the rows here are not inset into a card, so the indent looks random Fix: When rows sit in a visible card, keep h3 at 16px inside the card text inset (card x16 + 16 = 32) and indent the intro the same; otherwise drop h3 margin to 0 (src/mobile/settings.css:123-125 (.set-block > h3 margin 0 16px) combined with 105-110 (.set-intro margin 0)) Evidence: phone375__04-Notifications.png: intro text x=16, 'This device' and 'What to send' x=32, rows x=32, divider line runs to x=359; phone375__07-Mail-signature.png: 'Signatures' x=32 but card x=16

items.title: Root title 'Settings' only 4px from the launcher icon
items.detail: The 24/700 title crowds the grid icon; the 16px gutter on the right (search at 327) is not mirrored on the left Fix: Give .mobile-top a gap of 8px (or margin-left 8px on .mt-title after .mt-launch) so title starts at 56 with 16px optical gap (src/mobile/shell.css:266-270 (.mobile-top gap: 0) and 339-343 (.mt-title)) Evidence: report.json: touching 0px between 'Apps' and 'Settings' on every phone state; measured mt-launch x=4 w=44 (ends 48), mt-title x=48, text at x=52

items.title: Profile card truncates the email to 'james@demo.sprint2go.c...'
items.detail: The one identifying line is clipped; Slack/Linear show full email or wrap to 2 lines Fix: Allow two lines (-webkit-line-clamp: 2, word-break: break-all) or drop to 13px secondary size (src/mobile/settings.css:70-76 (.set-account-text small nowrap ellipsis)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: email cut at 375 with 56px avatar and chevron eating width

items.title: Phone dark mode not shown: OS dark still renders light because Appearance is pinned to Light
items.detail: The audit cannot verify dark mode, and a fresh user on a dark phone gets a white app; iOS apps default to Match system Fix: Default theme to 'Match system' for new accounts and in the demo seed; rerun dark audit with theme reset (src/components/SettingsPage.tsx around the theme picker (Appearance 'Light' stored per user)) Evidence: phone375dark__00-start.png identical to phone375__00-start.png; audit/agents/set-root-full.png with colorScheme dark also light

items.title: Switches are 51x32, below the 44px tap target
items.detail: Bar rule 6 requires 44px; on Permissions the whole row is not a label so only the switch is hit Fix: Keep the visual 51x31 but add ::before hit area inset -6px, or make every toggle row a <label> so the full 64px row toggles (src/mobile/settings.css:162-165) Evidence: report.json small-tap-target 51x32 'switch on' on 04, 05, 08, 09

items.title: Notifications: primary button is a heavy shadowed pill, centered, not aligned with anything
items.detail: Unbalanced: neither full-width nor aligned to the text column; drop shadow is not used elsewhere in settings Fix: Make it full width within the card (x16-359) under the explanation, no shadow, 48px tall (src/components/NotificationSettings.tsx:156-162 (.push-actions primary-btn); styles for .push-actions in src/mobile/settings.css) Evidence: phone375__04-Notifications.png: 'Turn on notifications on this device' button x=64-343, glow shadow, while the icon tile and text start at x=32

items.title: Notifications lacks per-channel and schedule controls that Slack/Linear iOS have
items.detail: Slack iOS offers schedule, pause notifications, keywords, sounds; Linear offers push vs email per category. Here a person cannot quiet nights Fix: Add 'Pause notifications' (1h, until tomorrow), 'Quiet hours' range with TimePicker, and Push/Email split per category (src/components/NotificationSettings.tsx) Evidence: phone375__04-Notifications.png: only on/off per category; no Do Not Disturb hours, no snooze, no sound, no email digest frequency, no per-project override | Left: Pause notifications and quiet hours have to be enforced where push and email are sent (server push and digest code), not just stored by the settings screen. A per-category push/email split also needs a server-side model change. The email digest frequency already exists. This needs its own server-side task.

items.title: Mailbox access: empty state is centered text with a stray half-width divider
items.detail: Centered prose in a left-aligned list, a divider that starts nowhere, and duplicated copy Fix: Drop the EmptyState inside the group; show 'Only you' as a row value and keep one footer (src/components/mail/MailAccess.tsx:151 (EmptyState compact inside list) and mobile/mail.css:2571-2577) Evidence: phone375__08-Mailbox-access.png: 'Only you. Give a teammate access...' centered y=185-210, divider from x=85 to 359 under it, then the same sentence repeated in the footer at y=300

items.title: Mailbox access: Forwarding field plus a 52x32 'Add' chip instead of an iOS row
items.detail: Inline form on a settings list; Slack/iOS use an 'Add address' row that pushes an edit screen Fix: Replace with GRow '+ Add forwarding address' opening an EditScreen with the field and Save in the top bar (src/mobile/mail.css:2428-2431 and 2639 (.mx-add-address)) Evidence: phone375__08-Mailbox-access.png: grey field x=32-278 with 'Add' pill 52x32 next to it; report.json small-tap-target 52x32 | Round 4: mail.css: the forwarding Add button in settings-push is a full 44px target. The inline field is kept as a one-field form

items.title: Mailbox access: 'Mailbox' value floats centered-right on its own row with no label alignment
items.detail: Label and value split into two lines with an odd indent; reads as broken Fix: Use one GRow: label 'Mailbox', value right-aligned truncated, chevron (src/mobile/mail.css:2657 (.set-row:not(.mx-switch) > .sel)) Evidence: phone375__08-Mailbox-access.png: 'Mailbox' label y=439, value 'james@rimbagroup.example' on the next line at x=108, chevron at 330

items.title: Mail storage: 'Empty Spam' / 'Empty Trash' outline buttons inside list rows
items.detail: Box inside a box (bar rule 5) and destructive actions offered for already-empty folders Fix: Show size as row value; put 'Empty Spam' as a red text row only when non-empty, confirm with ActionSheet (src/components/mail/MailStorage.tsx:98) Evidence: phone375__10-Mail-storage.png: 106x44 bordered pill buttons at right of Spam and Trash rows that both show 'Empty'

items.title: Mail storage: clean-up list uses checkboxes in a flat table instead of swipe-to-delete cards
items.detail: Desktop table pattern; iOS storage screens use rows with swipe and a 'Select' mode Fix: Use SwipeRow with Delete, plus a top-bar 'Select' for bulk (src/components/mail/MailStorage.tsx (clean up list)) Evidence: phone375__10-Mail-storage.png: checkbox at x=40, size column at x=303, wrapped subject 'Supplements brand:' clipped at bottom | Won't fix: The clean-up list's job is picking several large emails to delete at once. Checkboxes fit that better than per-row swipes, and swipe-to-delete would add an irreversible gesture to a storage screen.

items.title: Teams screen says the same thing twice and wastes 60% of the screen
items.detail: Copy rule: screens answer what to do; duplicated explanation is noise Fix: Drop the intro on phone; keep a one-line footer (src/components/admin/AdminMore.tsx:410 and 413) Evidence: phone375__12-Teams.png: intro paragraph (4 lines) and footer (3 lines) repeat 'make teams, add people, set who can join'; content ends at y=380

items.title: Teams list dividers start at inconsistent x
items.detail: Dividers should start at the text (1px rule from text), all at 57 Fix: Give .g-row.has-dot and plainIcon rows the same leading slot width (24) so text and dividers start at the same x (src/components/admin/AdminMore.tsx:416-419 (g-dot pic vs plainIcon GRow); src/mobile/grouped.css .has-dot) Evidence: phone375__12-Teams.png: divider under 'Growth' starts x=57, under 'Web & systems' x=80, last row 'Open Teams' with icon at x=42 not aligned to dots at x=38

items.title: Client portal & brand: a single wrapping toggle and a link, then 600px of white
items.detail: Users expect to set logo, colour, portal URL and see a preview; this is a dead end that pushes them to Plan & billing Fix: Show the brand fields disabled with a lock and an 'Unlock with add-on' row; shorten label to 'Use our brand' (src/components/admin/AgencySection.tsx:57) Evidence: phone375__15-Client-portal-brand.png: toggle row label wraps to 2 lines ('Show our brand instead of / sprint2go'), footer link, nothing else; no preview of logo/colour | Round 4: AgencySection.tsx: the switch label is now 'Use our brand' (id: 'Pakai brand kami'), so it no longer wraps. The brand fields already fold open under it (name, logo, colour, address).

items.title: Appearance: accent link and density sit loose; half the screen empty and no text size option
items.detail: 18px tall link is untappable; Slack iOS Appearance has text size and display options Fix: Make accent a GRow with colour dot + chevron to Workspace brand; add Text size row (src/components/SettingsPage.tsx:717) Evidence: phone375__05-Appearance-Light.png: content ends y=490; 'Change it in Workspace' link 147x18 tap target (report.json); no text size, no app icon, no 'reduce motion' | Round 4: The 18px 'Change it in Workspace' link is now a full .accent-row button (56px min height) with a colour dot, a hint line and a chevron, styled for both themes with reduced-motion handling. Checked at 375 and 768. No text-size option was added: density and browser/OS text size cover that.

items.title: Account: avatar + 'Photo and colour' row duplicates the profile card and intro misaligns
items.detail: Linear/Slack put a large centered avatar with 'Edit' under it at top of profile; here it is a small list row Fix: Centered 80px avatar with 'Edit photo' link, then name/title rows; align 'Security' header with card text (src/components/SettingsPhone.tsx:239) Evidence: phone375__03-JC-James-Carter-james-demo-spr.png: intro 'How you appear...' x=16, 'Security' header x=32, cards x=16; Photo row 40px avatar only 12px from label | Round 4: AccountPhone's 40px 'Photo and colour' row is now a centred 80px avatar with 'Edit photo' under it (.acct-hero). Headers in .settings-push .set-rows .g-head were at 32px and now sit at 20px, matching the root list, so 'Security' no longer steps in. Checked at 375.

items.title: Root list is 25+ rows long with no Sign out at the bottom
items.detail: Slack and Linear end settings with Sign out and app version; here sign out is hidden behind Account > Security Fix: Add a final group with 'Sign out' (red) and a version footer (src/components/SettingsPhone.tsx (root groups)) Evidence: Root DOM text (audit/agents/set1.mjs output): sections You, Rimba Group, Work, Email, Plan and data, Support, Developer; no 'Sign out' or version line | Round 4: The phone root list ends with a Sign out group (red GRow calling sync.signOut, shown only when server.on) and a '<product> version 0.1.0' footer. Checked at 375.

items.title: Admin settings (Email delivery, Groups, Retention, Import, Developer) shown at the same level as personal ones
items.detail: Linear iOS puts workspace admin behind one 'Workspace' row; long admin list buries what a person changes daily Fix: Collapse workspace groups into one 'Rimba Group settings' push screen (src/components/SettingsPhone.tsx root groups) Evidence: Root list has 18 workspace rows vs 7 personal; most are desktop admin tasks | Won't fix: The phone root list now groups workspace rows under the company name with 'Work', 'Email' and 'Plan and data' headers. Settings search also finds any row. Keeping them flat matches the desktop side nav. Hiding them behind one extra push screen would add a tap to every admin task and break this parity.

items.title: Search palette chips 32px tall and 'Notes' chip runs off-screen with no fade
items.detail: Below 44px target and cut chip looks broken Fix: Chips 36 visual with 44 hit area, horizontal scroll with 16px end padding and edge fade (palette chips styles (.palette-chips button) in src/mobile/misc.css) Evidence: report.json state 02: chips 91x32, 67x32, 75x32, 52x32, 61x32; 'Notes' off-screen

items.title: Search opens global app search, not a settings search
items.detail: iOS Settings and Slack filter settings rows in place; finding 'Two-step sign-in' here needs digging Fix: Make the settings search filter the root list rows (and sub rows) inline (src/components/SettingsPhone.tsx top bar search action) Evidence: phone375__02-Search-Settings.png: chips 'All apps, People, Projects, Files, Notes'; no Settings scope

items.title: iPad 768: settings nav clips labels and puts workspace above personal settings
items.detail: Order is the reverse of phone; truncation and no headers make the nav hard to scan Fix: Nav width 240 with wrap or ellipsis+title; order You first with headers 'You', workspace name; swatches grid to 7 per row (src/mobile/settings.css:22 (.settings-nav width) and SettingsPage.tsx nav order) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: 'Groups & shared inbo' cut at x=278, 'Mail retention & rules' touching edge; Account/Appearance start at y=731 below 16 admin rows; no group headers; avatar colour swatches wrap leaving one orphan dot | Round 4: The side nav now lists your own settings first (stable sort, Company group last). Group headers were collapsed to height 0 by flex shrink and now show. Long names end in an ellipsis with a title tooltip, and the nav is 240px wide at 768 to 1023px. Checked at 768: nothing is clipped and the 'Anda' / 'Rimba Group' headers are visible.

items.title: Grouped cards are invisible: card is white on a white page, so rows float with a stray 32px indent
items.detail: The CSS comment promises Apple Notes grouped cards on grey, but surface equals bg, so the 16px card margin plus 16px row padding reads as random double indent: titles sit 16px right of their section headers. This is the main reason margins look wrong. Fix: Give .notes-phone the grouped background (var(--bg-grouped)/#f2f2f7 token, #000 in dark) so the card shows, or drop the card and put rows at 16px gutter flush with headers. (src/mobile/notes.css:62-67 (.nl-card background var(--surface)) and :15 (.notes-phone background var(--bg))) Evidence: audit/mobile/notes/phone375__00-start.png; measured .notes-phone bg rgb(255,255,255), .nl-card bg rgb(255,255,255); section head x=16 but row title x=32

items.title: Row divider starts 4px left of the text it belongs to
items.detail: Kit rule: divider starts at the text. 28 is off the 4/8 grid relative to 16px padding. Fix: left: 16px (row padding), right: 0. (src/mobile/notes.css:105 (left: 28px)) Evidence: audit/agents/n-search.png: divider begins x=44 while titles start x=48 (card 16 + divider left 28 vs text 16+16)

items.title: Search pill shrunk to 271px to make room for a FAB that is not beside it
items.detail: Pill and FAB were meant to share a row but the FAB floats 50px higher, leaving a lopsided bottom bar and a FAB that covers the last list row. Fix: Either place the compose button inline at the pill's right (Apple Notes bottom bar) or let the pill run full width and lift the FAB above the dock consistently. (src/mobile/notes.css:199 (margin-right: calc(56px + 16px))) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: .nl-search x16 w271 at y752, FAB centred y703 above it; 72px empty gap right of the pill

items.title: First section header is jammed 12px under the top bar
items.detail: Tight-under-header; the pinned header feels glued to the large title and inconsistent with the 24px between later sections. Fix: margin-top: 16px (or 24) for the first section, matching the rhythm. (src/mobile/notes.css:52-54 (.nl-section:first-child margin-top 12px)) Evidence: top bar ends y52, .nl-sec-head 'Pinned' at y64; other sections get 24px

items.title: Section header size/height inconsistent with the system
items.detail: Kit says section headers are 15/600; this uses heading/700, and something else overrides the line-height, so header rhythm differs from other apps. Fix: Use the shared section-header role from src/mobile/system.css instead of a local rule. (src/mobile/notes.css:55-61) Evidence: .nl-sec-head measured 20px tall although CSS sets line-height 25px and font-size var(--fs-heading) at weight 700 | Round 4: Removed the local 17/700/25px override on .nl-sec-head. The shared 15/600 role in system.css applies.

items.title: Dark mode never applies on phones
items.detail: Bar item 8: both themes. Notes dark styling exists only for an explicit data-theme='dark' and is never seen when the system is dark. Fix: Default theme to 'system' and mirror the dark .nl-card/.swipe-face rules under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme='light']). (theme init (data-theme set to 'light' explicitly, overriding prefers-color-scheme); src/mobile/notes.css:68 only styles :root[data-theme='dark']) Evidence: audit/mobile/notes/phone375dark__00-start.png is fully light; my run with colorScheme 'dark' measured documentElement data-theme='light', bg rgb(255,255,255) (audit/agents/n-list-dark.png)

items.title: Search result snippet repeats the title and cuts off the match
items.detail: Apple Notes and Notion show body context centred on the match; here the person cannot see why a note matched. Fix: Build the snippet from body only and start it a few words before the first hit. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx (snippet built from title+body text)) Evidence: audit/agents/n-search.png: row 1 snippet 'Website move: what to check on la…' (match truncated at the edge); row 2 'Q4 priorities Supplements launch…' | Round 4: snippetAround now uses the body only (the title is already on the row) and starts at a word boundary about 24 chars before the hit.

items.title: Search shows no scopes, recent searches, or 'Top hits' and loses section headers
items.detail: Apple Notes offers suggested searches (checklists, attachments, shared, tags); Notion offers filters by date/creator. Here only plain text. Fix: Show facet chips (Shared, With checklists, With attachments, Project) when the field is focused and empty. (src/mobile/notes.css:189-194 (.nl-facets defined) / NotesList.tsx search branch) Evidence: audit/agents/n-search.png: flat list, no 'In note' vs title split, no count, no filters chips despite .nl-facets styles

items.title: Empty 'Untitled' notes pile up after New note + Back
items.detail: Apple Notes and Notion discard a note left empty; here every accidental tap litters the list. Fix: On leave, delete notes with empty title and body (silently, no toast). (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx (create on open, no discard on empty leave)) Evidence: phone375dark__00-start.png shows 'Untitled / No more text'; ipad1024__03-New-note.png shows four 'Untitled just now' rows | Round 4: New api.discard (App.tsx notesApi) drops a note quietly. The editor discards a note left empty when it is closed (owner only, StrictMode-safe through an OPEN set and a deferred check).

items.title: Phone editor has no visible formatting entry until the keyboard is open
items.detail: Apple Notes always shows checklist, Aa, camera, compose at the bottom; here a user must discover that tapping text enters edit mode before any tool exists. Fix: Show a bottom toolbar (Checklist, Aa, Attach, New note) in reading view too; tapping a tool enters edit mode. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:42 comment (opens to read) and NoteBar.tsx:28) Evidence: phone375__03 / __04: top bar only Back, Share, More; no Aa or checklist button; bar only exists inside NoteBar shown with caret | Left: A bottom toolbar in reading view needs a redesign of PushScreen's footer and NoteBar's edit-mode entry. That is bigger than this pass.

items.title: Format sheet still misses core Notion/Apple Notes options
items.detail: Apple Notes Aa has Monospaced, dashed list, indent/outdent, block quote; Notion's /menu has toggle, table, callout, image, code block. Callout and PRE exist in fmt but are not first-class in the bar. Fix: Add Monospaced, Dashed list, Indent/Outdent row, Table, Toggle, Photo/Scan to the sheet; add a '/' or '+' block inserter to the bar. (src/components/notes/NoteSheets.tsx:60-64 and :43-60 (rows)) Evidence: NoteSheets.tsx styles: Title/Heading/Subheading/Body only; no Monospaced, no dashed list, no alignment, no table, no toggle, no image/scan, no indent in Aa sheet | Left: Monospaced, dashed list, table, toggle and a photo/scan block are new editor block types in NoteText and the sanitizer. That is feature work, not an audit fix.

items.title: Selection bar drops colour: highlight is fixed to yellow and text colour is unreachable from it
items.detail: Colouring text needs selection, Aa, scroll to colour section: three steps versus one in Notion's selection menu. Fix: Make the highlighter open a small colour strip (text + background) above the keyboard. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:169) Evidence: NoteBar.tsx:36 highlight runs a.highlight; NoteEditor.tsx:169,188 hl = HIGHLIGHTS[0].color | Round 4: On phones the selection bar's highlighter opens an ActionSheet with highlight colours, text colours and reset options. Selection is saved and restored.

items.title: Note body text is 15px while editable
items.detail: Kit rule: fields at 16px; iOS Safari zooms on focus of editable text under 16px, shifting the page. Fix: font-size: var(--fs-field) (16) for .note-text on phones. (src/mobile/notes.css:334) Evidence: body font var(--fs-body)=15px on the contentEditable | Round 4: .note-text font-size var(--fs-field) (16px) on phones.

items.title: Title tap target 34px tall
items.detail: Below the 44px tap minimum for a one-line title. Fix: min-height: var(--tap) with padding-block 4px. (src/mobile/notes.css:326-330 (.note-screen .note-title line-height 34, no min-height)) Evidence: report.json: small-tap-target 343x34 textarea.note-title on phone375 and phone430 | Round 4: Phone title: min-height var(--tap), padding-block 4px.

items.title: 'Saving…' and 'Edited x ago by you' sit above the title, pushing content down and repeating info
items.detail: Apple Notes puts the date centred small above text only when scrolled; 'by you' is noise in a personal note. Fix: Drop 'by you' when the author is the viewer; move save state into the top bar as a subtle icon. (src/mobile/notes.css:338-343 (.note-meta-top)) Evidence: phone375__05-New-note.png: cloud+Saving at y69 above Title y99; phone375__03: 'Edited 9 hours ago by you' | Round 4: 'by you' dropped: when you made the last edit it now says 'Edited {when}'. The status line cross-fades.

items.title: Editor placeholder is an instruction paragraph
items.detail: Long grey hint competes with the title; Notion uses 'Type / for commands', Apple Notes nothing. Fix: Short placeholder ('Start writing'); teach Make task through the bar button itself. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:295) Evidence: phone375__05: 'Write here. A line can become a task: put the caret on it and tap Make task.' wraps two lines | Round 4: Same fix as P130: 'Start writing'.

items.title: New note top bar has three accent actions competing (Undo, Share, filled Done)
items.detail: Bar rule: one primary action and accent only on primary; Undo and Share should be neutral. Fix: Undo/Share in var(--text-2); Done stays the single accent. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx top bar / src/mobile/notes.css:257-267) Evidence: phone375__05: green undo, green share, 44px filled green check circle | Round 4: .note-top-btn colour is var(--text-2). Done stays the only accent.

items.title: More sheet lacks Share/export, Find in note, Lock, and Recently deleted path
items.detail: Apple Notes More: Find in note, Move, Lines & grids, Lock, Send a copy, Print; Notion: Export, Page history, Word count. No version history or find. Fix: Add Find in note, Send a copy (PDF/Markdown), Page history; put sheet title in 15/600 with no truncation of meaningful words. (src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts) Evidence: audit/agents/n-more.png: Unpin, Move to a project, Who sees it, Copy link, Duplicate, Delete only | Left: Find in note, Send a copy (PDF/Markdown) and Page history are new features. Page history needs server-side versioning.

items.title: List rows have no swipe hints, no folders or tags, only a 3-option scope sheet
items.detail: Apple Notes has folders, tags, Recently Deleted; Notion has workspace pages. Projects exist in data but cannot be browsed from the list. Fix: Add a 'Projects' group and 'Recently deleted' to the scope sheet. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx (title menu options)) Evidence: phone375__02-Which-notes-All-notes.png: All notes / Only me / Shared with me; no projects, no Recently deleted

items.title: Which-notes sheet: tall empty gap above, items not on row heights
items.detail: Minor, but icons not vertically centred to label line look sloppy. Fix: Use ActionSheet row role (44/48 rows, centred 20px icons). (src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx usage in NotesList.tsx) Evidence: phone375__02: rows 48px pitch but icon baseline misaligned with label (icons at y678 vs text y680), sheet title 17px with 24px gap

items.title: iPad 768: notes sidebar collapses to single-letter grey squares
items.detail: Letters are meaningless (three notes are 'U'ntitled); at 768 there is room for a 280px list like Apple Notes' split view. Fix: At >=768 show the full list column by default; collapse only on explicit toggle. (src/notes.css (collapsed rail at 768)) Evidence: audit/mobile/notes/ipad768__00-start.png: W, U, U, Q tiles with no titles; huge empty pane | Round 4: App.tsx: on tablet, Notes has its own persisted collapse key that defaults to open (pm-sidebar-collapsed-tablet-notes). Checked at 768: the full list shows.

items.title: iPad 1024 list rows show lock icons and three-line rows that misalign with the header
items.detail: Edges not aligned; pin icon too small to read; lock on every private note is noise. Fix: Align button, search and rows to one 12px inset; hide lock for default private; 16px pin icon. (src/notes.css (sidebar .new-note / .note-item)) Evidence: ipad1024__03-New-note.png: '+ New note' pill wider than search field and overhanging; list text x=114 vs 'Notes' x=108; pinned icon is a 8px pin glyph | Round 4: Removed the lock on every private row and the pin icon is now 16px. Alignment checked in the iPad screenshot.

items.title: .nl-proj dot is 9x8, not round
items.detail: Off-grid and oval dot. Fix: 8x8. (src/mobile/notes.css:152-155) Evidence: width 9px height 8px | Round 4: .nl-proj .sel-dot is 8x8.

items.title: Dark mode never applies on phones: phone375dark capture is identical to light
items.detail: CLAUDE.md bar 8: the app must work in both themes; a phone in dark mode gets a white flash-bang Drive Fix: Default data-theme to 'system' and follow prefers-color-scheme when the user has not picked a theme; re-run the dark capture (theme bootstrap (data-theme is forced to 'light' and ignores prefers-color-scheme); Drive styles in src/mobile/drive.css only use tokens, so the fault is the theme attribute) Evidence: audit/mobile/drive/phone375dark__00-start.png is pixel-for-pixel the light screen; my run with colorScheme:'dark' measured documentElement data-theme='light', body bg rgb(255,255,255) (audit/agents/drv-dark.png)

items.title: Grid view on a phone truncates every name to ~12 chars ('Rimba-board-p...', 'Supplements-...')
items.detail: Google Drive iOS grid shows the name on up to 2 lines plus a file-type icon left of it; here the file can't be identified, and two files with the same prefix are indistinguishable Fix: Let .dp-tile .d-name wrap to 2 lines (line-clamp 2), keep the extension via the dp-stem/dp-ext split used in rows, put a 16px type icon before the name (src/mobile/drive.css:216-221 (.dp-tile .fc-text padding 0 0 0 4px, .d-name fs-secondary single line)) Evidence: audit/mobile/drive/phone375__04-Show-as-a-grid.png, phone375__11-Shared.png: names cut at 12 chars, no extension, no owner/date line

items.title: Grid tile uses asymmetric padding: 8px left/top, 0 right, inner thumb has its own 8px right margin; name row sits flush to the tile bottom
items.detail: Uneven insets read as sloppy; spacing must be even on the 4/8 scale and the name touches the more button Fix: padding: 8px; remove .d-thumb margin-right; give the name row 4px 4px 8px 8px and a 4px gap before the 44px more button (src/mobile/drive.css:201-214 (padding: 8px 0 0 8px; .d-thumb margin-right: 8px)) Evidence: phone375__04-Show-as-a-grid.png: thumb inset 8px top/left, name baseline ~20px from bottom but '...' button hugs right edge; measured 'touching 0px between name and More' in report.json

items.title: Box inside a box in grid tiles: white thumb card inside a grey tile
items.detail: CLAUDE.md bar 5 'No box inside a box'; Drive iOS uses one card with a flush thumbnail on top Fix: Make the tile one surface (border or hover bg) and the thumb flush to its top edge with the same top radius (src/mobile/drive.css:209-214 (background: var(--hover) on tile, var(--surface) on .d-thumb)) Evidence: phone375__04-Show-as-a-grid.png: grey --hover tile with a white --surface rounded rectangle inside it

items.title: Row divider runs to the screen edge on the right but starts at the text on the left; first row has no top rule, and the divider sits only 1 row (no 'none after last row' check across sections)
items.detail: Right end of the rule should stop at the 16px gutter like the rest of the content; edges are misaligned Fix: set right: 16px on the ::before rule (left already aligned to text) (src/mobile/drive.css:117-124 (.dp-list > .dp-row + .dp-row::before)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: divider between rows spans x=68..375 touching the right edge while content ends at 358 | Round 4: Row divider ::before now right:16px

items.title: Drawer nav items are 36px tall, below the 44px tap target
