items.detail: Bar 6: tap targets at least var(--tap) 44px on phones Fix: In the phone layer: .drawer .nav-item { min-height: var(--row-1) } (44-48px) (src/brand.css:171-174 (.nav-item, no min-height override in src/mobile/drive.css)) Evidence: report.json: 7x small-tap-target 304x36 for New folder, My Drive, Recent, Photos & videos, From email, Starred, Trash; phone375__01-Open-menu.png | Round 4: Drawer 44px rule keyed on new .d-new-nav (old :has(.storage-row) only matched when storage was nearly full)

items.title: Drawer header crowded: 'Settings' pill butts against the org switcher, active 'Recent' pill overflows the drawer edge, 'Drive' title has a second gear duplicating Settings
items.detail: One way to reach settings; active state must sit inside the 16px gutter Fix: Drop the gear next to 'Drive' on phones, inset nav to margin 0 8px so the active pill has room, give drawer header 16px right padding (src/components/DriveSidebar.tsx (header + gear), src/brand.css:175-178 (.nav-item.active box-shadow)) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png: Settings pill right edge at x=296 vs drawer edge 304 (8px), Recent active pill shadow runs off the drawer at x=304; two settings entries (pill + gear at 278,82) | Won't fix: Phones use the hamburger drawer and Apps tab; drawer gutter/padding already fixed (nav padding-right 8px), gear is the app settings entry per useAppSettings

items.title: 'New folder' is a nav row in the drawer above 'My Drive', mixing an action with places
items.detail: Drive iOS keeps create actions in the + sheet only; the FAB already has 'Make a folder' Fix: Hide the New folder nav item on phones (src/components/DriveSidebar.tsx (New folder nav-item)) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png: 'New folder' first item, then section 'Drive' | Round 4: DriveSidebar New folder nav gets .d-new-nav, hidden on phones

items.title: Bottom sheets have no safe-area/bottom padding: last item sits on the home indicator and the sheet looks cut off
items.detail: On a real iPhone the last option collides with the home bar; it reads as clipped Fix: padding-bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 8px) on the sheet list (src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx sheet body (no padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)))) Evidence: Measured in audit/agents/drv.mjs: 'Details' row top 752 height 48 -> ends 800 of 812; phone375__06, __14, __03 show last row at the bottom edge with no breathing room

items.title: File menu for shared/email files has only 3 actions (Open, Open the email, Details): no Share, Download, Star, Send a copy, Make available offline
items.detail: Drive iOS menu has ~12 actions incl. Share, Copy link, Star, Send a copy, Open in, Download, Rename, Move; a file you can open you should be able to star and download Fix: Allow Star for any visible file (per-user), show Download/Send a copy whenever the file can be opened, add 'Add to My Drive' for shared files (src/components/DriveView.tsx:234-242 (Share link/Download gated on i.url, Star/Rename/Move gated on own)) Evidence: phone375__06-More-for-Rimba-board-pack-Oct-.png; drv.mjs menu dump: ['Open','Open the email','Details'] | Won't fix: Email attachments are derived items, not stored Drive rows, so per-user star can't persist; Download/Share already show whenever a url exists

items.title: No Share (people + access) flow at all on phones, only 'Share link' for own files
items.detail: Sharing with a person is the core Drive iOS task (Share -> add people, role); here it is a dead end Fix: Add a 'Share' sheet using PeoplePicker + role, and a 'Who has access' row in Details (src/components/DriveView.tsx:176,235 and DetailsScreen at :806-830) Evidence: DriveView menu items list; Details screen audit/agents/drv-details.png has no 'Who has access' section | Left: Sharing with people needs a per-file ACL model and server support that Drive doesn't have yet

items.title: Preview viewer buttons are 38x38 and the caption text is 11.7px
items.detail: 44px targets and 12px minimum labels on phones Fix: Phone layer: .lb-btn { width/height: var(--tap) }, .lb-doc small { font-size: var(--fs-secondary) } (src/shell.css:1656-1661 (.lb-btn 38px), src/shell.css:1712 (.lb-doc small)) Evidence: report.json: small-tap-target 38x38 'Open related email', 'Close (Esc)'; tiny-text 11.67px 'Previews for documents arrive...'; phone375__05

items.title: Preview has no action bar: no share, download, star, or more menu, only 'email' and close; the developer caption shows to users
items.detail: Drive iOS preview has Share, Star, and a ... menu with all file actions; a dev-note copy is not user-facing language Fix: Add the same ActionSheet as the row '...' to the preview header; replace the caption with 'Can't preview this file' + Download/Open in button (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx (header buttons, placeholder copy)) Evidence: phone375__05-Rimba-board-pack-Oct-pdf.png: header has mail + X only; body shows 'Previews for documents arrive with the real file server.' | Round 4: Preview header gains Copy link and Download, dev caption replaced (with P111/P119)

items.title: Preview next button floats bottom-right alone, no previous button and no swipe hint; '1/2' counter offset from the button
items.detail: Unbalanced; Drive iOS uses swipe between files without chevrons Fix: Support horizontal swipe, hide chevrons on touch, or show both chevrons aligned with the counter (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx (nav buttons)) Evidence: phone375__05: '>' at (337,780), counter at (188,788) not on the same baseline; nothing on the left

items.title: Preview card is a box floating mid-screen with 8px side margins and shows name and size twice (header + card)
items.detail: Margins off the 16px gutter, duplicate info Fix: Use 16px gutter, show only the icon + 'No preview' message in the card (src/shell.css:1703 (.lb-doc)) Evidence: phone375__05: card x=8..367, name repeated at y=26 and y=420, size at y=40 and y=448 | Round 4: src/mobile/drive.css .lb-doc: side margins changed from 8px to the 16px gutter. Name and size are already hidden in the card on phones.

items.title: Search results keep the section title ('Recent') and sort row though they search all of Drive; no recent searches or type filter chips
items.detail: Sort label lies (says Last modified, list is by name); Drive iOS turns search into its own screen with filter chips (Type, People, Modified) Fix: While q is set, swap the title to 'Results', hide the sort row or honour it, add type chips (src/components/DriveView.tsx:82 and DrivePhone header ~:600-610) Evidence: audit/agents/drv-search.png title still 'Recent' and 'Last modified' while results are sorted by name (DriveView.tsx:82 sorts byName)

items.title: Sort row says 'Last modified' with an arrow but tapping only opens a 3-item sheet; no ascending/descending toggle visible, and no Folders-first option
items.detail: Drive iOS offers Name, Last modified, Last modified by me, Last opened by me, plus direction Fix: Add 'Last opened by me' and make re-tapping the active option flip direction with a label (src/components/DriveView.tsx:493-497 (SORTS)) Evidence: phone375__03-Last-modified.png: Name / Last modified / Size only

items.title: My Drive empty state is vertically centered in a huge void and gives no action button; copy explains internals
items.detail: Screens should answer 'what do I do now'; Drive iOS shows an illustration + 'Upload' / 'New' action Fix: Add a primary 'Upload' button and 'Make a folder' secondary to EmptyState; shorten copy (src/components/DriveView.tsx:581-590) Evidence: phone375__12-My-Drive.png: icon at y=338, nothing else; text 'Files from chat and email stay in Home and Shared.' | Round 4: My Drive root empty state has a 'New' primary action and short copy 'Upload files or make a folder to get started.'

items.title: My Drive has no sort row / layout toggle while other sections do: header layout jumps when switching tabs
items.detail: Bar 2: no jumps; tab switch shifts content by 44px Fix: Always render the sort row, disabled when empty (src/components/DriveView.tsx ~:600 (dp-sort rendered only when items exist)) Evidence: phone375__12 vs phone375__00: search pill then empty, sort row (y=133) missing | Round 4: Phone sort row always rendered (disabled when empty) so switching sections doesn't shift

items.title: Sort row and list have uneven spacing: 8px above search, 4px gap from search to sort, 12px from sort to first row
items.detail: Rhythm should be consistent (8 / 8); the sort row feels jammed under search Fix: search margin-bottom 8px, sort row min-height 44 with 0 extra margin, list padding-top 4px (src/mobile/drive.css:31,39,68-74 (margins 4px 16px 8px / 0 16px 4px)) Evidence: phone375__00: search bottom y=108, sort text y=133, first row top ~162

items.title: Grid toggle button has a grey active circle that clips at the right gutter
items.detail: Right edges must align with the search pill (x=359) Fix: padding-right 16px and margin-right -10px on the 44px icon button so the glyph aligns at 359 (src/mobile/drive.css:68-74 (.dp-sort padding 0 4px 0 16px) and .dp-layout) Evidence: phone375__04: pressed circle spans x=327..371, past the 359 gutter

items.title: No quick-access suggestions, folders, or 'Files'/'Computers' tabs: Home is just a flat Recent list
items.detail: Drive iOS Home shows Suggested files/folders cards plus a Files tab; here a phone user sees nothing to act on Fix: Add a 'Suggested' horizontal strip and folders above the recent list (src/components/DriveView.tsx DrivePhone (~:534-700)) Evidence: phone375__00: two rows and 500px of blank space | Left: Suggested files/folders strip needs an open-history signal that isn't tracked; product decision pending

items.title: No multi-select on phones (long-press only opens the menu)
items.detail: Drive iOS long-press enters selection mode to move/share/trash several files Fix: Long-press -> select mode with a top bar count and bottom actions (src/components/DriveView.tsx:462) Evidence: DriveItemCard src/components/DriveView.tsx:462-486 maps long-press to actions only | Left: Phone multi-select needs a selection mode plus bulk move/trash handlers in App; too large to do safely alongside the other agents' work

items.title: Tablet 768: Drive sub-sidebar is icon-only with no labels and the Upload button floats between gear and folder icons
items.detail: Two icon rails side by side waste space and hide meaning; Drive iPad shows a labelled sidebar Fix: At 768 collapse the app rail and show the labelled Drive sidebar, or use the phone tab bar (src/components/DriveSidebar.tsx (collapsed state at tablet)) Evidence: audit/mobile/drive/ipad768__00-start.png: second rail x=100-145 has unlabeled icons, green upload pill at y=117 overlapping column rhythm | Won't fix: Tablet layout is the shared shell's collapsed-rail decision (desktop sidebar with labels at 1024+), not Drive-specific

items.title: Bottom tab icons inconsistent: Apps tab leaves Drive to the launcher instead of a Drive section; FAB overlaps 16px above tab bar with no gap symmetry
items.detail: Edges misaligned by 4px between FAB and tab bar Fix: Align FAB right edge to the tab bar inset (both 16px) (src/mobile/drive.css:28 (--fab-space) and phone shell tab bar) Evidence: phone375__00: FAB bottom y=728, tab bar top y=744 (16px) while FAB right edge 359 vs bar right 363 | Won't fix: FAB/tab bar geometry is owned by the shared phone shell, not Drive; Apps tab is the agreed phone pattern

items.title: Phones open a sideways-scrolling spreadsheet, not cards
items.detail: You can only read 2.5 of 5 fields at a time. Airtable iOS shows grid views as record cards with the primary field plus 3 or 4 fields, and Notion iOS uses a list or gallery layout. Fix: On phone, default `cards` to true for grid views too (`?? true` when phone), and keep the grid as an opt-in 'Show as grid' item in the views sheet. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:84 (cards defaults to true only for kind 'list': `cardsOn[view.id] ?? view.kind === 'list'`)) Evidence: audit/mobile/tables/phone375__03-S-Stockists.png and audit/agents/tb-scrolled.png: grid scrollWidth 730 on a 375 viewport. Status is cut off ('Samples sent' clipped) and Owner and Next step are off-screen.

items.title: First grid column text is 10px from the edge, out of line with the 16px gutter
items.detail: The left edge is ragged. This is the 'no padding' complaint again. Fix: .tb-grid-wrap.touch .tb-first .tb-cell, .tb-th.tb-pinned { padding-left: 16px } (src/mobile/tables.css:1105-1109 (touch cells have no 16px inline padding on .tb-first)) Evidence: tb-scrolled.png / phone375__03: 'Toko Hijau' starts at x≈10, the 'Stockists' title and 'All shops' pill start at x=16

items.title: Cell borders use two different weights, a box in a box
items.detail: It looks unfinished and breaks the 'one divider rule' system. The rule also continues after the last row. Fix: Use one --line hairline, keep a thin shadow on the pinned edge only while scrolled, and drop the bottom rule on the last row. (src/mobile/tables.css:1105-1115) Evidence: phone375__03: the pinned Shop column has darker --border lines while the other cells have --line. The bottom of the last row draws a double rule at y≈336

items.title: Measured cells touching: 0px between columns
items.detail: Text sits flush against the next cell, and long values like 'Samples sent' run into the edge. Fix: Give cells 12px inline padding, or switch to cards (finding 1). (src/mobile/tables.css:1105) Evidence: report.json: touching 0px between 'Shop'/'City', 'City'/'Status', 'Toko Hijau'/'Bandung', 'Bandung'/'Selling' | Round 4: Phone grid cells and headers have 12px inline padding; the pinned column keeps 16px.

items.title: Scrolled columns slide under the pinned name, leaving clipped fragments
items.detail: The Owner column becomes unreadable fragments, and it is not clear what is pinned. Fix: Add an 8px scroll shadow on the pinned edge while scrollLeft > 0 and snap scrolling to column starts. (src/mobile/tables.css:1111-1115 (pinned column has no separating shadow or background while scrolled)) Evidence: audit/agents/tb-scrolled.png: 'es Cart…', 'n Broo…', 'nas Re…' show beside the pinned column | Round 4: The GridView wrap toggles .scrolled-x on scroll, only when it changes. The pinned column gets an 8px edge shadow with a transition. Snap scrolling was not added.

items.title: Owner column cannot be told apart while scrolling: the header row shows a blank cell
items.detail: Users lose the column context, and the add-column '+' is a 30px target at the screen edge. Fix: Use cards on phones, or keep the header label visible with text-overflow and move add-column into the more menu. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:1012 GridView with touch) Evidence: tb-scrolled.png: the header next to Shop is empty (the Owner label is scrolled under) and a '+' column sits half off-screen at x=345-375 | Round 4: The add-column button is a full 44px target on phones. Header labels keep text-overflow.

items.title: Calculate footer runs off-screen and is 33px tall
items.detail: It is under the 44px target size, and a desktop summary bar has no place on a phone. Fix: Hide .tb-foot on touch, and show summaries in the view settings sheet like Airtable's summary bar toggle. (src/mobile/tables.css (tb-foot rules) / GridView footer row) Evidence: report.json: small-tap-target 140x33 'Calculate'; off-screen 'Calculate' | Round 4: The calculate footer (.tb-foot) no longer renders on the touch/phone grid.

items.title: View pill is 36px tall, under the 44px tap target
items.detail: It breaks the bar's tap rule. The pill also sits beside 44px icon buttons, so their centres don't line up visually. Fix: min-height: var(--tap) with a 36px visual chip and an invisible hit area, or make the bar 52px with a 44px pill. (src/mobile/tables.css:57 (min-height: 36px)) Evidence: Measured pill rect 128x36 at y=64. report.json small-tap-target 'View: All shops'

items.title: Toolbar padding is uneven: 16px on the left, 4px on the right
items.detail: Icons look jammed toward the right edge compared with the left gutter, and the top bar uses different right insets. Fix: Use padding 8px 8px 8px 16px so the icon glyphs end at 16px, matching the top bar's '…'. (src/mobile/tables.css:48 (padding: 8px 4px 8px 16px)) Evidence: phone375__03: the pill starts at x=16, the sort icon glyph ends at x≈358 inside a 44px button whose edge is at 371

items.title: Search moved to the top bar but sort sits in the toolbar: actions are split over two rows
items.detail: Four actions are spread over two bars. Notion iOS keeps view, filter, sort and search on one row under the title. Fix: Put search, filter and sort in one toolbar row, and leave only back, title and '…' in the top bar. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:730-747) Evidence: phone375__03: search and more (…) in the header at y=26, filter and sort in the toolbar at y=82 | Won't fix: Phones put search in the shared TopBar (TopBarButton), the app-wide phone top-bar pattern. View, filter and sort stay in the toolbar row; moving search would break consistency with other apps.

items.title: No row count or active-sort feedback in the toolbar
items.detail: Airtable iOS shows record counts and the active sort and filter as chips. Here, users can't see why the order changed. Fix: When a sort or filter is on, show a chip row under the toolbar ('Status is Selling ×', 'City A→Z ×'). (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:742) Evidence: phone375__03: nothing says '4 shops'. The sort button only tints when on, and there's no chip saying what it's sorted by.

items.title: New row sheet only asks for the name
items.detail: Airtable and Notion iOS open the full record form with every field, so you can set Status, City and Owner while creating. Here it takes a second trip into the record. Fix: After the name, show the other fields in the sheet (collapsed under 'More fields'), or open the record screen right after Create. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:519-520 (openQuick)) Evidence: audit/agents/tb-fab.png: only 'Shop' field, then Create

items.title: New row sheet: the secondary action is a plain text button that looks like a label, and the footer is unbalanced
items.detail: There's one primary action but the secondary doesn't look tappable. The gradient and shadow on Create don't match the flat system. Fix: Use a quiet bordered or ghost button for 'Add another' (or a toggle), a flat accent Create, and a 16px gap under the title. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx openQuick sheet; quick sheet CSS in src/mobile/tables.css) Evidence: tb-fab.png: 'Create and add another' is plain text at x=30 with no affordance. Create is a shadowed gradient pill. The sheet title sits 8px from the field.

items.title: Column menu sheet is dense and mixes paddings
items.detail: Tap targets fail, and the left edge doesn't line up with other sheets (Views and Filter use 16px). Fix: Use 48px rows with 16px inline padding (shared .sheet-row) and separate Move left and Move right rows. (src/mobile/tables.css column-sheet rules (~lines 600-700, e.g. 638 padding:12px 4px, 659 padding:8px 4px)) Evidence: audit/agents/tb-colmenu.png: rows ≈32px tall (Sort A to Z at y=437, Z to A at 469), under 44. The title 'Shop' is at x=19, not 16. 'Move left / Move right' share one row. The footer note is 13px grey at the bottom.

items.title: Column format options are thin next to Airtable and Notion
items.detail: Notion iOS property sheets offer edit property (type picker with ~20 types), hide, duplicate, delete, wrap and calculate. Airtable has hide, field description, duplicate and type with formatting. Fix: Add Hide in view, Duplicate, Delete (for non-name fields), and a tappable type row that opens the full type picker with format options. (src/components/tables/GridView.tsx (field menu)) Evidence: tb-colmenu.png: only type, sort, filter, group, wrap, freeze, insert, move. Missing: hide field, duplicate, change type inline list, required, default value, number format.

items.title: Record screen: label column is wide and values start at x=148, wasting space
items.detail: Long values wrap early. Notion iOS also uses label/value rows, but with a 40% label column and full-width hit rows. Fix: Set the label column to 112px, make each row a 48px full-width tap target with a divider, and use an 8px gap before send. (record screen styles src/mobile/tables.css:700-770) Evidence: audit/agents/tb-row.png: labels at x=40, values at x=148. The comment field ends at 306 while the send button is at 338, an uneven gap. | Round 4: Record page label column is now 112px and rows are 48px full-width taps (src/mobile/tables.css).

items.title: Record screen has no way to step to the next or previous record
items.detail: Airtable iOS lets you swipe or use up/down arrows between records. Here, reviewing 4 shops takes 8 navigations. Fix: Add up and down chevrons in the top bar, or a horizontal swipe between rows in the current view order. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx openRowFull) Evidence: tb-row.png: only back and '…' | Round 4: The phone RecordPage top bar now has Previous/Next row chevrons (uses the existing nav prop) before the ... button.

items.title: Tables home: 'Company' header and list are misaligned, and the home is sparse
items.detail: Three different left edges. The page shows no row counts or recents, though the comment at TablesApp.tsx:201 promises 'how many rows'. Fix: Align the header with the card's inner text (16 card + 16 = 32 for both), add 16px above the first group, show the row count as g-val, and add a Recent group. (src/mobile/grouped.css:14 (.g-head margin 0 20px) vs .g-card margin 16 and src/mobile/tables.css:415) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: 'Company' at x=32, card edge at x=28, title 'Tables' at x=52 after the apps icon. The header sits 8px under a 24/700 title, and 'Apps' and 'Tables' touch with 0px (report.json). | Won't fix: Header and card insets come from the shared grouped system (src/mobile/grouped.css, g-head 20 / g-card 16) used by every app. Row counts were dropped on purpose (CLAUDE.md: no counts nobody acts on). The title/apps-icon spacing is shell chrome.

items.title: Apps icon and 'Tables' title touch (0px)
items.detail: The 44px icon button's hit area runs into the title text. Fix: Add 8px between the logo button and the title. (src/mobile/TopBar.tsx / src/mobile/shell.css mobile-top gap) Evidence: report.json: touching 0px between 'Apps' and 'Tables' at header.mobile-top

items.title: Dark mode screenshot renders light
items.detail: Dark mode for Tables is unverified, or the app ignores the system scheme for this user. Fix: Re-audit with data-theme='dark' set, and check that the grid hairlines and pill colours hold contrast. (src/settings.ts:157 (theme only follows the system when the setting is 'system'; the saved account preference overrides)) Evidence: audit/mobile/tables/phone375dark__00-start.png is identical to the light screenshot

items.title: iPad 768: Shop column takes half the width and City is cut off
items.detail: The width is spent badly, and a stuck hover on touch looks like a selection. Fix: Cap the name column at about 180px on touch, use one row-number colour, and drop hover styles under (hover: none). (src/components/tables/GridView.tsx (name column width) / src/mobile/tables.css) Evidence: ipad768__06: Shop column ≈240px wide with short names, City clipped at the right edge, and no Status visible. Row numbers 2 and 4 are coloured differently (grey and blue). The row 1 hover state is stuck on touch. | Round 4: The name column defaults to 180px on coarse pointers (GridView widthOf). The @media (hover: none) block in tables.css removes the stuck row hover on iPad.

items.title: iPad: the sidebar takes 340px of 768 with a duplicate New table
items.detail: Too little room for the table, and two create buttons break the one-primary-action rule. Fix: Collapse the sidebar by default under 900px wide, and drop the gradient New table button in favour of the shell create button. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:42 sidebar) Evidence: ipad768__06: rail + sidebar ≈ 340px, the grid gets ≈415px. The New table gradient button is on top of the + FAB.

items.title: Search chips run off-screen at 32px tall
items.detail: The last chip is cut off with no fade or scroll hint, and the chips are under 44px. Fix: Use 36px chips with a 44px hit area, scroll horizontally with 16px edge padding and a fade mask. (palette chips CSS (.palette-chips) in src/mobile/shell.css) Evidence: report.json: chips 52-83x32 small-tap-target, and 'Files' off-screen

items.title: Create button disappears in Day view and does not come back
items.detail: The grid scrolls itself to the current time when it opens, and that scroll counts as 'scrolling down', so the button hides. The only ways to create an event are then gone (Google Calendar always keeps its + button). Fix: Only set 'away' after the person scrolls (ignore programmatic scrollTo on mount), or keep the button on screen in the time-grid views (src/mobile/AppBar.tsx:81 + src/mobile/shell.css:735) Evidence: audit/agents/cal-day.png: no + button. Playwright reports the button as class 'fab lp on scroll-away', and a click times out after 60 tries because the grid underneath takes the tap

items.title: Tab bar says 'Schedule' while you are in Day, 3 days or Week view
items.detail: The highlighted tab says one thing and the screen shows another. Day, 3 days and Week can only be reached through the drawer. Fix: Make the bar 'Schedule | Day | Month' (closer to Google Calendar's view switcher), or highlight nothing when a drawer-only view is open (src/App.tsx:4343-4348) Evidence: audit/agents/cal-day.png: a time grid is showing but the tab bar still highlights Schedule

items.title: Day-view header: the 10:00 label is cut off and the date sits loose
items.detail: A clipped label right under the header looks broken. This is the 'tight under header' problem again. Fix: Add 8px of top padding to the grid scroller so the first visible label is never cut, and put a date and weekday header over the event column, as Google Calendar does (src/mobile/calendar.css:1070-1080 (.tg-phone head/gutter)) Evidence: audit/agents/cal-day.png: the '10:00' label is half under the header line at y=112. 'THU 15' is centred in the 56px gutter but nothing lines up with the column

items.title: Day-view events touch the right edge of the screen
items.detail: There is no right gutter, while the Schedule cards keep 12-16px. Google Calendar leaves about 8px. Fix: Give .tg-phone .tg-col 8px of right padding, or inset the event by right: 8px (src/mobile/calendar.css:1169 (.tg-phone .block-event)) Evidence: audit/agents/cal-day.png: the Badminton block runs from x=67 to 373 with 0-2px to spare on the right

items.title: Event colours differ between views: solid blue in the grid, pale tint in Schedule
items.detail: The same event looks like a different object depending on the view Fix: Use one card style in every view (the 'calm card' rule at 1683 should also cover .tg-phone .block-event) (src/mobile/calendar.css:1169-1176 vs 1683-1687) Evidence: cal-day.png shows a saturated #4285F4 block with white text; phone375__00-start.png shows a pale tint with a 4px edge for the same Badminton event

items.title: The calendar does not follow dark mode
items.detail: The bar requires both themes. Either the app ignores the system dark setting, or the dark audit never checked it. Fix: Follow prefers-color-scheme when the theme is 'system', then check the card tints (color-mix with --surface) in dark (src/mobile/calendar.css (only one dark rule, at line 1387); the theme follows the stored data-theme, not prefers-color-scheme) Evidence: audit/mobile/calendar/phone375dark__00-start.png is the same white page as the light screenshot

items.title: Big empty gaps in Schedule: days with nothing on them are skipped
items.detail: Google Calendar shows each month with an illustrated header and a week range even when it has no events. Here November simply vanishes, so the list reads as broken. Fix: Show week ranges for empty weeks (as Google does), or one quiet 'Nothing in November' row (src/mobile/calendar.css:870-890 (.sch-month 24px top, .sch-day 16px bottom)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: Wed 21 Oct jumps straight to 'December' (24px + 32px gaps), with no Nov rows. 'January 2027' sits under the + button and the tab bar | Round 4: Schedule now inserts a month header and a quiet 'Nothing planned this month' line (.sch-gap, aligned with the cards) for whole months with nothing on them. Verified November at 375 and 768.

items.title: Week-range labels are indented to the date column, not the cards
items.detail: Three left edges (16, 56, 60) in one list. This breaks the 'aligned edges' rule. Fix: Use padding-left: 60px, the same as the .sch-items start, or line up with the 16 gutter (src/mobile/calendar.css:879-885 (.sch-week padding-left 56px)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: '19 to 25 Oct' starts at x=56 while the cards start at x=60, and the month headers start at x=16

items.title: Task rows are 32px tall, below the 44px tap target
items.detail: Event cards are 48px but task cards are 32px, so the list is uneven and hard to tap Fix: Make .sch-task and the title min-height: var(--row-48) to match .ev-card.solid (src/mobile/calendar.css:942-967 (.sch-task min-height 32px, .sch-task-title 32px)) Evidence: report.json: '255x32 Prepare growth partner proposal' and '255x32 Review November reorder plan' (small-tap-target) on every phone state

items.title: Task titles are cut off on one line with nothing else shown
items.detail: The most useful word (the client) is the part that gets cut Fix: Allow 2 lines, or show the project on a second line like an event's meta (src/mobile/calendar.css:961 (.sch-task-title) + 994 (line-clamp 1)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: 'Prepare growth partner proposal for L...' with no project or time, while event cards get two lines

items.title: Month picker: the month chip strip is clipped at both edges
items.detail: The strip repeats what the arrows and swipe already do, has 32px targets, and looks broken. Google Calendar iOS has only the month grid and a swipe. Fix: Drop the strip, or scroll it to centre the current month with 16px insets and 44px-tall chips (src/mobile/calendar.css:334-370 (.md-chips margin 0 -8px, .md-chip height 32px)) Evidence: phone375__02-October-Pick-a-date.png: 'Jul' cut at x=0, '202' cut on the right. report.json: chips 47-60x32 and 'July 2026 runs past the edge' | Round 4: Month chips are 44px tall (var(--tap)) and pill-shaped, with no negative margin, a 16px inset and scroll-padding. They fade out with a mask at the 16 gutter instead of being cut at the screen edge.

items.title: The month picker pushes the list down instead of overlaying, and has no year or arrows
items.detail: In Google Calendar the title drop-down is a month you can swipe, with clear month and year context Fix: Show 'October 2026' in the drop-down header with chevrons, and keep swiping (src/mobile/calendar.css:300-370 (.month-drop)) Evidence: phone375__02: the grid takes 330px and the agenda below gets squeezed. There are no prev/next arrows and the month label carries no year | Won't fix: The bar title already adds the year when the browsed month is in another year, and the chips mark where the year turns. Swipe moves months, as on Google iOS, and pushing the list down matches Google's title drop. Arrows would repeat the swipe and the chips.

items.title: The hamburger opens the desktop sidebar, not a phone drawer
items.detail: Two different drawers ('Open menu' vs 'Calendars and views') hold the same calendars. Drag-to-schedule does not work on a phone. The header is jammed against the top. Fix: On phones, the hamburger opens only the 'Calendars and views' drawer (as in Google). Remove the desktop sidebar there, or give it 16px padding and 48px rows and hide 'Plan your tasks' (src/mobile/calendar.css (.sb-panel / nav-item have no phone overrides); drawer rendered by useSidebarDrawer in src/mobile/chrome.ts) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png: the workspace switcher row has a 'Settings' pill wedged into the top-right corner with no padding (x=218-296, y=2). A gear repeats beside 'Calendar'. 'Plan your tasks' holds framed cards with a drag hint ('Drag a task onto the calendar'), and nav rows are 34px (report.json 304x34) | Won't fix: A later decision changed this: phones use the app hamburger menu plus the calendar's own 'Calendars and views' AppDrawer (Layers button), which has 16px gutters and 48px rows, with no desktop sidebar or 'Plan your tasks'.

items.title: Drawer: icons sit right against their labels
items.detail: The 24px glyph ends at x=40 and the text starts at x=56, so the visible gap is fine, but the box measures 0. The bigger problem: the account rows ('G james.personal@...', the Public holidays flag) indent the icon to x=56 while the checkbox rows sit at x=16, so the edges go 16/56/16 Fix: Put the account headings at the 16 gutter like 'My calendars', and use 16px icons for the account badges (src/mobile/calendar.css:120-127 (.ad-icon place-items: center start, width 56px, padding-left 16px)) Evidence: report.json: 'touching 0px between ad-icon and Schedule/Day/3 days/Week/Month'. In phone375__04 the icon box is 56px but the glyph is drawn at the left

items.title: Drawer list: gaps between sections are uneven, and the account email is cut off
items.detail: It looks crowded next to the clean Google Calendar drawer Fix: Put the address on a 13px secondary line, line up the end buttons at the 16 gutter, and add 8px above each group heading (src/mobile/calendar.css:128-140 (.ad-heading)) Evidence: phone375__04: 'james.personal@example...' is truncated. 'Personal / Busy only' shows a subtitle while other rows do not, and the two '...' buttons line up at x=278 instead of the right gutter at x=288

items.title: Create sheet: options go full width and the sheet is flush with the bottom
items.detail: The highlight should sit inside the 16 gutter, and the last row is cramped against the screen edge Fix: Inset rows by 8px with the radius at 10, add padding-bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), and consider adding Focus time and Working location (src/components/ui/ActionSheet.tsx (Create menu) / src/mobile/calendar.css create sheet rules) Evidence: phone375__19-Create.png: the highlighted 'Event' row spans x=4-371 (4px inset, not 16), and 'Out of office' ends at y=786 with no bottom safe-area padding. The sheet is only 3 options tall, while Google iOS offers Event, Task, Working location, Out of office, Focus time and Birthday

items.title: Event detail: a pencil icon and a big Edit button do the same thing
items.detail: Two primary actions break 'one primary action per area'. Google shows the pencil only, with the rest in the ... menu Fix: Drop the bottom bar (or the top pencil). Show the reminder, guests and description as real values, or leave them out when empty instead of four 'Add ...' prompts in read mode (src/mobile/calendar.css:1700-1706 (.ev-dp-edit) + event detail component) Evidence: phone375__06: a pencil at the top right (292,28) and a full-width 'Edit event' bar at the bottom. There is no delete, duplicate or RSVP visible, and 60% of the screen is empty | Round 4: The top pencil was already gone (one Edit bar). The read-mode 'Add guests' and 'Add a description' prompts are removed, so empty rows are left out. Delete, duplicate and copy are in the ⋮ menu.

items.title: Event detail in read mode is mostly 'Add ...' prompts
items.detail: A detail view should show facts. Google hides empty fields in view mode. Fix: Hide empty rows in view mode; show them in edit (event detail rows (.ad-icon rows) in the calendar event panel) Evidence: phone375__06: 'Add a place or a call link', 'No reminder', 'Add guests', 'Add a description' (4 of 5 rows are empty prompts)

items.title: Opening a task from Calendar opens the Tasks sheet with the wrong app behind it
items.detail: The app's context changes and the layout misaligns. Google Calendar opens a short task card in place. Fix: Open the task sheet over the Calendar, give 'Checks it' an icon or line it up as a sub-label, and put the add-chips in one horizontally scrolling row or a '+ Add' sheet (src/components/tasks/TaskDetail.tsx:219 ('Checks it' row) and the task sheet layout) Evidence: phone375__09: the title 'Tasks' shows behind the sheet at y=24. The 'Checks it' caption starts at x=48 with no icon, out of line with every other row, and the chip buttons (Description, Repeat...) wrap 2+2+1 | Round 4: App.tsx: Calendar's onOpenTask now calls setTaskOpen, so the global TaskDrawer opens over the Calendar and the app no longer switches to Tasks. The 'Checks it' label and the chip wrap were already fixed.

items.title: An event sits under the top bar and New Year's sits under the tab bar
items.detail: The start scroll position hides a past event behind the top bar with no fade or gap. At the bottom, the + button and tab bar cover content. Fix: Use scroll-margin-top: 52px when auto-scrolling to today, and pad the end by the tab bar plus 72 (src/mobile/calendar.css:866-868 (.sch padding-bottom: var(--fab-space))) Evidence: report.json covered: 'Pick up kids 15:00 to 15:45 sits under mobile-top', and 'New Year's Day' under the tabbar. In phone375__00 'January 2027' is half under the + button and the tab bar

items.title: The audit's 'Mark done' taps marked tasks done, and there was no confirmation or undo
items.detail: The check sits right next to the title tap area, so it is easy to hit by accident, and no Undo toast showed up in the screenshots Fix: Show an Undo toast after completing a task, and widen the check target to 44x44 (src/mobile/calendar.css:950-960 (.ev-check 40x32 with ::after inset -6px 0)) Evidence: phone375__19 and phone375dark__00: both tasks are struck through after the auto-tap on their 32px check circles

items.title: iPad 768: the sidebar is a strip of bare checkboxes with no labels
items.detail: You cannot tell what the checkboxes mean. Google iPad shows a full list or nothing. Fix: At 768, hide the rail and use the drawer, or show the labelled sidebar. Pad the top of the grid by 8px (src/mobile/calendar.css (no ipad rule for the collapsed .sb-panel)) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: x=110-135 holds 6 coloured checkboxes, a globe, a + and 'EB'/'TR' avatars, none labelled, next to a 3-day grid that starts at 07:00 with a clipped '07:00' label | Round 4: Calendar and teammate checkbox lists (.cal-list) are hidden in the collapsed sidebar, so the rail no longer shows unlabelled dots. The open-sidebar toggle stays.

items.title: Features missing compared with Google Calendar iOS
items.detail: People expect Month on a phone to show short event titles, and expect search Fix: Add a search icon to the top bar, show 1-2 truncated chips per day in Month, and let people swipe left and right in Day/3 days (src/App.tsx:4343-4348 (bar has only Schedule/Month), src/mobile/calendar.css month grid) Evidence: Phone screenshots show no search, no week-number or 'jump to date' sheet beyond the title, no swipe between days, no all-day strip in Day view, no birthdays, Month view has only dots (phone375__17) instead of event chips | Won't fix: Month on phones is deliberately iOS Calendar style (dots plus the picked day's list under the grid). Day and 3-day already swipe (onStep) and have the all-day band. Calendar search is listed separately as a new feature.

items.title: Project page cards sit on a 12 px gutter while the header row uses 16
items.detail: The system gutter is 16. The left edges don't line up, so the page looks shifted. Fix: Give .project-pane's phone body padding-inline 16 (or margin-inline 4px on .proj-sections and .needs-card) so the cards line up with the header. (src/mobile/projects.css:34 (.proj-sections has no margin; inherits the pane's 12 px padding)) Evidence: pj.mjs measured .proj-sections x=12 w=351 and photo button x=16; phone375__04-S-Supplements-brand.png shows card edges 4 px outside the S tile and back arrow

items.title: Section rows are padded unevenly and the icon tile is 30x32 instead of square
items.detail: The icon isn't square, the 12 px inset doesn't match the 16 px tbr rows in the list one screen back, and the divider lines up with nothing measured. Fix: Use padding 0 12px 0 16px, a 32x32 tile (or a 24 icon with no tile, like Basecamp), and put the divider at 16+32+12=60, the same as .tbr-row. (src/mobile/projects.css:48, 60, 72-73) Evidence: Measured .proj-sec-icon 30x32 at x=25; rows padding 8px 12px, but the divider is placed at left:52 by hand

items.title: Header row on the project page is cramped: status pill is only 8 px from the photo and the avatar sits hard against the add-person icon
items.detail: The photo, status and people sit jammed together with uneven gaps, and the card below is jammed under the header: the 'pill jammed under header' problem again. Fix: Use gap 12, make the people button a 44 tap target with 8 px between the avatar stack and the add icon, and add 16 px between the header row and the first card. (src/mobile/projects.css:20-28) Evidence: photo [16,66,40,40], status [64,64,85,44]: an 8 px gap. Avatar 24 px at x=301 with the add-person icon about 4 px right of it (phone375__04). The row is 69 px tall with no space to the attention card below (card top at y=125, header ends at 121)

items.title: Avatar initials render at 9.12px
items.detail: Labels must be at least 12 px, and the avatar sizes on the system scale are 24/32/40/56. Fix: On phones, use 32 px avatars with 13 px initials in .proj-people. (src/mobile/projects.css:25 (.proj-people uses the 20 px desktop avatar-stack)) Evidence: report.json tiny-text '9.12px "EB"' and '"JC"' in header.tasks-head .avatar-stack

items.title: Project list is a bare name list and loses everything the iPad card shows
items.detail: Basecamp iOS's Home shows each project with its recent activity, and on a phone you can't tell which project needs you. The .proj-card phone rules in projects.css:137-158 are dead code. Fix: Use 64 px two-line rows: the name, then 'Next: Launch bundle landing page · Tomorrow' or 'On track · updated 3d' in 13/400 text-3, with the owner avatar on the right. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:117-126 (row() gives a hint only when something is late, waiting or not picked up)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png shows only a tile and a name. ipad768__00-start.png shows the next deadline, On track, the owner avatar and 'Updated 3 days ago' | Round 4: BrowseRow takes an optional sub line (src/components/tasks/TasksBrowse.tsx). Phone rows in ProjectsHome show 'Next: <task>, <day>', or 'Updated <when>' / 'No activity yet', as 64px two-line rows (src/mobile/projects.css). Checked on a 375 screenshot. The owner avatar was not added.

items.title: List card is white on a white page, so the group card can't be seen
items.detail: With no edge, each section header and row floats. The 16 px card inset becomes a strange 32 px text indent with no visible reason. Fix: Use a surface-2 page background behind the grouped cards (iOS inset-grouped), or drop the card and put the rows at the 16 px gutter. (src/mobile/tasks.css:1355-1359) Evidence: Measured .tbr-card background rgb(255,255,255) and page background transparent/white; pj-list.png shows no card edge and no divider with a single row

items.title: Tile touched the name in the audit screenshots (the tile slot was squeezed to 24 px)
items.detail: The base slot is 24 px but holds a 32 px tile, so it overflows into the gap whenever the override is missing or loads late. Fix: Make IconTile rows render .tbr-icon.is-tile with width 32 explicitly, without relying on :has. (src/mobile/tasks.css:1388-1394 (.tbr-icon width var(--icon-m)) overridden only by src/mobile/projects.css:173 using :has) Evidence: In phone375__00-start.png and phone375dark__00-start.png the 'S' tile touches 'Supplements brand' (text at x=64). The live run measures tile [32..64] and label x=76, so the fix depends on :has()

items.title: Dark mode screenshot is identical to light
items.detail: Either the app ignores the system dark setting or the saved theme overrides it, so phones in dark mode get a glaring white app. Fix: Default the theme to 'system' and check that the :root dark tokens apply under emulated dark mode. (src/tokens.css (the dark tokens under prefers-color-scheme are not applied when the saved theme is 'light' in .auth.json; check the theme override)) Evidence: phone375dark__00-start.png has a white background and black text; it is pixel-identical to phone375__00-start.png

items.title: New project sheet has misaligned insets and too few options
items.detail: The left edges don't line up. Basecamp's New project asks for a name and a description, then lets you invite people and pick tools or a template. Fix: Set padding 0 16 on the field and the select row and inset the divider by 16. Add a description, 'Invite people' (PeoplePicker) and 'Start from a template'. (src/mobile/projects.css:183-197; src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:94-95) Evidence: phone375__10-New-project.png: the title is at x=16, the name field text at x=12, 'No type' at x=15, and the divider runs 4 px to 371. It offers only a name and a type | Round 4: Insets already 16 px; sheet now also has 'More options' (email domain). Templates are offered from the new project's Manage section, people from its header

items.title: Disabled Add button is a full-width pale green bar that looks broken
items.detail: It reads as a broken button. iOS puts Add in the sheet header's top-right and greys it out until there is a name. Fix: Move Add to the sheet header's right, or use a neutral surface-2 background for the disabled state. (src/mobile/projects.css:193-197) Evidence: phone375__10-New-project.png: the Add button at y=756 is washed-out green with white text, low contrast | Round 4: Disabled Add in the new-project sheet uses neutral surface-2 / text-3 (src/mobile/projects.css)

items.title: 'Needs attention' card takes up space with nothing in it
items.detail: The rules say screens answer 'what do I need to do now?' and avoid filler. An empty card pushes the actual tools down. Fix: On phones, hide the card when items is empty, or collapse it to a single 'All clear' line in the header. (src/components/TasksView.tsx:925-938) Evidence: phone375__04 and phone375__05: an 84 px card saying 'Nothing needs you for Lereng Coffee.' pushes 13 rows below the fold (End work is off-screen at y=788+)

items.title: 13 section rows in one long card, unordered, with no counts
items.detail: Basecamp shows a few tools as tiles with previews such as unread counts and the next event. Here every tool weighs the same and needs a tap to find out anything. Fix: Show .proj-sec-note on each row (open tasks, late count, unread chat, next meeting), list the most-used tools first, and move Workload, Quotes and Logins under 'More'. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:95-120) Evidence: pj-bottom.png: Tasks, Workload, Quotes, Chat, Mail, Meetings, Files, Notes, Tables, Logins, Guests, then a template row and End work, with no notes or counts on any row

items.title: Template and End work sit in the main list, and End work is one tap from destructive
items.detail: Basecamp keeps archive and trash in the '...' project menu. A red row in the main list draws the eye and invites mistakes. Fix: Move Start from a template and End work into a '...' TopBarButton ActionSheet. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:115) Evidence: pj-bottom.png: the 'End work' danger row is at the bottom of the scroll, within easy reach of a stray tap

items.title: On the Tasks screen the project name is truncated by a three-icon pill
items.detail: The sub-screen title should name the part ('Tasks'). The project name gets cut and the extra buttons crowd the bar. Fix: Title the screen 'Tasks' with the project as a 13 px subtitle, and keep only '...' in the top bar. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx (top bar actions for the tasks part) / src/mobile/TopBar.tsx) Evidence: pj-tasks.png: the title 'Supplement...' is cut at x=170 by a 140 px pill with people, view and '...' icons | Won't fix: A project now opens on its tasks as its home screen, so the project name is the right title there. The parts and the overview are pushed from the '...' menu.

items.title: Tasks list has no late or overdue grouping and no counts
items.detail: The task 'see what is late' is a dead end: neither the list nor the project row shows it. Basecamp to-dos show overdue dates in red. Fix: Show past due dates in var(--danger) and add an 'Overdue' group at the top when there are any. (src/components/TasksView.tsx (phone group rendering)) Evidence: pj-tasks.png: groups 'To do' and 'In progress', 'Monday' in grey, nothing marked late

items.title: Status sheet rows are inset differently from the title
items.detail: The left edges don't line up and the selected state is a box inside the sheet. Fix: Put titles and rows at 16 px, use full-bleed rows with a check and no tinted box. (src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx option list styles (grouped.css)) Evidence: pj-status.png: the 'Status' title is at x=19, row text at x=21, the selected row background is at x=11; the sheet has no Done or close button

items.title: Status picker trigger is 85x44 with an uneven grey box on tap
items.detail: The text sits off-centre in the pressed box (11 px left, 16 px right). Fix: Show status as a pill (12/600) on the name's line, with even 12 px padding. (src/mobile/projects.css:29 (the .client-status button keeps its desktop ghost style)) Evidence: pj-status.png: the Active button turns into a grey 85x44 block with the text at x=75 while the box starts at x=64

items.title: Drawer: chips are 21 px tall and project rows 36 px
items.detail: These are below the 44 px tap target and the 12 px minimum label size. Fix: In the phone drawer, use 44 px nav rows, 32 px chips with 44 px hit areas, and 24 px tiles with 12 px letters. (src/system.css .type-chips / .nav-item (no phone override in src/mobile/projects.css)) Evidence: report.json small-tap-target: chips 33x21, 54x21, 62x21; nav-items 304x36; the client-dot letter is 10.5px. phone375__01-Open-menu.png | Round 4: Nav rows already 44 px; Projects drawer type chips now 32 px tall with a 44 px hit area (src/mobile/projects.css)

items.title: Drawer header has no padding, and the Settings pill is jammed against the right edge
items.detail: The edges are uneven at 12 and 8 px instead of 16, and the floating shadow card looks like a bug. Fix: Use 16 px padding throughout and a flat selected row background instead of a shadowed card. (src/system.css .sb-panel / drawer header (phone styles in src/mobile/shell.css)) Evidence: phone375__01: the Settings pill ends at x=296 of a 304 drawer (8 px), 'Projects' sits at x=12, and the 'All projects' row's shadow card overlaps the 'Projects' label gap

items.title: Drawer duplicates the bottom tabs and the main list
items.detail: There are two navigation systems for one list, and the drawer's Client/Internal filter isn't available from the main screen. Fix: Drop the drawer on phones and put the type filter in the title menu (Active ▾). (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx onMenu, src/mobile/chrome.ts useSidebarDrawer) Evidence: The drawer lists All projects, filters and the same two projects; the bottom tabs are Active, Mine, Past | Won't fix: Phones use the hamburger menu, which is the app's sidebar drawer, together with the bottom tabs and the Apps tab. That is the shell pattern for every app, so the Projects drawer stays.

items.title: Search scope chips run off-screen and repeat 'Projects'
items.detail: Two chips named 'Projects' is confusing, and the 'Files' chip runs off the edge with no fade to hint that the row scrolls. Fix: Remove the duplicate scope, add a scroll fade, and make the chips 44 px hit areas. (palette chips (src/components/CommandPalette*.tsx .palette-chips)) Evidence: phone375__03: chips are All apps, Projects (selected), People, Projects, F... cut off at x=375; chips are 32 px tall

items.title: Past empty state is a plain grey sentence at a 28 px inset
items.detail: The compact form is meant for inside cards. A full screen needs the full EmptyState, centred, with an icon. Fix: Use the non-compact EmptyState with an Archive icon, the title 'No past projects' and text at 16 px insets. (src/components/PastClients.tsx:56 (EmptyState compact)) Evidence: phone375__08-Past.png: 12 px text at x=28, no icon or title, and the rest of the screen is blank

items.title: Mine looks identical to Active
items.detail: A whole tab that shows the same thing looks broken. Basecamp uses pins/favorites instead. Fix: Show pinned or owned projects with an empty state explaining how to pin, or replace the tab with 'Pinned'. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx (Mine filter)) Evidence: phone375__07-Mine.png shows the same two rows and groups as phone375__00 | Won't fix: Mine is a real filter (projects you are a member of). It only matches Active in the demo because James is on both projects.

items.title: Missing Basecamp-style features: activity feed, schedule, pinning, project colours/descriptions
items.detail: Basecamp iOS users expect Activity ('what changed'), a Schedule and pinned projects. Here you have to open each tool to find out what changed. Fix: Add an 'Activity' row (latest 5 events) to the top of the project home, long-press to pin on list rows (useActionMenu), and an optional description line. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:95-120, src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:117) Evidence: No Activity or Schedule section in the project's section list (pj-bottom.png), no pin action on rows, no description under the name | Left: Pinning projects and a per-project activity feed are new features. They need data-model and API work in the Projects area, which another agent owns. Last activity already shows on the project cards.

items.title: Display sheet: section labels at x20, rows at x32, cards invisible
items.detail: In light theme --bg and --surface are both white, so the grouped cards that are supposed to explain the 12px inset disappear; the result reads as three random left edges Fix: Give .ds-sheet a grouped background (var(--surface-2)/page grey) so cards show, or drop cards and align labels and rows on the 16 gutter; set .ds-plab margin-left 16px to match row text (src/mobile/tasks.css:1455 (.ds-sheet background var(--bg)) with 1511 (.ds-plab margin 16px 4px) and 1519 (.ds-card background var(--surface))) Evidence: audit/mobile/tasks/phone375__02-Layout-and-display.png: 'Layout/Sort/Filter' labels start at x=20, row text at x=32, list/board tiles at x=28; no visible card edge

items.title: Display sheet header jammed against first label
items.detail: Header and content collide; 12px side padding breaks the 16 gutter Fix: padding 0 16px on .ds-phead, first label margin-top 16px (src/mobile/tasks.css:1460-1471 (.ds-phead padding 0 12px, margin-bottom 4px) and 1514 (.ds-pbody > .ds-plab:first-child margin-top 4px)) Evidence: phone375__02: header buttons end at y~90, 'Layout' label at y~100 (about 4px gap); X button sits 10px from the left edge

items.title: Side drawer header has no padding and a pill clipped at the top
items.detail: Exactly the 'drawer header with no padding' complaint; looks unfinished Fix: 16px top/side padding on the workspace row, settings as a 44px icon button inside the gutter, 8px gap below (src/mobile/shell.css:418-512 (.ws-panel/.ws-row/.ws-settings)) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png: workspace logo at y=8 touching status area, 'Settings' pill butts the drawer right edge (x~296 of 304) and top; 'Tasks' heading then 'My tasks' with no rhythm

items.title: Drawer active item is a floating shadowed card overlapping its neighbours
items.detail: Selected state should be a tinted fill inside the gutter, not a lifted card; it breaks the edge and reads as a glitch Fix: On phones: .nav-item.active { background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow:none; margin:0 8px; border-radius:10px } (src/mobile/shell.css nav-item active state (no phone override; desktop .nav-item.active shadow leaks), see .mobile-list .nav-item at shell.css:516) Evidence: phone375__01: 'Today' highlight is a white card with drop shadow spanning from x=0 to beyond the drawer edge, covering half of 'My tasks' row

items.title: Drawer nav rows 36px tall, below the 44 tap minimum
items.detail: CLAUDE.md requires var(--tap) on phones; Todoist iOS rows are 44+ Fix: Apply min-height: var(--row-1) to .sb-panel .nav-item under the phone media query (src/mobile/shell.css:516 only sizes .mobile-list .nav-item; the drawer .sb-panel .nav-item keeps the desktop 36px) Evidence: report.json: 12 nav-items measured 304x36 / 304x34 (My tasks ... Web & systems)

items.title: Upcoming day headings indented 16px past their own rows
items.detail: Heading, empty line and rows sit on three different left edges Fix: Zero the h3's inner padding so the heading sits at the 16 gutter like rows (src/mobile/tasks.css:510-512 (.ucal-dhead padding-left var(--gutter)) stacked on .t-heading padding from src/tasks.css:1099) Evidence: phone375__07-Upcoming.png: 'Thu 15 Oct · Today' and 'Sat 17 Oct' at x=32, but 'Nothing due today.' at x=16 and task rings at x=16

items.title: Upcoming: huge dead gaps between days, + not on heading line
items.detail: Agenda looks sparse and the add button floats; Todoist uses a tight sticky day header Fix: padding-top 24 once, align-items:center on .ucal-dhead, make headers sticky with a divider (src/mobile/tasks.css:510-513 (.ucal-dhead padding-top var(--sp-4) + min-height row-1) and src/tasks.css:1086 (.ucal-day padding-bottom)) Evidence: phone375__07: ~48px empty above each day heading (y 390->305? e.g. 'Lereng Coffee' meta y=393 to 'Mon 19 Oct' y=464); + icons at y=210/306/456 sit ~8px above the heading baseline

items.title: Task rows: project chip pushed to a right-aligned second line, title tap target 20px
items.detail: Eye has to jump across the row; Todoist keeps date left and project right on one meta line but the title itself is the full-row target Fix: Make the whole .trow-main the button (min-height row-2); keep meta on one line left-aligned with project after date (src/mobile/tasks.css:232-245 (.trow-title/.trow-meta) and trow-meta justify between date and project) Evidence: phone375__07: 'Lereng Coffee' flush right at x=359 on its own line under a two-line title; report.json small-tap-target 303x20 on .trow-title

items.title: Row dividers run to the screen edge on the right but start at 56 on the left; last row ends with no divider logic
items.detail: Inconsistent with the 16 gutter used by text; looks unaligned against the right-aligned project labels Fix: right: 0 is fine only if meta also bleeds; otherwise right:16px. Pick one rule consistent with other apps' lists (src/mobile/tasks.css:183-191 (row ::before left 56px right 0)) Evidence: phone375__08-My-tasks.png: divider between the two rows spans x=56..375 while content ends at 359 | Won't fix: Row dividers start at the text column (56) and run to the trailing edge, which is the iOS inset-list convention the other phone lists also use. The project label now sits on the meta line, so nothing looks misaligned.

items.title: Task detail: 'Checks it' label floats as a stray 12px caption between rows
items.detail: Breaks the icon+value rhythm; the eye icon row reads as 'James Carter' with an orphan caption above Fix: Hide the label on phones like the others, or render as a secondary line inside the row ('Checked by James Carter') (src/components/tasks/TaskDetail.tsx:219 (label 'Checks it' rendered) vs src/mobile/tasks.css:858 comment 'no labels') Evidence: audit/agents/tk-detail.png: 'Checks it' at y=273, left x=48, wedged under the 'You' divider with no row of its own, while other rows have no labels

items.title: Task detail: empty-field chips wrap into 3 rows instead of one scrolling strip
items.detail: Unbalanced orphan chip and 150px of chips; Todoist puts these in a single toolbar row Fix: flex-wrap: nowrap on .tdp-chips in the phone layer (src/mobile/tasks.css:980-987 says one sideways row; a wrap rule wins (tdp-chips has flex-wrap from desktop src/tasks.css)) Evidence: tk-detail.png: Description/Repeat, Reminder/Followers, Checklist in 3 ragged rows (y 499-603), Checklist alone on its own line

items.title: Task detail: field dividers start at 48 and bleed to the right edge, priority row has no visual weight difference
items.detail: Title, values and dividers on three edges (60/48/52) Fix: Single value column (56) for title, values and divider start (src/mobile/tasks.css:871-878 (left 52px comment says 16+24+12=52) vs title at .tdp > .td-title-row line 779) Evidence: tk-detail.png: dividers x=48..375; icons at x=16-34, value text at x=48; title text at x=60 (not on 48 or 56)

items.title: Quick add: send button 36px and date chip strip clipped with no fade
items.detail: Primary action smaller than tap size visually; cut chip looks like a bug rather than a scroller Fix: 44px send button; add ::after end spacer + mask fade on .qa-chips like .tdp-chips (system.css:231) (src/mobile/tasks.css:705-711 (.qa-send 36px) and 596-608 (.qa-chips)) Evidence: audit/agents/tk-add.png: send circle 36x36 at bottom right; 4th chip cut at x=347-375 with no gradient; desc field 30px tall (report: 375x30 'Description')

items.title: Quick add has fewer options than Todoist iOS
items.detail: Todoist users expect reminders and labels at creation; here they must open the task after saving Fix: Add Reminder and Labels chips plus a '...' chip opening the full field list (src/components/tasks/QuickAdd (chips list rendered in .qa-chips) / src/mobile/tasks.css:588) Evidence: tk-add.png chips: Date, Assignee, Priority, one more; no Reminder, Labels, Deadline, Duration, Location, subtask, or '...' overflow; no inline priority 'p1' hint row

items.title: Today empty state copy points elsewhere and has no 'add task' action
items.detail: Answers the wrong question; Todoist's Today shows overdue tasks and a calm 'All clear' plus add Fix: Show overdue section on Today; empty copy 'Nothing due today' + 'Add a task' primary (src/components/tasks (Today view EmptyState usage)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: 'Reviews, replies and requests waiting on you are in Needs you on Home. Plan ahead in Upcoming.' and only link 'See Upcoming'; overdue/this-week items exist in My tasks | Round 4: The Today empty state now says 'Nothing due today' / 'Nothing late either. Plan ahead in Upcoming.' and has a primary New task button plus the See Upcoming link. Today already includes overdue tasks.

items.title: Top bar icons change per tab, so the right cluster jumps
items.detail: Uneven, unstable chrome; layout toggle also duplicates More > Display Fix: Drop the layout icon from the bar (it lives in Display); keep more+search fixed on every tab (src/mobile/TopBar.tsx usage in tasks views (useTitleMenu/TopBarButton per view)) Evidence: phone375__00 shows 3 icons (layout, more, search); phone375__07 shows 2 (more, search); phone375__09 shows 1 (search) - icons shift x positions 260/305/349

items.title: Search scope chips run off screen and are 32px tall
items.detail: Below tap minimum and no end gutter on the strip Fix: min-height 44 hit area (::before), scroll-padding and ::after spacer 16px (src/mobile/shell.css:1078-1125 (.palette-chips)) Evidence: phone375__04-Search-Tasks.png: 'Files' chip cut at x=375; chips 32px tall (report.json 71x32 etc.)

items.title: More popover items 36px; popover detached far from edge
items.detail: CLAUDE.md: popovers become bottom sheets on phones; 36px targets Fix: Use ActionSheet on phones (rows 48) (src/mobile/kit.css:216 (.pop .as-item)) Evidence: phone375__03-More.png: Display/Brain dump 226x36; with only two items this should be a bottom sheet per CLAUDE.md

items.title: Browse: content inset 32px from screen edge, '+' touching section label
items.detail: Double inset wastes 32px for cards nobody can see; differs from the 16 gutter of every other tab Fix: Either show the grouped card background or drop the 16px group margin (src/mobile/tasks.css:1330 (.tbr-group margin 16) + 1340 (.tbr-head padding-left 16) + 1350 (.tbr-card background surface)) Evidence: phone375__09-Browse.png: row icons at x=32, headers 'Team/Projects' at x=32, card invisible (white on white); report 'Projects' touching 'New project' 0px

items.title: Browse: 'Past projects' greyed like disabled, 'Lead' badge floats right
items.detail: Looks non-tappable Fix: Normal text color with archive icon; badge as pill on name line (Badge component) (src/mobile/tasks.css:1405+ (.tbr-label / muted variant)) Evidence: phone375__09: 'Past projects' text text-3 color looks disabled; 'Lead' at x=290 next to chevron | Round 4: Past projects is no longer muted. The Lead status is now a Badge pill on the name line (new BrowseRow.badge in TasksBrowse) instead of a right-aligned hint.

items.title: Project screen: no sections add, no 'Add task' row; single To do header with stage dot
items.detail: Harder than Todoist: adding to a specific section requires FAB then choosing section Fix: Add an inline '+ Add task' row at the end of each group and an 'Add section' at list end (src/components/tasks project list view (group header) / src/mobile/tasks.css group head styles) Evidence: audit/agents/tk-proj.png: one 'To do' heading with a 6px ring, one task, then 500px blank; no inline 'Add task' under the section as Todoist has | Round 4: Phones, grouped by stage: each group ends with a '+ Add task' row (.t-add-row, 44px) that opens Quick add with that stage. Checked in light and dark (tk-r4-p-proj*.png). Add section is not included, because stages are managed in the Stages dialog.

items.title: Dark capture renders light
items.detail: Either dark mode doesn't follow the system setting or the audit didn't set it; can't verify dark here Fix: Make theme 'system' follow prefers-color-scheme or set data-theme in audit; re-check (theme application (data-theme on :root) not following prefers-color-scheme in tasks route; verify src/tokens.css dark block) Evidence: audit/mobile/tasks/phone375dark__00-start.png is pixel-identical light theme

items.title: iPad 768: header actions wrap 'Template' onto its own second line
items.detail: Unbalanced header, wasted height Fix: Move Template into the '...' menu below 900px pane width via container query (src/tasks.css tasks header (.tv-actions / head flex-wrap) without container query) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: 'Template' at y=89 under 'New task' row; header height doubles to 118px | Round 4: Template no longer shows outside projects, and Brain dump sits in the sidebar in Tasks. At 768 the Today header is one row (checked in tk-r4-i768 screenshots).

items.title: iPad: second icon-only sidebar column with unlabelled icons and colour squares
items.detail: Mystery meat navigation; Todoist iPad shows labelled sidebar Fix: Show labelled sidebar at >=1024; at 768 use the drawer like phones (src/mobile/shell.css:226 (.sb-resize / collapsed sidebar) for 768-1024) Evidence: ipad768__00 / ipad1024__00: column at x=122 with 12 bare icons and two coloured squares, no labels; plus app rail = 160px of chrome | Won't fix: The icon column at 768 is the user's own collapsed-sidebar state with an expand button and tooltips; the labelled sidebar comes back on expand

items.title: Header hamburger and title measured touching
items.detail: Mostly noise visually, but hamburger glyph at x=16 and title at 52 leaves the title optically loose versus Todoist Fix: Keep; add 4px gap so hit areas don't abut (src/mobile/shell.css:266 (.mobile-top) / system.css:23) Evidence: report.json every state: 0px between 'Open menu' and 'Tasks' (visually 44px button edge meets title at x=52)

items.title: Coming-up block is inset 16px more than Past meetings, so the home screen has two left edges
items.detail: Two sections on one screen start on different verticals, which is the most visible spacing fault on the first screen Fix: Drop the horizontal padding on .mh-up (padding: 0 0 8px) so both the heading and the rows sit on the 16px gutter (src/mobile/meet.css:225-227 (.mh-up padding: 0 16px 24px) on top of .mh-main padding 12px 16px (meet.css:143)) Evidence: audit/mobile/meet/phone375__00-start.png; measured: 'Tomorrow' h2 x=32, upcoming row x=16 with inner padding 16 so the icon sits at x=32; 'Past meetings' h2 x=16, past icon at x=16

items.title: 40px dead gap between Coming up and Past meetings
items.detail: Stacked margins make the list look broken in two; the gap is double the section rhythm used elsewhere Fix: Keep one 24px space: set .mh-up padding-bottom 0 (src/mobile/meet.css:226 and :114) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: upcoming row ends y=172, 'Past meetings' starts y=220 (48px gap: .mh-up 24 bottom padding plus .mh-head 24 top margin)

items.title: Section header says 'Tomorrow' instead of 'Coming up', and the row repeats 'Tomorrow'
items.detail: Redundant words push the useful part (who is attending) into an ellipsis Fix: When grouped by day, drop the day from the row subtitle: '10:00 to 10:30 · Thomas, Ethan' (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:36-40 (day label) used both as group heading and in the row subtitle around :148-152) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png and audit/agents/m-upcoming.png: header 'Tomorrow', subtitle 'Tomorrow · 10:00 to 10:30 · 2 ot...'

items.title: Upcoming row subtitle truncates at '2 ot...' on a 375 phone
items.detail: Attendees are what people scan for in Google Meet's upcoming list; here they are cut off Fix: Shorten subtitle (see above) and allow a second line of 13px meta (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:148-160; src/mobile/meet.css:155-165 (ellipsis)) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png: subtitle width 207px clipped at x=291 by the 52px mic button | Round 4: Upcoming rows show guests by first name instead of '2 others', and the subtitle can wrap to 2 lines (.mh-two).

items.title: No 'Join' action for an upcoming call; the event sheet's only button is 'Open in Calendar'
items.detail: Google Meet iOS and Read AI put a big Join button on every upcoming call; here you cannot join a meeting from Meet at all Fix: Add a primary 'Join' button (meetingLinkOf(e)) full width at the bottom, and the notetaker switch as a real toggle row; keep 'Open in Calendar' secondary (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:166-182) Evidence: phone375__03-Website-launch-check-in-Tomorr.png: sheet rows are plain text, single right-aligned text button 'Open in Calendar' | Round 4: Added a Join button and a notetaker switch to the event sheet; 'Open in Calendar' is the secondary button (same change as P101).

items.title: Event sheet body is indented 20px vs title 16px, and its lines have no icons or row height
items.detail: Misaligned edge and a list of facts with no structure; Calendar-style sheets use 48px rows with 20px icons Fix: Render as dr-rows (icon 56px column, 48px min height) aligned to the 16px gutter (src/mobile/meet.css:546-551 (.mhe-line padding 4px 16px inside an already padded body)) Evidence: phone375__03-...png: title x=16, detail lines x=20; lines are 28px tall plain text | Round 4: Event sheet lines are now 48px rows with icons: time, call, people and notetaker. Icons sit on the 16px gutter with text at 56.

items.title: Send notetaker sheet title truncates to 'Send noteta...' and Send button looks disabled
items.detail: A sheet's own title being cut is the definition of a cramped header Fix: Let the title take flex:1 with no ellipsis at 17/600, or shorten the label to 'Take notes'; show Send disabled state with clear contrast plus helper text (src/mobile/meet.css:249-256 (.tn-sheet > .sheet-head, .tn-title at fs-title) and MeetApp.tsx:1369) Evidence: audit/agents/m-fab.png: title clipped at ~x=165 while header has room; Send is a faded green pill

items.title: Send notetaker sheet mixes three alignments and divider styles
items.detail: Not on the 16 gutter; looks assembled from parts Fix: Put all headings, rows and the note on the 16px gutter, one divider rule inset from text (src/mobile/meet.css:258-262 (.tn-body .ad-heading padding-left 16 inside padded body)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-fab.png: headings at x=20, 'Paste' chip inside the link row, a full-bleed divider then icon rows at x=24 with 56px text column, footnote at x=20 | Round 4: The Take notes sheet body is offset by -4px so headings, calls and fields share the 16px gutter.

items.title: Meeting tabs are 32px chips with the 4th tab half off-screen
items.detail: Below the 44px tap rule and the sliced chip at x=345 reads as a bug; Read AI uses a full-width underlined segmented tab bar Fix: Use an equal-width underline tab bar (3 tabs, 48px), move 'Arrange tabs' into the ... menu (src/mobile/meet.css:402-416 and 442-446 (.meet-page .m-tabs)) Evidence: phone375__05-Supplements-brand-weekly-Wed-1.png; report: Summary 86x32, Action items 112x32, Transcript 88x32, 'Arrange tabs' runs past the edge

items.title: Meeting page leads with metadata rows; the summary starts below the fold
items.detail: Read AI and Google Meet notes open on the recap; folder/type/people are secondary Fix: Collapse facts into one meta line or a 'Details' row, put tabs and summary right under the title, player as a compact mini-player (src/mobile/meet.css:376-400 (.m-facts order 2, player order 3, tabs order 4)) Evidence: phone375__05-...png: 4 fact rows + 140px player, summary text begins at y=540 of 812 | Round 4: The phone meeting page now opens on the title, player, tabs and summary. The fact rows (folder, type, people) moved below the notes (order 7).

items.title: Action items: add-task is a box inside a box with an inner 'Add' button
items.detail: Violates 'no box inside a box'; Read AI uses a single '+ Add action item' row Fix: Use the .mt-add-row 48px '+ Add a task' row that opens the Sheet (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:848 (input) and its wrapper; src/mobile/meet.css:455-463 (.mt-add-row unused on this path)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-actions.png: grey rounded card 343x96 containing a field plus a separate pill 'Add' at bottom right | Round 4: On phones, Action items uses the 48px '+ Add a task' row, which opens a New task Sheet, instead of the boxed field with an Add button.

items.title: Action items have no assignee avatar, due control or swipe to complete
items.detail: Read AI and Otter show owner avatars and let you assign/share each item; here owner is text only Fix: Add PersonCell 24px avatar, SwipeRow complete/reassign, tap date to open DatePicker (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1004-1008 (.mtp-main)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-actions.png and m-tasks.png: plain ring + text + 'James Carter · 17 Oct' grey line | Round 4: Phone task rows show the owner's 24px avatar and swipe right to Mark done or Reopen, with an Undo toast (SwipeRow). The due date is still changed by tapping the row to open the task.

items.title: Tasks from meetings: group header double-indented to x=32
items.detail: Heading, add row and rows do not share an edge Fix: Remove the container margin or the padding so headers sit at 16 (src/mobile/meet.css:468-474 (.m-group-phone padding 24px 16px 8px inside a 16px-margined container)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-tasks.png; measured .m-group-phone x=16 w=343 with padding 16 -> text at x=32, while 'Add a task' sits at x=36 and the checkbox ring at x=36

items.title: Transcript lines are indented 24px with timestamps floating left, no avatars
items.detail: Off the 16 gutter; Read AI/Otter show a speaker avatar and tap-to-seek timestamps Fix: Avatar 32 + name 15/600 + time 12 on one line, text below aligned to the name, whole row taps to seek (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:855-865 (transcript list) and src/mobile/meet.css:423 (.meet-page .tl)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-transcript.png: '1:00' at x=24, speaker at x=74, text at x=24 | Round 4: Phone transcript lines show a 32px avatar, the name at 15/600 and the time on one line, with the text under the name. Rows have no inset and the whole row still seeks.

items.title: 'Keep:' row spreads label, value and storage text across the width
items.detail: Reads as three unrelated fragments; a setting belongs in a 48px settings row Fix: Make it one row 'Keep recording' with value and chevron, storage as secondary line; move under ... menu (src/mobile/meet.css:347-352, 418-421 (.keep-row)) Evidence: audit/agents/m-actions.png (Keep: at x=16, value at x=74, '470 MB of team storage' at x=216); ipad1024__12-...png Keep: x=365 and value x=478 | Round 4: The keep row is now one line of text ('Kept: Audio and notes · 470 MB of team storage'). Deleting moved to the More menu (same change as P104).

items.title: Drawer: header 'Meet' at x=12 while items at 16, and nav rows are 36px
items.detail: Under 44px tap targets and uneven heights (36 vs 34); letters on dots below 12px Fix: nav-item min-height var(--tap), dots 24px with 12px text, header padding 16 (src/mobile/calendar.css (AppDrawer styles, shared) .nav-item height; .client-dot font) Evidence: phone375__01-Open-menu.png; report: Meetings/Upcoming/... 304x36, Unfiled 304x34, client dots 10.5px text

items.title: Folders tab: dividers start at x=68 while text starts at x=48 and Meet settings sits inside the Projects group
items.detail: Divider must start at the text; settings is not a project Fix: Divider inset = 16+20+12 = 48 for icon rows; put Meet settings in its own group or in the top bar (src/mobile/meet.css:124-127 (inset 68px divider reused for 20px-icon rows)) Evidence: phone375__08-Folders.png: divider under 'Tasks from meetings' begins at 68, label at 48; 'Meet settings' follows Supplements brand with no section break

items.title: Meetings and Past tabs duplicate each other; tab bar does not earn four slots
items.detail: Google Meet iOS has Calls/Meetings; Read AI has Home/Search/Action items. A 'Tasks' tab is what people need here Fix: Tabs: Home (coming up + recent), Search, Action items, Folders (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:195-250) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png vs phone375__07-Past.png: both list the same past meeting; Folders mixes tasks and settings; Apps leaves Meet | Won't fix: A later decision replaced the phone tabs with Meetings/Past/Folders (the app's own bar in App.tsx), plus the shell's Apps tab. The four-tab layout this finding proposed no longer applies.

items.title: Past tab search placeholder clipped
items.detail: Clipped text Fix: Placeholder 'Search meetings' (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:219-226 placeholder; meet.css:50-56) Evidence: phone375__07-Past.png: 'Search meetings, notes and transcript' cut at the pill edge | Round 4: The search placeholder is now 'Search meetings'.

items.title: Global search scope chips are 32px and the last runs off-screen; result row icon not on gutter
items.detail: Tap targets under 44 and misaligned results Fix: Chips 32 visual with 44 hit area (padding-block), scroll padding-right 16, result icons at 16 (src/mobile/shell.css:1078-1125 (.palette-chips)) Evidence: phone375__02-Search-Meet.png; report: chips 52-76x32, 'Files' past the edge; result icon x=26 vs heading x=16

items.title: Dark mode never applied in the audit: page stays light under prefers-color-scheme dark
