items.detail: Dark mode has effectively not been checked for Meet Fix: Re-run the dark pass with theme set to System/Dark in storage and review (saved theme setting in audit/mobile/.auth.json / theme init in src/main.tsx forcing data-theme='light') Evidence: phone375dark__00-start.png is light; measured body bg rgb(255,255,255), html data-theme='light' with colorScheme dark | Won't fix: Audit setup, not an app bug: the test account saves Appearance = Light, which correctly overrides the system scheme; dark checked by forcing data-theme=dark

items.title: iPad 768: Meet sidebar collapses to an unlabeled icon rail beside the app rail; upcoming calls missing
items.detail: Two stacked rails are unreadable and the most useful info (next call) is absent on iPad Fix: At 768 hide the Meet rail behind a drawer or show labels; add the Coming up section to the desktop list (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:391-396 (desktop list, no upcoming section) and sidebar collapse rule) Evidence: ipad768__00-start.png: two icon rails (88px + 72px) with no labels, floating green bot pill; list shows only the past meeting, no Coming up, 600px empty | Round 4: The desktop and iPad Meetings list now starts with an Upcoming section: the next 3 calls with a link and See all. The second icon rail at 768 is the shared shell's collapsed sidebar, used by every app, so it was left as is.

items.title: FAB covers bottom-right content and duplicates the drawer's Send notetaker
items.detail: An unlabeled robot icon is unclear; Read AI uses a labeled 'Add to live meeting' button Fix: Extended FAB with label 'Take notes' that shrinks on scroll (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:223 useCreateAction) Evidence: phone375__00-start.png FAB 56x56 at (303,672) above tab bar; bot icon has no label | Won't fix: The create button is the shared phone shell's icon-only FAB, set through useCreateAction with the label 'Take notes' for assistive tech. The duplicate in the drawer no longer exists because the drawer is gone. An extended FAB would change the shell for every app.

items.title: Catch up pill jammed 4px under the top bar
items.detail: The pill sits glued to the 52px bar while the gap below it to 'Direct messages' is ~32px, so the top looks cramped and the rhythm is uneven. Fix: padding: 8px 16px 16px (or 12px top) so the pill has the same breathing room as section headers. (src/mobile/chat.css:90 (.chat-tiles padding: 4px 16px 8px)) Evidence: audit/mobile/chat/phone375__00-start.png; report: 4px between top bar and 'Catch up' on every phone375/430 state

items.title: Activity filter chips touch the top bar (0px)
items.detail: Chips sit flush against the header; it reads as broken spacing, the exact 'pill jammed under the header' problem. Fix: padding: 8px 16px; also give chips min-height var(--tap) hit area via ::after (system.css:255 pattern) since they are 32px tall. (src/mobile/chat.css:483 (.act-chips padding: 0 16px 8px)) Evidence: audit/mobile/chat/phone375__14-Activity.png; report: 0px between top bar and 'All' (also phone430)

items.title: Composer has 4px bottom padding, toolbar hugs the screen edge
items.detail: Unbalanced (12 top, 4 bottom) and on devices without a safe-area inset the buttons sit on the edge; Slack iOS leaves clear space under the toolbar. Fix: padding: 8px 12px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)). (src/mobile/chat.css:1042 (.composer.is-phone padding: 12px 12px 4px)) Evidence: audit/agents/c-b-channel.png, c-e-dm.png: + / Aa / emoji / @ row ends at y=804 of 812 (8px from edge); top padding is 12px

items.title: Send and schedule buttons are 38x32 and 26x32
items.detail: The single most important button in a chat app is below the 44px rule; the 26px chevron sits right next to it, so mis-taps schedule instead of send. Fix: Make send a 44x44 round button; move 'Schedule' to long-press on send (already supported) and drop the split chevron on phones, as Slack iOS does. (src/mobile/chat.css:1149-1165 (.cmp-split > button height 32px, .cmp-split-send width 38px, .cmp-split-later width 26px)) Evidence: measured: 'Send' 38x32 at (299,766), 'Schedule for later' 26x32 at (337,766)

items.title: DM intro avatar initials drawn in grey on teal
items.detail: Selector meant for the job title also recolours the avatar, so initials are near-invisible. Fix: Give the title its own class (e.g. .csd-title) in Conversation.tsx:570 and target that instead of > span. (src/mobile/chat.css:1798 (.chat-start-dm > span { color: var(--text-3) } also matches the Avatar span from Conversation.tsx:568)) Evidence: audit/agents/c-e-dm.png: 56px hero avatar shows faint grey 'EB' while the header avatar shows white 'EB'

items.title: iPad channel rail is unlabeled icons: two identical '#' you can't tell apart

items.title: Tapping a person's avatar opens a profile card
items.detail: Reference: Slack, Teams, Google: tapping an avatar opens a profile card with name, title, team, email, local time, status, and Message, Call and Schedule buttons. Today: Avatars on Home are just pictures inside row buttons. In the Waiting card, the avatar sits inside the button that opens the thread (src/components/HomeView.tsx:599-600). Workload avatars do nothing (HomeView.tsx:468), and brief and task owner avatars do nothing either (HomeView.tsx:548, 713). Proposal: Add a shared PersonCard: a popover on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones. It shows the avatar, name, title, team, email, local time and status, with Message as the one main button and Call or Email as smaller icons. Every Avatar becomes its own button that stops the click from reaching the row, so tapping the face opens the profile and tapping the text still opens the item. (effort medium)

items.title: Workload rows lead nowhere
items.detail: Reference: Asana and Monday workload views: clicking a person opens a filtered list of their tasks. Today: Workload rows are plain divs with no click handler (HomeView.tsx:467). Proposal: Make each row a button that opens Tasks filtered to that person, with the late tasks shown first. A long press, or the avatar, opens the PersonCard. (effort small) | Built: Each Workload row is now a button (.load-go, at least 44px tall, hover background). It opens Tasks filtered to that person through the existing openTasks({kind:'person'}) scope. The avatar still opens the PersonCard. Changes: new onOpenPerson prop in src/components/HomeView.tsx, wired in src/App.tsx (one added line), CSS in src/home.css, Indonesian string 'Open tasks of {name}' in src/i18n/id/home

items.title: No reply or archive straight from Home
items.detail: Reference: Gmail and Outlook widgets and Slack Activity let you swipe to archive or mark done, and give you a quick-reply box. Today: Waiting rows can only open the thread (HomeView.tsx:599). Notices can only open (HomeView.tsx:622). Proposal: Phones: swipe left to mark read or done, swipe right to snooze. Desktop: a hover action. Keep opening the item as the one main tap. (effort medium) | Built: In the For you card on desktop, each notice row has a CheckCheck 'Mark as seen' icon button that appears on hover or keyboard focus and calls onReadNotices. The same row is wrapped in SwipeRow with a 'Seen' end swipe for touch. Opening the item stays the row's main tap. The phone Needs you list already had swipe actions (Done/Approve, Tomorrow, Seen) through NeedsList.

items.title: No Join button on meetings starting soon
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 home show a Join button on a meeting about 5 minutes before it starts. Today: Home events open the calendar entry (HomeView.tsx:577). The MeetingStrip handles bot and notetaker actions (HomeView.tsx:1008), not a one-tap join. Proposal: When a meeting is within 10 minutes, its row's main action becomes Join, with a countdown chip, on both Home and the phone Launcher. (effort small) | Built: New JoinSoon component in src/components/home/HomeParts.tsx. For a meeting with a link, from 10 minutes before the start until the end, it shows a countdown chip ('in N min', or 'On now' once started) and a primary Join button. It refreshes every 30 seconds and animates in, with a reduced-motion fallback. It is used in three places: the phone Launcher under the greeting (src/mobile/Launcher.tsx; t

items.title: Recent items are too few and can't be pinned
items.detail: Reference: Microsoft 365 home and Notion: recent files and pages with pin or favourite, plus a 'Shared with me' filter. Today: The Launcher shows only 3 recents (src/mobile/Launcher.tsx:161-167), with no pinning and no 'See all'. Desktop Home has no recents card. Proposal: Add a Recents card with pinned items on top and 'See all', available on desktop too. Long press to pin. (effort medium)

items.title: Search shows no suggestions before you type
items.detail: Reference: Google, Microsoft 365 and Notion search open with recent searches, people you work with and recent files already listed. Today: The search bar only opens the command palette (HomeView.tsx:998). On phones, the Launcher search does the same (Launcher.tsx:120). Proposal: Before you type, show recent queries, the 5 people you work with most (tap opens their PersonCard) and the last few files. (effort medium)

items.title: Tasks can't be snoozed or rescheduled inline
items.detail: Reference: Todoist and Microsoft To Do: swipe to reschedule to Today, Tomorrow or Next week. Today: A task row has only Done and Open (HomeView.tsx:347-348). Proposal: Swipe, or a hover button on desktop, opens a date chip sheet: Today, Tomorrow, Next week. (effort small)

items.title: Home is missing birthdays, out-of-office and new joiners
items.detail: Reference: Teams and Workplace show who's out today, birthdays and new joiners. Today: Home has no people-presence card. The Workload card lists load only (HomeView.tsx:460-478). Proposal: Add an optional 'Who's out today' card that reads leave and calendar data. Tapping a person opens their PersonCard. (effort medium)

items.title: No way to see who's online
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Teams show green or away presence dots on avatars. Today: The Avatar component shows no presence (used at HomeView.tsx:468, 600). Proposal: Add a presence dot prop to Avatar, fed by the status from the status-setting gap above. (effort small)

items.title: Mail rows don't show when the message arrived or what it says
items.detail: Reference: The Gmail widget shows the time and a snippet for each message. Today: Waiting rows show only the sender and subject (HomeView.tsx:601-604). Proposal: Add a relative time ('2h') and a one-line snippet, and mark messages that mention you. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping a sender's avatar or name opens their contact card, not a fold
items.detail: Reference: Gmail on phone: tapping the sender's photo in an open email opens a contact card with name, email, phone, company, title, and Email, Chat, Meet, Schedule, Add to contacts. On desktop, hovering the name shows the same card. Superhuman keeps a right-hand sidebar with the sender's role, company, LinkedIn/X, recent threads and local time. Today: The avatar and the name both just fold the message. On desktop, src/components/Reader.tsx:557-558 puts the Avatar inside the message-head button, which calls toggle(m.id). On phones, Reader.tsx:968-970 gives the avatar a 'Fold this message' button, and :971-973 does the same for the name. No person card or hover card component exists anywhere in src (searched for HoverCard, PersonCard and ProfileCard: nothing found). Proposal: Build one shared PersonCard: a bottom sheet on phones and a popover on desktop (hover after 400ms or click). It shows the avatar, name, title and company (from the workspace directory or Contacts.tsx data), email, phone, local time, and presence for teammates. The primary button is 'Email'. Secondary buttons: Chat (teammates), Call/Meet, 'Emails with {name}', 'Add to contacts' or 'Edit', and Block. Open it from the reader avatar and name, recipient names in the 'to' details, compose recipient chips, Contacts rows and Chat. Folding stays on the rest of the message header. (effort medium) | Built: On phones, tapping the sender's name in an open email now opens their person card, the same way the avatar already did. The rest of the header still folds the message. To make the name tappable, the name link sits above the line's fold hit area and has its own 44px reach (CSS rule appended to mailExtras.css). File: src/components/Reader.tsx (gm-msg-name).

items.title: Recipient names and compose chips do nothing when tapped
items.detail: Reference: Gmail: in an open email, tapping a recipient in the 'to me' details opens their card. In compose, tapping a chip lets you edit the address or open the contact card, and you can drag a chip between To, Cc and Bcc. Superhuman: Cmd+Shift+B moves the selected recipients to Bcc ('Instant Intro'). Today: src/components/RecipientInput.tsx:53-58 renders each chip as a plain span. The only button on it is the X that removes the recipient, so you can't fix a typo or move the person to Cc or Bcc. The 'to' line in the reader is joined text (Reader.tsx:566-572) with no tappable names. Proposal: Make each chip a button that opens a small menu: the PersonCard, Edit address, Move to Cc, Move to Bcc, Remove. Double-tap edits the address in place. On desktop, allow dragging a chip between fields. In the reader's expanded details, render each recipient as a tappable name that opens the PersonCard. (effort small) | Built: In compose, each recipient chip's face is now a button. It opens a menu with Profile (the PersonCard), Edit address (puts the address back in the field as text; double-click does the same), Move to To/Cc/Bcc (Compose opens the Cc/Bcc rows when needed) and Remove. Quick reply and reply-head chips get Profile, Edit and Remove. In the desktop reader, the expanded to/Cc/Bcc line now shows each person

items.title: No one-tap 'all emails with this person'
items.detail: Reference: Gmail's contact card has 'View recent emails' (from:/to: search). Superhuman's sidebar lists recent threads with the sender, and clicking one opens it. Today: The search screen exists (src/components/mail/MailSearch.tsx), but the reader has no path from a person to their history. The message ⋮ menu (Reader.tsx:450-494) offers reply, forward, translate, print, original and block, but no 'Emails from {name}'. Proposal: Add 'Emails with {name}' to the PersonCard and the message ⋮ menu. It runs MailSearch with a from:x OR to:x chip. On desktop, the card also previews the last 3 threads. (effort small) | Built: Added 'Emails with {name}' to the message menu (desktop and phone). It uses a new emailsWith() on the shared PersonCard context, which runs the existing from:x OR to:x mail search. It was already on the card. Files: src/components/ui/PersonCard.tsx (additive Api.emailsWith), src/components/Reader.tsx.

items.title: Desktop has no sender context panel next to the email
items.detail: Reference: Superhuman shows a right rail on every open thread: who the person is, their company, social links, recent conversations and shared files. Gmail's side panel shows Contacts, Calendar and Tasks. Today: Reader.tsx has no side rail. Context about a person exists only in the separate Contacts screen (src/components/mail/Contacts.tsx:339-520, ContactPanel), which you can't reach from an open email. Proposal: On wide screens (over 1280px), add a collapsible right rail to the reader built from PersonCard data: role, company, notes from Contacts, recent threads, recent attachments (reuse FilesView), and upcoming shared calendar events. Keep it off on phones, where the PersonCard sheet covers this. (effort medium)

items.title: Avatar in the inbox list always selects; no quick-peek of the sender
items.detail: Reference: Gmail on phone: tapping the avatar selects the row, which is the same as here. On desktop, hovering the sender name in the list shows the contact hovercard. Superhuman shows the person in the sidebar as you move through the list. Today: src/components/MessageList.tsx:634-635: the row avatar is a select toggle on every screen size, and hovering the sender name does nothing on desktop. Proposal: Keep tap-to-select on phones. On desktop, attach the PersonCard hover to the sender name text in the row, after a 500ms delay so scanning the list stays calm. (effort small)

items.title: No split inbox driven by people or VIPs
items.detail: Reference: Superhuman's Split Inbox: tabs such as VIP, Team, Calendar and News, defined by sender or domain, with unread counts that you cycle through with Tab. Gmail has categories and Priority Inbox. Today: Inbox tabs and multiple inboxes exist (src/components/mail/Sorting.tsx), built around categories and searches. There's no VIP or person-based split, and no way to mark a person as VIP from their card. Proposal: Add 'Mark as VIP' to the PersonCard. VIPs get their own split and their mail notifies even when notifications are quiet. Offer ready-made splits for Team (your workspace domain) and Calendar (invites). (effort medium)

items.title: Read status is only in the list summary, not on the sent message
items.detail: Reference: Superhuman shows read status as a small eye icon on your sent messages, with a per-recipient timeline in a popover. Gmail Workspace offers read receipts. Today: src/components/MessageList.tsx:782-787 shows 'Opened by X of Y' in a summary line. In the open thread, your own sent messages in Reader.tsx carry no read indicator. Proposal: On each of your sent messages in the reader, add a small 'Seen 2h ago' tag. Tapping it opens a sheet listing each recipient with the time they opened it. (effort small)

items.title: No quick 'Message on Chat' or 'Call' from an email
items.detail: Reference: Gmail's contact card has Chat and Meet buttons. Slack and Teams profile cards have Message and Call. This is the user's exact complaint. Today: Mail, Chat and Meet are separate apps. Reader.tsx has no route from a sender to a Chat DM or a Meet call. Proposal: In the PersonCard, show Chat (opens or creates the DM in the Chat app) and Meet (starts a call) for any workspace member. For external people, show 'Schedule a meeting'. (effort small) | Built: The PersonCard now has a Call (video) button for workspace teammates. It opens or creates the DM in Chat and starts its huddle, using the same logic as Chat's huddle button. This came from a new optional onCall prop wired in App.tsx. Message (Chat DM) was already there. Files: src/components/ui/PersonCard.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/i18n/id/ui.ts.

items.title: Contacts are separate from teammates, so profiles are thin
items.detail: Reference: Gmail's card merges directory data (title, department, manager, phone) with personal contacts. Slack's profile shows title, pronouns, local time and status. Today: src/components/mail/Contacts.tsx:31 stores name, emails, phones, company, title, notes and labels for saved contacts only. Workspace members appear in a separate list (:247-255) with just name and email. Proposal: Add one people resolver: workspace profile (title, team, timezone, status) plus a saved contact plus the last-seen email signature (parse title and phone from the signature, as Superhuman does). The PersonCard and every avatar use it. (effort medium)

items.title: No 'Reply all → Reply' guard and no recipient warnings
items.detail: Reference: Gmail warns about external recipients and missing attachments ('you mentioned attached'). Superhuman flags long-dormant recipients. Today: Compose.tsx and DraftFiles.tsx handle files, but I found no check for words like 'attached' when no file is present, and no warning about external domains. Proposal: Before sending, show a single inline banner, not a modal: 'You wrote “attached” but nothing is attached' or 'This goes outside your company'. It has one primary button, Send anyway. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping an avatar or name opens a profile card
items.detail: Reference: Slack: tap an avatar or display name and a profile sheet opens (phone) or a popover (desktop), with photo, title, pronouns, local time, status, email, and Message / Huddle buttons. Discord does the same with its user popout. Today: The avatar in Message.tsx:249 is a plain <Avatar> with no handler, so the tap falls through to the whole-row onClick at Message.tsx:238-240, which calls ctx.onOpenThread(m.id) on phone. The only way to see a profile is the DM 'View profile' button (Conversation.tsx:578) or Details > Profile (Conversation.tsx:862), and both exist only inside a DM. Proposal: Make the avatar and the name in .cm-head (Message.tsx:257) buttons that open a ProfileCard: a bottom sheet on phone, an anchored popover on desktop. Reuse the Details 'about' pane, which already formats timeZone. Show name, title, status, local time, email (tap to copy) and team. Message is the one primary button; Huddle and 'View full profile' go underneath. Stop propagation so a tap on the avatar never opens the thread. (effort small)

items.title: @mentions are inert bold text
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Discord: an @mention is a tappable chip that opens the same profile card. #channel mentions open the channel. Today: Message.tsx:43 renders a mention as <b className="mention">, so it does nothing when tapped, and on phone the tap opens the thread. Proposal: Render mentions as buttons that open the ProfileCard from gap 1, and render #channel references as links that open the channel. Highlight mentions of me in a different colour. (effort small) | Built: @mentions in messages are now buttons that open the shared PersonCard (Popover on desktop, Sheet on phone), with mentions of me in amber and others in the accent colour. #channel references become chips that open the channel through a new 's2g:open-channel' window event, which App.tsx listens for. Changes are in src/components/chat/Message.tsx (Inline/Text get refs, MsgCtx.channels), src/component

items.title: Tapping a message on phone opens its thread
items.detail: Reference: Slack mobile: a tap does nothing (or selects text) and a long-press opens the action sheet. You reply in a thread through the 'N replies' link or the action sheet. Discord: a tap does nothing and a swipe left replies. Today: Message.tsx:232-240 sets canOpen = ctx.phone and calls onOpenThread on any tap outside a button. This is the 'it jumps to the thread' complaint: reading or scrolling triggers navigation. Proposal: Remove the tap-to-thread behaviour. Keep long-press for the action sheet (actionsFor, Conversation.tsx:484) and the existing thread-link (Message.tsx:369). Optionally add swipe-to-reply. (effort small) | Built: Removed the phone tap-to-thread handler (canOpen/onClick) on .chat-msg in src/components/chat/Message.tsx. Long-press action sheet and the 'N replies' link stay.

items.title: No typing indicator
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Discord both show 'Ana is typing…' above the composer, and Slack shows it in DM rows too. Today: No typing presence anywhere. The only match for 'typing' in chat/ and ChatApp.tsx is one hit in chatPrefs.ts, and nothing in Conversation.tsx or Composer.tsx sends or shows typing state. Proposal: Broadcast a throttled typing ping from Composer over the existing realtime net (chat/net.ts) and show a slim animated line above the composer that names up to 2 people. (effort medium)

items.title: No 'seen' state in DMs
items.detail: Reference: Discord has no read receipts, but WhatsApp-style apps and Teams show 'Seen'. Slack shows the unread line and nothing else. People expect to know whether a DM landed. Today: Unread is tracked per user for the NewLine (Message.tsx import, Conversation.tsx:27), but nothing tells the sender that their message was read. No readBy is shown. Proposal: In 1:1 DMs only, show a small 'Seen' with a time under my last message once the other person's read marker passes it. Add a setting to turn it off. (effort medium)

items.title: Full-screen image viewer
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Discord: tap an image to open a full-screen viewer with pinch-zoom, swipe between images, and save / share / forward. Today: Attachments are links that open in a new tab (Message.tsx:327, target=_blank). There is no in-app viewer. Proposal: Add a MediaViewer overlay: tap a thumbnail to open it full screen with pinch-zoom and swipe through the conversation's images. One primary action, Share/Save, with Forward in the overflow menu. (effort medium)

items.title: Quote-reply inline (Discord 'Reply')
items.detail: Reference: Discord: Reply quotes the original above your message in the main channel, and tapping the quote jumps to it. WhatsApp works the same way. Slack only has threads. Today: Replies go only to threads (actionsFor, Conversation.tsx:490). A Quote formatting option exists in Composer, but nothing links back to the source message. Proposal: Add 'Reply' (inline) beside 'Reply in thread' in the action sheet and as a swipe gesture. The composer shows a dismissible 'Replying to X' bar, and the sent message carries a tappable quote that calls the existing jumpTo. (effort medium)

items.title: No workspace-wide message search

items.title: Link previews
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Discord show a card for pasted links with title, description, image, and inline video players. items.title: Presence and local time missing from message headers and DM rows
items.detail: Reference: Slack shows a presence dot on avatars and a 'local time is 11:40 PM' warning in the DM composer when the other person is outside working hours. items.title: Long-press a person in the sidebar or people list for quick actions
items.detail: Reference: Slack: in the member list, tapping a person opens the profile and long-pressing a DM row gives mute, star and close. Discord opens a user sheet on tap anywhere. items.title: Edit history and delete-for-everyone feedback
items.detail: Reference: Slack: '(edited)', and hovering it shows when. Delete removes the message entirely (Conversation.tsx:503). Proposal: Make '(edited)' tappable to show the time it was edited. When a deleted message had thread replies, keep a 'Message deleted' tombstone so the replies still have context. (effort small)

items.title: Unread jump and 'mark all read' per conversation
items.detail: Reference: Slack: a 'N new messages since 2:14 PM, Jump' pill at the top, and Esc marks a channel read. Discord shows a 'N new messages, Mark as read' bar. Today: There is a 'jump to recent' button (Conversation.tsx:587) and a NewLine marker, but no pill that jumps up to the first unread or marks the conversation read. items.title: Tapping a person opens nothing about them
items.detail: Reference: Asana: tap any avatar (assignee, commenter, follower) for a profile card with name, title, team, email, local time, and Message or 'View tasks'. Proposal: Add one shared PersonCard (a sheet on phones, a popover on desktop) that opens from every avatar in Tasks: name, title, team, local time, and how many open or late tasks they have. One primary button, Message (opens a DM in Chat), with Email, Call and 'See their tasks' (goes to scope people:id) as secondary rows. items.title: No @mentions in task comments

items.title: Due dates have no time of day
items.detail: Reference: Todoist: 'tomorrow 3pm' sets a due time, and Today sorts by it. Asana: due time, plus start dates and date ranges. Today: Todo.due is only YYYY-MM-DD (types.ts, Todo.due). QuickAdd reads a time (parsed.time, QuickAdd.tsx:275) but only puts it into the label or the reminder. Today cannot show what is due at 2pm. Proposal: Add an optional dueTime. Show it on the row's due chip and sort Today by time. The date picker gets a 'Add time' row. On phones, Today lists timed tasks first, in order. (effort medium) | Built: Tasks have a new optional field, Todo.dueTime (HH:MM). Quick Add saves the parsed time ('tomorrow 3pm') as dueTime, via NewTask and createTask. The row's due chip shows the time, also under Today and Tomorrow headings. sortTasks orders by date and then time, so timed tasks come first and in order, including on Today. The due row in TaskDetail (phone and desktop) and in TaskDrawer has 'Add time', t

items.title: Checklist items aren't real subtasks
items.detail: Reference: Asana subtasks have their own assignee, due date and comments, and show in the assignee's My Tasks. Todoist sub-tasks can have dates and labels and can be indented by dragging. Today: Checklist items are only text plus done: Todo.checklist {id,text,done} (types.ts; TaskDetail.tsx:271-288, 646-676). They can't be given to someone or dated. Briefs (briefId) are the only parent/child link. Proposal: Let a checklist item be promoted to a subtask: hold it and choose 'Make it a task', or give it a person or date. It then becomes a Todo with parentId, appears in that person's My tasks, and shows as 'Sub-task of X' with a link back. (effort large)

items.title: No search inside Tasks
items.detail: Reference: Todoist: search on phone and Cmd+K on desktop find tasks, comments and projects. Asana has a search bar with saved advanced searches. Proposal: Add a search field at the top of Browse on phones and a '/' shortcut on desktop. It matches titles, notes, checklist items and comments, done tasks included, grouped as Open and Done. It matches titles, notes, checklist items and comments with every word typed, includes done tasks, and groups results as Open and Done. On phones it is a search pill at the top of Browse that replaces the cards while you type. On desktop, '/' or a new search button in the Tasks header opens it in a Sheet. Tapping a result opens the task. Copy is

items.title: No labels or tags
items.detail: Reference: Todoist labels (@errand, @waiting) can be used across projects, filtered, and added in Quick Add. Asana has tags and custom fields. Today: Todo has no labels field (types.ts). QuickAdd understands #project, +person, /stage, p1, reminders and repeats (QuickAdd.tsx:41) but has no labels. The Display filters (DisplaySheet.tsx:166-174) can only filter by who, stage and waiting. Proposal: Add workspace labels, typed in Quick Add with @label, shown as small chips on rows, and offered as a 'Label' filter in Display and in saved views. (effort medium)

items.title: No 'blocked by' or dependencies
items.detail: Reference: Asana: 'Blocked by' / 'Blocking' on a task. The waiting task shows a lock icon, and the assignee is notified when the blocker is done. Today: There is no dependency field on Todo (types.ts). A 'waiting' stage exists (DisplaySheet.tsx:174), but it doesn't say what the task is waiting on, and nothing happens when that work is finished. Proposal: Add a 'Waiting on' field that points to another task. Rows get a small lock icon. When the blocking task is done, notify the doer: 'X is done, you can start Y'. (effort medium)

items.title: Files can only be attached through a comment
items.detail: Reference: Asana: attachments on the task itself, with a paperclip at the top and a gallery of images. Todoist: a file on a comment, and attachments listed on the task. Today: Files only come in through comments (CommentFiles.tsx:86-118 used by TaskDetail.tsx:434, 581). The task itself has no Files row, so a brief's reference image is buried in the activity. Proposal: Add a 'Files' field chip to TaskDetail. It lists every file attached to the task or its comments as thumbnails, and shows a 'Files' count on the row. (effort small)

items.title: No reactions or likes on comments and tasks
items.detail: Reference: Asana: like a task or comment (thumbs-up) to acknowledge without writing back. Slack-style emoji reactions are common. Today: History events are comments and logs only (TasksView.tsx:94-96, TaskDrawer.tsx:345-360). The only way to say 'seen' is to post another comment, which notifies everyone. Proposal: Hold a comment on phones, or hover it on desktop, to add a quick reaction (thumbs-up, check, eyes). It shows a small count and quietly notifies only the author. (effort small)

items.title: No start date or date range
items.detail: Reference: Asana: start and due dates, so a task shows as a bar on the timeline or calendar. Todoist added 'deadline' alongside the date you plan to do it. Today: There is only Todo.due (types.ts). TaskCalendar.tsx shows each task on a single day, so a week-long piece of work looks like it is due that one day. Proposal: Add an optional start date in the date picker ('Starts'). The calendar draws a range, and Upcoming shows 'In progress' tasks on each day of the range. (effort medium)

items.title: Repeat options are too limited
items.detail: Reference: Todoist: 'every 2nd Monday', 'every 3 weeks', 'every last day', 'every! (from completion)'. Asana: custom periodic repeats. Today: Repeat is one of 'daily' | 'weekdays' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' (types.ts; TaskDetail.tsx:25-30; QuickAdd.tsx:32). Fortnightly reports or 'first Monday of the month' are impossible. Proposal: Add 'Custom…' to the repeat picker: every N days, weeks or months, which weekdays, and 'after I finish' versus 'on schedule'. Quick Add should parse 'every 2 weeks' and 'every mon, thu'. (effort medium)

items.title: No keyboard shortcuts on desktop
items.detail: Reference: Todoist: q quick add, t/m/y today/upcoming, e complete, Cmd+K, j/k navigation. Asana: Tab+Q, Tab+A assign, Tab+D due date. Today: Key handling exists only inside the QuickAdd field (QuickAdd.tsx:246-256). There are no global shortcuts in TasksView.tsx or TaskViews.tsx to add, complete or move between tasks. Proposal: Add desktop shortcuts: q or n new task, j/k move, Enter open, e or x done, d date, a assign, '/' search, and '?' to show the cheat sheet. Phones are unaffected. (effort small)

items.title: Can't see a teammate's task list in one tap
items.detail: Reference: Asana: from a profile, 'View tasks' opens that person's My Tasks (filtered to what you can see). Used every day by leads. Today: The Display sheet can filter a view to one person (DisplaySheet.tsx:219, 264-273). That takes several taps inside a view. The workload rows (TasksView.tsx:823-833) go to the team scope, not to the person. Proposal: Add a 'people' scope, reached from the PersonCard ('See their tasks') and from the workload rows. It shows their open tasks grouped Late, Today and Later, with Reassign as the main action. (effort small)

items.title: No 'My tasks' inbox of new assignments
items.detail: Reference: Asana: Inbox shows 'X assigned you Y' and 'Z commented'. My Tasks marks recently assigned tasks. Todoist shows collaboration notifications. Today: Today, Upcoming and My tasks (TasksView.tsx:319-321) filter by doer and date. A task someone just gave you with no date is buried in My tasks and nothing marks it new. Proposal: Add a 'New for you' strip at the top of My tasks, listing tasks assigned since you last looked, each with Accept (add a date) as its one action, and marking them seen once opened. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping a person opens nothing useful
items.detail: Reference: Basecamp: tap any avatar to open a profile card with name, title, company, email, local time, and links to their activity and assignments. Proposal: Use one shared PersonCard: a bottom sheet on phones and a popover on desktop. It shows the avatar, name, title, role on this project, email, phone, local time and their open tasks here. Message is the primary action; Call and Email are secondary. Make every Avatar in Projects open it, and stop the tap from bubbling up to the card. (effort medium) | Built: Every person in Projects now opens the shared PersonCard. In ProjectPeople.tsx, the rows for the owner, members and guests pass `card`. Each row has an avatar that opens the PersonCard. Tapping a row opens the task, note, meeting or chat. An Everyone / Just me segmented filter and Sh

items.title: No 'My work' across projects

items.title: Card avatars and the people stack are tap traps
items.detail: Reference: In Monday, the people column is its own target: tapping it opens assignment or the person, not the item. items.title: No status updates or project health
items.detail: Reference: Monday has status updates and a project-health column, and Basecamp has a pinned project message. Stakeholders see 'On track / At risk' without digging. Today: The only states are active, lead, paused and ended (ProjectsHome.tsx:128-131). There is no health indicator or written update. items.title: Search only matches project names
items.detail: Reference: Basecamp and Monday search inside the project (tasks, comments, files) and filter by person or date. Today: ProjectsHome.tsx:215 filters cards by c.name.includes(q) only. Proposal: Make the search box match tasks, notes and files across projects, with results grouped by type. On phones it becomes a full-screen search. (effort medium)

items.title: No progress signal
items.detail: Reference: Basecamp hill charts show whether each piece of work is still being figured out or is getting done. Monday shows a progress (battery) column per group. Today: Project cards at ProjectsHome.tsx:223 only flag problems (late, not picked up, waiting). There is no percent-complete. Proposal: Add a progress bar to each card and to the Overview header (done ÷ total tasks). (effort small)

items.title: No notification follow or mute per project
items.detail: Reference: Basecamp lets you subscribe to or unsubscribe from each message board, to-do or file. Monday lets you mute boards. Today: Nothing in ProjectsHome.tsx, ProjectPhone.tsx or ProjectPeople.tsx controls notifications. Proposal: Add a bell button in the project header with three levels: All, Mentions only, Off. (effort small)

items.title: No pin or favourite projects
items.detail: Reference: Basecamp pins projects to the top of Home, and Monday has Favorites. Today: The sidebar list at ProjectsSidebar.tsx:95-97 shows every live project in the same order. Proposal: Add a star on each card and sidebar row. Starred projects appear in a top 'Pinned' group. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping a person opens their team, not their profile
items.detail: Reference: Slack: tapping any avatar or name opens a full profile (photo, title, pronouns, local time, status, email, phone, Message / Huddle / Call). Teams mobile: the profile card has Chat, Call, Email, org position. The primary action is Message, which opens a Chat DM; Email and Call sit in a secondary row. Open it from every avatar and name in the app. (effort medium) | Built: People directory row tap now opens the shared PersonCard (Message first, Email/Call/tasks secondary) instead of jumping to their first team; long-press keeps the Email/Open-team menu. items.title: Member row opens an action menu, not a real profile
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Teams open a profile first. Admin actions such as remove or make owner are tucked away in an overflow menu. items.title: No 'Message' or DM action anywhere in Teams
items.detail: Reference: Slack: Message is the first button on a profile. MS Teams: a chat icon on every person card. Today: The member menu only offers mailto: TeamsApp.tsx:315. items.title: Desktop member list rows are dead text
items.detail: Reference: Slack desktop: clicking a name in the member list opens a profile popover. Linear: clicking a member shows their profile and issues. items.title: Avatar stacks are not tappable

items.title: No presence, status or local time
items.detail: Reference: Slack: green or away dot, custom status emoji and text, 'Away until', local time on the profile. MS Teams: Available, Busy, In a meeting, Out of office. Let people set a status message and 'out until' date in Settings. Show local time and status on the profile. (effort medium)

items.title: Can't reassign straight from 'Who's busy'
items.detail: Reference: Linear: drag or reassign issues from a member's view. Asana workload: drag tasks between people. Today: Expanded workload list only opens the task: TeamsApp.tsx:633. Proposal: Long-press (phone) or right-click (desktop) a mini task to get 'Give to...' with a people picker, plus Undo. (effort small)

items.title: No team channel or conversation
items.detail: Reference: Slack user groups link to default channels. MS Teams: every team has channels as its core surface. Today: Team tabs are only People, Tasks, Who's busy and Settings: TeamsApp.tsx:405-411. Proposal: Auto-create a Chat channel per team. items.title: Add people is a tick list with no invite or bulk paste
items.detail: Reference: Slack: add by name or email, paste several emails, and invite external people. MS Teams: add a member or guest by email. items.title: No contact actions: call or meet
items.detail: Reference: Slack: Huddle. MS Teams: Video/Audio call on every card. Today: No call or meet entry exists in Teams. The only contact action is Email: TeamsApp.tsx:315. Proposal: Put 'Start a Meet' and 'Schedule' (which opens Calendar with the person pre-filled) as secondary actions on the profile and team header. (effort small)

items.title: Team page has no overview or activity
items.detail: Reference: Linear: team page shows active cycle progress and recent activity. MS Teams: Posts feed. Today: Team opens on the People tab: TeamsApp.tsx:404. items.title: Tapping a person in a cell does nothing useful
items.detail: Reference: Notion and Airtable open a hover or popover card for a Person/Collaborator value with avatar, name and email. items.title: No @mentions or notifications in row comments

Commenting auto-follows the row. A bell toggle in the drawer header lets you follow or unfollow. (effort medium) | Built: Row comments now have an @mention picker. It filters teammates, works with arrow keys, Tab and Enter, and highlights each @Name in the posted comment. Mentions are saved on the comment. Posting a comment makes you follow the row automatically, and a Follow/Following bell toggle sits in the Comments header. Server (server/tables.ts afterRowWrite): when a new comment arrives, the mentioned people an

items.title: Deleted rows are gone for good, with no trash
items.detail: Reference: Airtable has record trash and base snapshots. Notion has a Trash where deleted pages can be restored for 30 days. Today: src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:546 deletes rows directly. Undo (TableScreen.tsx:138-142) lives only in memory, holds 40 steps, and is lost on reload or on another device. Proposal: Soft-delete rows into a 30-day 'Recently deleted' list, reached from the table's ⋯ menu, with Restore as the main action. After a delete, show a toast with Undo, which matters most on phones where Ctrl+Z doesn't exist. (effort medium)

items.title: No form view to collect rows from people outside the table
items.detail: Reference: Airtable Form view and Notion Forms give you a shareable public URL with chosen fields, required flags and a thank-you message. Each answer becomes a row. Today: src/components/tables/viewKinds.ts:7-14 lists only grid, board, list, gallery, calendar and timeline. The only outside intake is the webhook in Automations.tsx:529-530, which needs a developer. Proposal: Add a Form view kind. It lists fields with required toggles and help text, and has one primary button: Copy form link. The public page is phone-first and creates a row on submit, then any rules run as usual. (effort large)

items.title: Photos and files in cells can't be opened full size
items.detail: Reference: In Airtable, tapping an attachment opens a full-screen previewer you can swipe through, with download. Notion opens images in a lightbox. Today: src/components/tables/Cell.tsx:138-151 shows up to 4 thumbnails and +N. There is no viewer, so a tap opens the row or editor. Proposal: Tapping a thumbnail opens a full-screen viewer. Swipe between files on phones and use arrow keys on desktop. Download is the main action, Share the second. PDFs open in the browser viewer. (effort small) | Built: Tapping a file thumbnail or chip in a cell (or +N) now opens the shared full-screen AttachmentViewer from mail. You can swipe or use the arrow keys to move between files, PDFs and Office files preview, and Download is available. Clicks are stopped from opening the row or the cell editor. Hover, focus and reduced-motion styles are added in src/tables.css. File: src/components/tables/Cell.tsx (Files

items.title: Comments can't be edited, deleted or reacted to
items.detail: Reference: Notion and Airtable let you edit or delete your own comment, add emoji reactions, and resolve a thread. Today: src/components/tables/RecordDrawer.tsx:203-213 renders comments as read-only text with no menu. Proposal: Long-press on phones (a ⋯ menu on hover on desktop) gives Edit, Delete and React. Show reactions as small chips under the comment. (effort small)

items.title: No date reminders
items.detail: Reference: Notion date properties have 'Remind: on day / 1 day before'. Airtable automations trigger when a date arrives. Today: Date cells only turn red when late (Cell.tsx:104-106). There is no reminder option on the field or in Automations triggers (a grep for reminder finds nothing). Proposal: In the date field menu, add 'Remind the Person field X days before/on the day', which sends a Home notification with a link to the row. Add a 'When a date arrives' trigger to Automations. (effort medium)

items.title: No personal or private views
items.detail: Reference: Airtable has personal views. In Notion, filters you apply stay yours until you choose 'Save for everyone'. Today: View changes go to the shared definition (TableScreen.tsx:168-180). Your own quick filter changes what teammates see. Proposal: Keep filter, sort and search changes local to each viewer by default. A 'Save for everyone' pill appears when the view differs. Add a 'My views' section to ViewTabs. (effort medium)

items.title: Can't freeze columns or choose row height or wrapping
items.detail: Reference: Airtable lets you drag the freeze line and pick short, medium, tall or extra-tall rows. Notion lets you wrap cells per view. Today: GridView.tsx has no freeze or row-height setting (a grep for freeze, frozen and rowHeight finds nothing). Only the first column sticks. Proposal: In the column ⌄ menu (ColumnMenu.tsx), add 'Freeze up to here'. In the view's settings, add a Row height choice (Short/Tall/Wrap) saved per view. On phones, keep cards as they are. (effort small)

items.title: No charts or summary dashboard
items.detail: Reference: Airtable Interfaces show number tiles and bar/pie charts over a table. Notion added a Chart view in 2024. Today: Only footer calcs exist (core.ts:457-471: count, sum, avg and so on). There is no chart view (viewKinds.ts:7-14). Proposal: Add a Chart view: bar, line or donut, grouped by a choice, person or date field, showing count or sum. Tapping a bar opens the filtered rows. On phones it is one chart per screen with a big total on top. (effort medium)

items.title: Can't share a single view publicly or lock it
items.detail: Reference: Airtable has shared view links (read-only, optionally password-protected) and locked views. Notion has 'Publish to web' and locked databases. Today: Sharing is only the client-guest share (TableScreen.tsx:577, requires tb.clientId). Any edit to a view changes it for everyone (patchShared, TableScreen.tsx:168). Proposal: Add Share view in the view tab menu. Its main button copies a read-only link, with options to allow search and download. Also add 'Lock this view' so filters and sorts change only for you until you choose to save. (effort medium)

items.title: Copy link to a row is hard to find on phones and doesn't land well
items.detail: Reference: Airtable and Notion have Copy link to record on the record page. The link opens the record straight away on any device. Today: Copy link exists in RecordDrawer.tsx and TableScreen.tsx, but it is buried in a menu. There is no native share sheet in the row menu (around TableScreen.tsx:546). Proposal: In the phone row page header, add a Share button that calls navigator.share with the deep link, falling back to Copy. Make sure the link opens the row page directly, even when you're logged out (it asks you to log in and then opens the row). (effort small)

items.title: No rich text body on a row
items.detail: Reference: Every Notion database row is a full page with headings, checklists and images. Airtable has rich text long-text fields. Today: RecordDrawer.tsx:161 shows fields, links, comments and history. Long text is plain text. There is no page body. Proposal: Give the row page a Notes body under the fields, reusing the Notes app's editor, with checklists, headings and pasted images. On phones it sits below the fields as a 'Notes' section. (effort medium)

items.title: No sub-items or dependencies between rows
items.detail: Reference: Notion has sub-items and 'Blocked by' dependencies on a timeline. Airtable timeline shows dependency arrows. Today: There is no parent/child or dependency handling (a grep finds nothing). TimelineView.tsx draws independent bars only. Proposal: Add 'Sub-items' as a built-in self-link that indents children in grid and list and shows a progress count. On the timeline, add an optional 'Blocked by' link drawn as arrows, and warn when a bar is moved before its blocker ends. (effort large)

items.title: Tapping a guest does nothing: no person card
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar: tap a guest to get a hover/sheet card with name, email, Email and Chat buttons, and their calendar. Notion Calendar shows the person card with local time and quick 'Schedule with'. Today: Guests render as plain rows with no handler: desktop src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:216-224 (div.ev-guest), phone EventDetail.tsx:481-500 (div.dr-guest). Proposal: Make each guest row a button that opens the shared person sheet (same one Chat/Teams should use): avatar, name, title, email, local time. One primary action 'Message', secondary Email / Call / 'Find a time'. Bottom sheet on phones, popover on desktop. (effort medium) | Built: Guest names in the event detail (desktop .ev-guest and phone .dr-guest) are now PersonName links, so both the avatar and the name open the shared PersonCard (sheet on phones, popover on desktop). That card already has Message, Email, local time and the rest. Edited src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx.

items.title: No search across events
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar has a search icon in the top bar (phone and desktop) finding events by title, guest, place, past and future. Notion Calendar has Cmd+K. Today: The Calendar top bar is mounted with search={false}, src/components/CalendarView.tsx:357; there is no event search anywhere in the calendar folder. Proposal: Turn on the top bar search: results as a schedule-style list grouped by date. Tapping one jumps the cursor to that day and opens the event. On desktop, '/' focuses it. items.title: No 'Find a time' / see guests' availability
items.detail: Reference: Google 'Find a time' lays guests' calendars side by side and suggests free slots. Notion Calendar overlays a teammate's calendar and lets you share free slots. Today: GuestPicker.tsx:16-117 only adds or removes people; busyOf (CalendarView.tsx:203) feeds only the grid, so nobody's free/busy is visible while you pick a time in EventForm.tsx. Proposal: Once guests are added in EventForm, show a 'Find a time' row: a one-day strip with everyone's busy blocks and the first 3 free slots as chips. Tapping a chip sets start/end. (effort large)

items.title: No 'Message guests' / 'Email guests' from an event
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar event detail has 'Email guests' (and Chat guests in Workspace). Today: The event overflow menu (CalendarView.tsx:276-312) has Open invite, Edit, Duplicate, Move to tomorrow, Copy link, Delete; the only mail link is 'Open related email' to an existing thread (EventDetail.tsx:272-273). Proposal: Add 'Message guests' to the More menu and next to the guests count: opens a Chat group or a Mail draft with all guests in To and the event title as subject. Added the new onMessageGuests prop to CalendarView and Ev

items.title: Guests can't propose a new time
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar: 'Propose a new time' under RSVP; the organiser sees and accepts it. Outlook/Notion support the same. Today: Rsvp at EventDetail.tsx:94-118 has Yes / No / Maybe only. items.title: Guest list doesn't show who's optional or let organiser see emails
items.detail: Reference: Google marks optional guests, shows each guest's email on hover, and lets you copy all guest emails. Proposal: Add an 'Optional' toggle per guest in GuestPicker, show 'Optional' under the name, and 'Copy all emails' in the guests row menu. (effort small)

items.title: No working hours / out-of-office auto-decline
items.detail: Reference: Google Calendar: working hours and location per day, greyed hours outside them, warnings when inviting someone outside hours, and Out of office events that auto-decline. Today: EventForm has an 'ooo' kind (EventForm.tsx:488 disables all-day for it) but no working-hours setting and no greying in TimeGrid.tsx; no auto-decline. items.title: No second time zone on the grid
items.detail: Reference: Google and Notion Calendar show a second (or more) time-zone column next to the hours; Notion also shows teammates' local times. Today: Time zone is only per event (EventForm.tsx:32, EventDetail.tsx:157-167); TimeGrid.tsx has a single hour gutter. Proposal: Settings toggle 'Show a second time zone': adds a narrow gutter on desktop and a tap-to-switch label on phones. (effort small)

items.title: Reminders: one only, no email or default per calendar
items.detail: Reference: Google allows several notifications per event (e.g. 1 day and 10 min), as push or email, and default reminders per calendar. Today: A single 'remind' select, EventForm.tsx:310 and 569; detail shows one 'Reminder' row, EventDetail.tsx:233. Proposal: Allow up to 3 reminders with '+ Add reminder', and a default reminder per calendar in the Calendars drawer. (effort small)

items.title: Phone detail rows for place/reminder/notes jump to the edit form
items.detail: Reference: Google: tapping the location opens Maps; tapping description links opens them; reminder editing is inline. Today: PhoneDetail rows MapPin, Bell, Users, notes all call p.onEdit (EventDetail.tsx:452, 457, 462, 507), so tapping an address opens the whole form. Proposal: Location row opens directions (maps link) with a copy button; empty rows keep 'Add …'; notes render links as tappable. (effort small)

items.title: Video call must be pasted; no one-tap Meet link
items.detail: Reference: Google adds a Meet link with one tap 'Add Google Meet video conferencing'; Notion adds Zoom/Meet automatically. Today: The video field is a text input 'Paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link', EventForm.tsx:280 and 550. Proposal: Primary chip 'Add sprint2go Meet call' that generates a Meet room link; keep paste as secondary. The helper is newCallLink() in calTools.ts.

items.title: No 'Up next' join reminder outside calendar
items.detail: Reference: Notion Calendar's menu-bar shows the next meeting with Join; Google sends 'starting now' notifications with Join. Today: UpNext.tsx (52 lines) shows only inside the calendar view. Proposal: Surface the next meeting with a Join button on Home and as a push/notification one minute before start. (effort medium)

items.title: Tapping an @person mention launches a mail client instead of opening their profile
items.detail: Reference: Notion: hovering or tapping an @person mention shows a card with avatar, name, email and role. Slack and Teams open a profile sheet with title, local time, Message and Call. The sanitizer keeps only href/style/class/data-task (noteHtml.ts:13), so no user id is stored. Proposal: Store mentions as <a class="note-person" data-user="id">. A tap opens the shared person sheet used across the app: avatar, title, team, local time and email. Message is the primary button, Call and Email are secondary. On desktop the same card shows on hover or click. (effort small)

items.title: No slash (/) command menu
items.detail: Reference: In Notion, typing / opens a filterable menu of blocks (heading, to-do, table, callout, toggle, page, mention, date). In Apple Notes the Aa and checklist buttons sit above the keyboard. Today: Markdown shortcuts work at the start of a line (NoteText.tsx:352-376). items.title: Typing @ does not trigger mentions inline
items.detail: Reference: In Notion, Slack and Apple Notes (shared notes), typing @ opens an inline people picker right at the caret. Today: Mentions open only from the toolbar's @ button, which brings up a full tall sheet (NoteBar.tsx:54, NoteSheets.tsx:184-215). items.title: No images, files, scans or attachments
items.detail: Reference: Apple Notes: camera, photo library, document scanner and file attachments shown inline. Notion: image and file blocks, plus drag-and-drop. Today: The paste handler sanitizes HTML only (NoteText.tsx:405-407). The sanitizer has no img or src attribute (noteHtml.ts:13). Neither NoteBar nor FormatPanel has a photo or attach action. Proposal: Add a Photo/File button to NoteBar (camera and scan on phones) and support image paste and drop. Upload to Drive and insert an inline image or file chip that opens Drive's preview. items.title: No folders, tags or nested pages
items.detail: Reference: Apple Notes: folders, smart folders and #tags with a tag browser. Notion: nested pages in a sidebar tree. Today: The only grouping is the project (client) facet plus private/team/shared filters (NotesList.tsx:23-24, 254-259). MoveSheet moves a note only to a project (NoteSheets.tsx:220). Proposal: Make #word in a note a tag, and show tags as chips in the search facets (NotesList.tsx:254) and in the desktop filter. This avoids a full folder tree and keeps one primary action. items.title: No version history
items.detail: Reference: Notion's Page history lets you view and restore earlier versions. Apple Notes shows 'Show Highlights' for edits by others in shared notes. Today: The footer shows only who last edited the note (NoteEditor.tsx:216). Nothing lists or restores earlier versions. Proposal: Add a 'History' item to the note menu (noteMenu.ts). It opens a sheet of snapshots (by person and time) with a preview and Restore as the primary action. (effort large)

items.title: No comments on shared notes
items.detail: Reference: Notion: select text, then Comment, with threads, resolve and @ notifications. Apple Notes shared notes show activity and highlights. Today: Team notes can be edited and mention people (NoteEditor.tsx:363), but there is no comment or discussion layer anywhere in src/components/notes. Proposal: Selecting text shows a 'Comment' action that anchors a thread to the selection. A count badge sits in the note top bar, and on a phone the threads open in a sheet. (effort large)

items.title: Share sheet stops at private/everyone, with no per-person sharing
items.detail: Reference: Apple Notes and Notion invite specific people with view or edit rights and show their avatars. Today: ShareSheet offers only 'Only me' or everyone in the company or project (NoteSheets.tsx:252-285). Proposal: Add 'Specific people' with a people picker and a can-edit/can-view toggle per person. Show the avatars of people who have access in the note-who chip (NoteEditor.tsx:374). (effort medium)

items.title: No presence or live collaborator indicator
items.detail: Reference: Notion and Google Docs show avatars of who is viewing and their cursors. Apple Notes shows who is in a shared note. Today: Remote changes simply replace the content when the note is not focused (NoteText.tsx:86). Nothing shows who else has the note open. Proposal: Show a small avatar stack of current viewers in the note top bar. Tapping an avatar opens the same person sheet as mentions. (effort medium)

items.title: No tables
items.detail: Reference: Apple Notes and Notion both have tables (Notion also has databases). Today: Block options are P, H1-H3, quote, code and callout (NoteText.tsx:19, NoteSheets.tsx:114-120). There are no tables. Proposal: Add a simple table block (add a row or column from a cell menu), inserted from FormatPanel and the slash menu. Link out to the Tables app for anything heavier. (effort medium)

items.title: No toggle or collapsible sections
items.detail: Reference: Notion has toggle blocks and collapsible headings. Apple Notes can collapse sections under headings. Today: Headings are static blocks (NoteText.tsx:159-166). Long notes cannot be folded. Proposal: Add a chevron that collapses everything under an H1-H3 until the next heading of the same level, with the folded state saved per viewer. (effort small)

items.title: No templates
items.detail: Reference: Notion has page templates and template buttons. Apple Notes has none, but its Quick Note can be launched from anywhere. Today: New note opens empty (NotesList.tsx:182). Duplicate (noteMenu.ts:28) is the only workaround. Proposal: Add a 'Save as template' menu item. The new-note button keeps its blank default, and a long-press on it offers templates (meeting notes, 1:1, brief). (effort small)

items.title: No export, print or send-as-email
items.detail: Reference: Notion exports to PDF, Markdown and HTML. Apple Notes has Share, Print, Export as PDF and Send copy. Today: The note menu has only Copy link and Duplicate besides pin, move, share and delete (noteMenu.ts:24-30). Proposal: Add 'Send a copy' (opens a Mail compose with the note's HTML) and 'Export PDF / Markdown' to the note menu's copy group. (effort small)

items.title: No dates or reminders in notes
items.detail: Reference: Notion's @today and @remind put an inline date and send a notification. Apple Notes checklist items can turn into Reminders. Today: A line can become a task (NoteEditor.tsx:118-130), but there is no inline date chip or reminder. Proposal: Add @date and @remind in the mention picker. They insert a date chip, and a reminder fires a notification that opens the note at that line. (effort medium)

items.title: Mention picker: people rows give no context
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Notion pickers show avatar, title and online status so you pick the right person. Today: MentionPanel lists users with name only plus notes (NoteSheets.tsx:196-205). Proposal: Show each person's title and team on the second line and sort recent collaborators on this note first. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping the uploader/owner name or avatar opens nothing
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive: owner avatar in Details/Activity opens a people card (name, email, Message/Email/Meet). Dropbox: member avatar shows name, email and actions. Today: Uploader is only text in the meta line ('{name} uploaded') built at src/components/DriveView.tsx:215-219; there is no profile card, and nothing on that line can be tapped. Proposal: Make the uploader name a tap target that opens the shared person card from Chat/Teams as a bottom sheet on phones and a popover on desktop. It shows name, title, email and local time, with Message as the primary action and Call as the secondary. (effort small)

items.title: Real sharing (people + permissions) missing; only 'copy link'
items.detail: Reference: Both apps: Share opens a sheet to add people/teams, set Viewer/Commenter/Editor, and set link access (restricted, anyone in org, anyone). Dropbox adds expiry and a password. Today: shareLink at DriveView.tsx:148-151 only copies a URL. It is hidden for folders and data: URLs (DriveView.tsx:173,176). Proposal: Add a Share sheet with a people picker drawn from Teams, a role dropdown and link access. Keep Copy link as the primary button. Allow sharing folders as well. (effort large)

items.title: Details/info pane missing on desktop
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive desktop: an 'i' toggles a right-side panel with Details and Activity (who, when, size, location, access). Dropbox has a similar side panel. Today: Details exists only in the phone sheet (DriveView.tsx:241). The desktop menu at DriveView.tsx:166-182 has no Details entry. Proposal: On desktop, add Details to the right-click and '...' menus, and an 'i' toggle in the toolbar that opens a side panel reusing the phone details content. (effort small) | Built: Desktop Details side panel: an 'i' toggle in the Drive toolbar (remembered per browser as pm-drive-info) slides a 320px panel out from the right. It reuses DetailsBody, and the uploader shown there opens the shared PersonCard through PersonName. The panel shows whatever Details was chosen for, otherwise the one picked file, otherwise the folder you are in, otherwise an empty state. The right-click

items.title: No sorting on desktop
items.detail: Reference: Both apps let you sort by Name, Last modified and Size from the column headers or a sort menu, with folders kept first. Today: Sort (name/modified/size) exists only in the phone layout (DriveView.tsx:~492-500, 604). Desktop always sorts by name, or by date in fixed sections (DriveView.tsx:82-97). Proposal: Make the desktop list-view column headers clickable for sorting, add the same sort menu in grid view, and reuse the sorter(). (effort small)

items.title: No multi-select / bulk actions
items.detail: Reference: Long-press on phone, or Ctrl/Shift-click and checkboxes on desktop, then a bulk bar with Share, Download (as zip), Move, Star and Trash. items.title: Document preview is a placeholder
items.detail: Reference: Both apps render PDFs, Office files, text and code inline, with page scroll and search. items.title: Preview lacks Share/Details/Open-with actions
items.detail: Reference: The Google Drive preview top bar has Share, Open with, Download, a details 'i' and a '...' menu (Rename, Move, Make a copy). items.title: Search is name-only with no filters
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive offers chips for Type, People, Modified and Location, searches inside documents (OCR), and suggests recent searches. Dropbox has full-text search and filters. items.title: No Activity/version history
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive has an Activity tab and 'Manage versions'. Dropbox keeps version history and lets you restore. Today: Items carry only a modified date. items.title: Comments on files missing
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive lets people comment on any previewed file and @mention them, and the mention notifies them. Today: There are no comments in DrivePreview.tsx. items.title: Drag-and-drop move between folders and upload progress
items.detail: Reference: On desktop you drag files onto folders or breadcrumbs to move them, and an upload tray shows progress with cancel and retry. Folder upload is supported. items.title: Offline / Available offline on phones
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive has 'Make available offline' and Dropbox has 'Make available offline' plus offline folders.
