items.title: Scan document only takes a raw photo
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive Scan and the Dropbox doc scanner detect edges, crop, enhance and combine several pages into one PDF. Today: 'Take a photo' at DriveView.tsx:69 uploads the raw camera image. Proposal: Change it to 'Scan': capture, then auto-crop, add more pages and save as a PDF, with Save as the one primary action. (effort medium)

items.title: Suggested/Quick access and pinned folders
items.detail: Reference: The Google Drive home shows Suggested files and folders. Dropbox has Starred at the top of Home. Today: Recent is just the last 30 files by date (DriveView.tsx:86-87), and there is no suggested strip. Proposal: At the top of My Drive, add a horizontal strip of suggested and recent files, with starred folders pinned, so the most likely file is one tap away. (effort small)

items.title: Make a copy / duplicate and keyboard shortcuts
items.detail: Reference: Both apps offer 'Make a copy'. Google Drive desktop supports shortcuts: Delete, F2 to rename, Shift+Z, '/' to search and arrow keys. Today: Menus have no copy action (DriveView.tsx:174-182). Only the preview handles arrow keys and Esc (DrivePreview.tsx:~30-36). Proposal: Add 'Make a copy' to the menus. On desktop, add F2, Delete, '/', Enter and arrow-key navigation over the grid. (effort small)

items.title: Shared section is phone-only and lacks a 'shared by' grouping
items.detail: Reference: Google Drive's 'Shared with me' (desktop and phone) groups items by person and lets you filter by sharer. Today: 'shared' is marked phone-only at DriveSidebar.tsx:14, so desktop users can't reach it. Proposal: Show Shared on desktop too, group it by person (tapping the avatar opens the profile card) and add a 'Shared by' filter. (effort small)

items.title: Restore from trash location feedback and an undo toast
items.detail: Reference: Moving a file to the trash shows an 'Undo' snackbar right away, and restoring it shows where it went. Today: onTrash is called directly (DriveView.tsx:142, DrivePreview.tsx:85) with no undo found in these files. Proposal: After Trash, Move or Rename, show a toast with Undo. After a restore, the toast offers 'Show in folder'. (effort small)

items.title: Tapping a person does nothing: no profile card
items.detail: Reference: Google Meet, Otter and Read AI: tap a participant or speaker name to open a card with photo, title, email, local time, and Message/Email/Call buttons. Otter also shows 'meetings with this person'. Today: People chips are plain spans with no onClick (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:715-718). Transcript speaker names are bold text inside a row button that seeks the audio (MeetApp.tsx:875-877), so tapping a name jumps playback. Proposal: Make the person chip and speaker name open a shared PersonCard: a bottom sheet on phones, a popover on desktop. It shows avatar, name, role/title, email, local time and a 'Meetings together' count. The one primary button is Message (opens Chat DM), with Email in the overflow. Outsiders get 'Add to contacts / file under project'. Tapping the row text still seeks. (effort medium) | Built: Speaker names in the transcript and outsider People chips can now be tapped. A teammate's name opens the shared PersonCard (bottom sheet on phones, popover on desktop, with Message, Email and Tasks). An outsider opens a speaker menu. Tapping the rest of the row still seeks the audio. The 'Meetings together' count was not added, because the shared PersonCard has no slot for it.

items.title: No per-speaker talk-time / speaker filter
items.detail: Reference: Read AI and Otter show talk-time % per speaker and let you filter the transcript to one speaker. Today: Only a count of speakers is shown (MeetApp.tsx:711-712). The transcript renders every line with no filter (MeetApp.tsx:874). Proposal: Under the People list, show a bar per speaker with their talk-time %. Tapping a speaker filters the transcript to that person's lines. On phones, put this in the PersonCard ('Spoke 34%, show their lines'). (effort small) | Built: The Transcript tab shows a talk-time bar per speaker, estimated from each line's length and capped by the next line's start time. Tapping a bar filters the transcript to that speaker and shows an 'Only X's lines / Show everyone' row. The speaker menu also has 'Show only their lines (Spoke N%)'.

items.title: Can't rename or fix speaker labels
items.detail: Reference: Otter: tap a speaker label, then 'Rename / tag speaker', with 'apply to all lines'. Read AI does the same. Today: Speaker labels are fixed (MeetApp.tsx:877). Unknown speakers show as 'Unknown' with no way to fix them. Proposal: Long-press (or right-click) a speaker name, choose 'Who is this?', and pick from workspace users or type a name. The change applies to all of that speaker's lines and re-links tasks. (effort medium) | Built: Long-press or right-click a speaker name (or tap an outsider) and choose 'Who is this?'. A Sheet lets you pick a workspace user or type a name. The new name goes on every transcript line, on matching action-item owners and on attendees, and unassigned tasks that speaker promised are linked to the picked user. A toast offers Undo. This only works on meetings that are not live, because the server ke

items.title: No search within one transcript
items.detail: Reference: Otter and Read AI have a search box inside the transcript that highlights matches and jumps between them. Today: Search exists only on the meetings list (MeetApp.tsx:374, MeetPhone.tsx:213). It finds the meeting but doesn't highlight or jump to the line. Proposal: Add a find field in the Transcript tab header with match count and next/previous arrows. When you open a meeting from list search, carry the query along so the first match is highlighted and the audio seeks to it. (effort small) | Built: Find-in-transcript bar with an 'n of total' count, previous/next buttons (Enter and Shift+Enter), clear, and highlighted matches. The current match is outlined, scrolled into view, and the playhead is moved there without playing. A search from the desktop meeting list or the phone Meet home is passed along (MeetPage meeting gets an optional q), so the meeting opens on the Transcript tab with the f

items.title: Action items not linked to the moment they were said
items.detail: Reference: Read AI and Otter link each action item and key point to its timestamp. Tapping one plays that clip. Today: Topics have timestamps (MeetApp.tsx:802). Tasks and key points have none, so the Tasks tab only lists items (MeetApp.tsx:823-850). Proposal: Store an `at` time for tasks, decisions and key points when the notes are generated. Show a small timestamp chip on each one that seeks the player. (effort medium) | Built: Key points, decisions and open questions get a timestamp chip, found by matching their words to transcript lines. Tapping the chip plays from that moment, or for notes-only meetings jumps to the transcript line. Tasks already had saidAt jump chips. This works on existing meetings without any AI or server change.

items.title: No live view, captions or 'catch me up' while the meeting runs
items.detail: Reference: Otter Live Notes and Read AI let you follow the transcript live on a phone, and give a 'catch me up' summary if you join late. Today: While live, the Summary tab only says notes come after the meeting (MeetApp.tsx:811). The live transcript auto-scrolls but has no summary. Proposal: When status is recording, open on a Live tab that shows the rolling transcript plus a single 'Catch me up' button that summarizes the last N minutes. (effort medium)

items.title: No highlights/bookmarks or clip sharing
items.detail: Reference: Otter: highlight a passage, comment on it, and share a clip. Read AI: share the clip of a key moment. Today: Transcript lines can only seek (MeetApp.tsx:875). Share covers the whole meeting only (MeetApp.tsx:490). Proposal: Long-press a line and choose Highlight, Comment or 'Share this moment' (a link with ?t=). Show highlights as markers on the progress bar (MeetApp.tsx:664). (effort medium)

items.title: No comments or @mentions on notes
items.detail: Reference: Otter and Read AI support comments on transcript lines and @mentions that notify teammates. Today: Meetings have no comment model. The only places to act are tasks and Ask AI (MeetApp.tsx:733). Proposal: Add comments to a line or summary section. An @mention sends a Chat notification that deep-links to the timestamp. (effort medium)

items.title: No recap email or post to Chat after the meeting
items.detail: Reference: Read AI and Otter email a recap to attendees automatically, or post it to Slack, when the meeting ends. Today: Recap is copy-to-clipboard (MeetApp.tsx:464) or a read-only share link (MeetApp.tsx:490). Proposal: When a meeting ends, show one primary button, 'Send recap'. It opens a prefilled Mail draft or Chat post to the attendees, with a setting to do it automatically. (effort small) | Built: A 'Send recap' primary button appears on finished meetings that have notes (header on desktop, full-width under the facts on phones). It opens a Sheet with the recap as editable text: summary, decisions, action items with owners and due dates, open questions. From there you can either email the attendees (opens a prefilled Mail compose to the teammate attendees through App's openCompose) or post i

items.title: No playback speed or skip controls
items.detail: Reference: Otter and Read AI offer 1x/1.5x/2x speed, 15-second skip, and skipping silence. Today: The player has only play/pause and click-to-seek (MeetApp.tsx:661-664). Proposal: Add a speed toggle and ±15s buttons beside Play. On phones, make the scrub bar bigger and draggable for touch. (effort small)

items.title: No pre-meeting brief
items.detail: Reference: Read AI's prep notes and Google Meet's calendar card show the agenda, last meeting's open tasks and attendees before you join. Today: An upcoming row opens a sheet with join toggles and 'open event' (MeetPhone.tsx:146-171). It doesn't include past context. Proposal: In that sheet, show open tasks and open questions from the last meeting with the same people or project. The primary button is Join. (effort medium)

items.title: Join link missing as the primary action on upcoming meetings
items.detail: Reference: Google Meet on phone: the upcoming card has a big Join button. Today: The upcoming sheet's main action is the notetaker override plus 'open event' (MeetPhone.tsx:159-171). Proposal: When the event has a meeting link (meetingLinkOf), make Join the primary button. Move the notetaker toggle to a secondary row. (effort small)

items.title: Attendees list ignores who actually spoke
items.detail: Reference: Google Meet attendance reports and Read AI's participant list show who joined, for how long, and who didn't show. Today: The list falls back to either invitees or speakers, not both (MeetApp.tsx:621, 715). Proposal: Merge the two lists and mark each person: attended/spoke, invited but absent, or not invited. Each person is tappable to open the PersonCard. (effort small)

items.title: Desktop meeting header has too many equal buttons
items.detail: Reference: Google Meet and Otter use one clear primary action, with the rest in a menu. Today: The desktop header shows Stop, Regenerate, Share, Delete and More side by side (MeetApp.tsx:538-556). Proposal: Make Share primary (or Stop while live) and move Regenerate and Delete into the ⋮ menu, as the phone layout already does (MeetApp.tsx:490-493). (effort small)

items.title: Tap a person in 'Who sees it' / Activity to see who they are
items.detail: Reference: 1Password shows each person with an avatar in 'Shared with'; tapping opens their profile (name, email, role, vaults) with actions. Bitwarden's member rows open member details. Today: Who sees it is a single summary string from accessLabel (VaultApp.tsx:850), and tapping it opens the editor rather than a list of people. Activity lines are plain sentences (VaultApp.tsx:49-64, 623) with no tappable names. Proposal: Turn 'Who sees it' into an avatar stack. Tapping it opens a sheet listing each person and team, and tapping a person opens the shared profile card (name, title, email, local time) with Message as the primary action. Names in Activity lines open the same card. (effort medium) | Built: 'Who sees it' is now a stack of avatars (up to 3 plus +N) on desktop rows and in the phone login screen. Tapping it opens a Popover (a sheet on phones) that lists the teams and every person with access. Tapping a person closes it and opens the shared PersonCard, with Message as its primary action. 'Change who sees it' appears for anyone who can edit. Names in Activity (phone screen and desktop mod

items.title: Only one item type: logins
items.detail: Reference: Both apps have item types for Login, Secure Note, Card, Identity, SSH key, API credential, Wi-Fi, Bank account and Document. Today: VaultItem has only title, url, username, password, totp and notes (VaultApp.tsx:28-38). The editor is 'New login' only (VaultApp.tsx:1045). Proposal: Make '+' open a type picker (Login, Secure note, API key, Card, Wi-Fi), each with its own fields. Agencies mostly need API keys and secure notes. (effort large)

items.title: No browser autofill or save prompt
items.detail: Reference: Both apps fill credentials through a browser extension and the OS autofill on iOS and Android, and offer to save a new login after sign-up. Today: Every use is copy and paste: copyPassword and copyUsername (VaultApp.tsx:269-330), with the clipboard cleared after 30 seconds (VaultApp.tsx:72). Proposal: In the short term, add an 'Open and copy' action that copies the password and opens the site in one tap. Longer term, build an extension or PWA credential provider. (effort large)

items.title: Password generator has no options
items.detail: Reference: Both generators offer a length slider, character-set toggles, memorable passphrases and a PIN mode, plus a standalone generator tab and generator history. Today: strongPassword() always makes 20 characters from a fixed set (VaultApp.tsx:876-881). The only control is a 'Generate' button (VaultApp.tsx:993). Proposal: Turn Generate into a sheet with a length slider, a Words/Characters toggle and a symbols switch, with 'Use password' as its one primary button. It remembers the last settings. (effort small) | Built: The generator now has a Characters/Words segmented control. Words makes memorable passphrases of 3 to 8 words, with one capital, an optional number, and dashes or spaces. It also has a length slider, Numbers and Symbols/Dashes switches, and a 'Make another' button. The last settings are remembered in localStorage ('vault-gen'). It still opens as the existing inline fold in the editor, not a separa

items.title: No password health or Watchtower
items.detail: Reference: 1Password Watchtower and Bitwarden Vault Health flag weak, reused and breached (HIBP) passwords, missing 2FA and unsecured http sites. Today: Nothing scores passwords. The sidebar has only filters and an info note (VaultApp.tsx:82-110). Proposal: Add a 'Needs attention' filter with a count badge, computed on the client after unlock: weak, reused, sites that support 2FA but have none, and HIBP k-anonymity breach checks. Each row's primary action is 'Change password'. (effort medium) | Built: There is a new 'Needs attention' filter in the sidebar and in the phone title menu. Its count badge appears after a check. The check runs on the client after unlock, on end-to-end encrypted logins, and flags weak passwords, reused passwords, HIBP breaches (k-anonymity range API, padded; only a 5-character hash prefix leaves the browser), known 2FA-capable sites without a 2FA key, and http:// sites

items.title: No favorites and no 'suggested for this site'
items.detail: Reference: Both apps have Favorites at the top of the list, and they suggest logins that match the current site or app. Today: The list is flat with search and client filters only (VaultApp.tsx:87-105, 340-345). Proposal: Add a star in the detail view and a Favorites section pinned above the list on phones. Sort the rest by most recently used. (effort small)

items.title: No password history
items.detail: Reference: Both apps keep earlier passwords for each item ('Password history' in Bitwarden, 'Previous passwords' in 1Password) so you can recover after a bad change. Today: Saving overwrites the encrypted password (VaultApp.tsx:946-960). Activity logs the action but not the old value. Proposal: Keep the last 5 encrypted passwords in a 'Previous passwords' row in the detail view, where each one can be revealed and copied. (effort medium)

items.title: No custom fields or multiple URLs
items.detail: Reference: Both apps let you add custom text, hidden and URL fields, several websites per login and match rules. Today: There is a single url and a single username field (VaultApp.tsx:31). Extras end up in notes, which are logged and hidden (VaultApp.tsx:610). Proposal: Add an 'Add field' row at the bottom of the editor (Text / Hidden / URL). Show custom fields as copy rows in the detail view. (effort medium)

items.title: No biometric or PIN quick unlock
items.detail: Reference: 1Password and Bitwarden unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or Windows Hello, or a PIN, after the master password has been entered once. Today: The gate always asks for the full passphrase (VaultApp.tsx:1091-1152). It auto-locks after 15 minutes (VaultApp.tsx:173) and again on every app restart. Proposal: After the first unlock, offer 'Unlock with Face ID / Windows Hello' using WebAuthn PRF to wrap the key. Keep the passphrase as a fallback. (effort medium) | Built: Quick unlock with Face ID, fingerprint or Windows Hello uses WebAuthn PRF (src/vaultCrypto.ts: enableQuickUnlock, quickUnlock, quickUnlockOn, quickUnlockOff, quickUnlockAvailable). The private key is wrapped with an HKDF/AES-GCM key derived from the platform passkey's PRF output and stored only in this browser. It is tied to the current key pair. After the passphrase unlocks the Vault, a dismissib

items.title: Auto-lock timeout is fixed
items.detail: Reference: Both apps let you choose the lock timeout (immediately, 1 minute, 15 minutes, 1 hour, on restart, never) and whether to lock on sleep. Today: The timeout is hard-coded to 15 minutes (VaultApp.tsx:173). Proposal: Add a Vault section in Settings with a timeout picker and a 'Lock when the device sleeps' switch. (effort small)

items.title: Clipboard clear is fixed and unreliable
items.detail: Reference: In Bitwarden, the clear-clipboard time is configurable. 1Password clears even when the app loses focus and marks copies as sensitive so they don't sync to clipboard history. Today: The clipboard clears after a fixed 30 seconds, only if the tab still has focus (VaultApp.tsx:71-75). Username copy is not tracked the same way (VaultApp.tsx:319). Proposal: Make the clear time configurable. Show a countdown in the toast with a 'Clear now' action. (effort small)

items.title: No import from other managers
items.detail: Reference: Both apps import CSV and JSON from Chrome, LastPass, 1Password and Bitwarden, among others. Today: Logins can only be added one at a time through the editor (VaultApp.tsx:436, 883). Proposal: Add 'Import' to the empty state and overflow menu: pick a file, preview the rows, assign a client and access, then a single 'Import N logins' button. (effort medium) | Built: Import is available from the desktop header button, the empty states (phone and desktop) and an 'Import logins' row at the end of the phone list. You pick a CSV or JSON file: Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox, LastPass, 1Password and Bitwarden CSVs plus Bitwarden JSON are parsed by header names, including quoted commas and line breaks. Then you preview the rows with checkboxes, assign a project, and c

items.title: No export or backup
items.detail: Reference: Both apps export to encrypted JSON or CSV. 1Password also has an Emergency Kit. Today: There is no export, and a lost passphrase cannot be recovered (VaultApp.tsx:1088-1089, 1126). Proposal: Add 'Export my logins' (an encrypted file) and a printable Recovery Kit right after the passphrase is set. (effort medium)

items.title: Desktop detail is a menu, not a pane
items.detail: Reference: 1Password and Bitwarden desktop use a list on the left and the full item in the right pane, with an inline TOTP countdown ring. Today: On desktop, a row opens a dropdown menu (VaultApp.tsx:503-560) and reading notes uses a modal (VaultApp.tsx:603). The full detail view exists only on phones (VaultApp.tsx:744). Proposal: Reuse the phone detail view as the right pane on desktop, with Copy password as its primary action and a countdown ring on the 2FA code. (effort medium)

items.title: No one-off secure share link
items.detail: Reference: Bitwarden Send and 1Password 'Share item' create an expiring link for someone outside the team, for example a client. Today: Sharing is only through workspace access lists (VaultApp.tsx:1010-1030) and re-sharing (VaultApp.tsx:231-255). Proposal: Add a 'Share link' action in the detail view: choose an expiry (1 hour, 1 day, 7 days) and whether it can be viewed only once, then copy the link. The key goes in the URL fragment. (effort medium)

items.title: Tapping an avatar or name opens a profile card
items.detail: Reference: Slack: tap an avatar or name in any message to open a profile sheet (phone) or popover (desktop) with photo, name, title, status, local time, email, and Message / Huddle buttons. Google and Microsoft 365 hover cards work the same way. Today: The Avatar is a plain span with aria-hidden and no click handler (src/components/Avatar.tsx:13-19). In chat it sits inside the message row, whose onClick opens the thread (src/components/chat/Message.tsx:240,249), so tapping a face jumps into the thread. Proposal: Add one shared PersonCard: a bottom sheet on phones and an anchored popover on desktop. Make Avatar and the sender name in chat, mail, tasks, activity, calendar guests and teams tappable, and call stopPropagation so the thread doesn't open. Show photo, name, title, status and local time. The primary action is Message, with Email and Call as secondary actions. (effort medium)

items.title: Tapping an @mention opens that person
items.detail: Reference: In Slack, Teams and Google Chat, tapping an @name opens the same profile card. Today: Mentions render as an inert <b className="mention"> (src/components/chat/Message.tsx:43). Proposal: Make mentions buttons that open PersonCard. (effort small)

items.title: Local time uses the person's own time zone
items.detail: Reference: Slack shows each person's local time, for example "4:12 PM local time (3 hrs ahead)". Teams and Outlook show the same. Today: The DM profile shows 'Local time', but it's calculated from the company time zone (src/components/chat/Details.tsx:293). User has no timeZone field (src/types.ts:530-543). Proposal: Add User.timeZone, filled in automatically from the browser. Show their time and how far ahead or behind you they are on PersonCard, and warn before messaging outside their working hours. (effort small) | Built: Added User.timeZone (src/types.ts). App.tsx now fills it in from the browser once per user, and the server's ownProfile accepts it after validating the IANA name (server/index.ts profileExtras). PersonCard shows their local time with the gap to yours, for example '5.46 (11 hrs behind)', and a soft note when it's outside 8:00 to 19:00 for them: 'It's {time} for {name}. They may reply later.' The DM

items.title: Profiles carry more than name, title and email
items.detail: Reference: Slack profiles have custom fields: phone, pronouns, department, location, manager. Microsoft cards add an org chart and contact details. Today: User only stores name, email, title, color and photo (src/types.ts:530-536). The profile editor is in ClientApp (src/components/ClientApp.tsx:1422). Proposal: Add optional fields: phone, pronouns, location, department and manager (reportsTo). Show only the ones that are filled in, and let people edit them in Your profile. (effort medium) | Built: Added optional User fields phone, pronouns, location, department and reportsTo (types and the server's profileExtras whitelist, which keeps a field when it isn't sent, so it stays backward compatible). Editing lives in the new src/components/ProfileDetails.tsx. On desktop these are plain fields that save when you leave them, plus a PersonSelect for 'Reports to'. On phones they are an 'About you' g

items.title: Message from any profile
items.detail: Reference: Every Slack, Teams and Google card has Message as its primary button, which opens or creates the DM. Today: Team member actions offer only Email, Make lead and Remove (src/components/teams/TeamsApp.tsx:316-321). There is no way to open a chat DM from there. Proposal: Make Message the primary action on PersonCard and the team member sheet. It opens the existing DM or creates one. (effort small)

items.title: Call / huddle from a profile
items.detail: Reference: Slack cards have Huddle, Teams cards have Call / Video, and Google cards have a Meet button. Today: Huddle and Meet exist (src/components/Huddle.tsx, src/components/MeetApp.tsx) but can't be reached from a person. Proposal: Add Call as a secondary action that starts a 1:1 huddle. On phones, if a phone number is set, also offer a tel: link. (effort small)

items.title: Presence and status on every avatar
items.detail: Reference: Slack and Teams show a green, away or busy dot and the status emoji wherever an avatar appears. Today: The status shows only in the DM About pane (src/components/chat/Details.tsx:289). Avatar has no presence badge (src/components/Avatar.tsx:13). Proposal: Add an optional presence dot to Avatar, fed by presence.ts, for sizes 32 and up. Show the status emoji and text plus 'until 5 PM' on PersonCard. (effort small)

items.title: "View profile" goes to a real profile
items.detail: Reference: Slack's View full profile opens a dedicated profile page. Today: The DM start's 'View profile' button only opens the details menu pane (src/components/chat/Conversation.tsx:575-580). Proposal: Point it, and Details, at the shared full profile: PersonCard expanded to full screen on phones. (effort small)

items.title: One person page that links their work across apps
items.detail: Reference: Microsoft profile cards list recent files, shared emails and meetings with you. Google contact cards show recent interactions. Today: Details computes a last-mail date only for client contacts (src/components/chat/Details.tsx:270-276). There's no per-person view across tasks, files and events. Proposal: Add tabs or sections to the full profile: Shared tasks, Upcoming meetings together, Recent files, Recent mail. Each is a short list with 'See all'. (effort medium)

items.title: Mail sender avatar opens the contact
items.detail: Reference: In Gmail and Outlook, hovering or tapping the sender shows a contact card with Add to contacts, Email, Chat and Schedule. Today: MessageList renders the sender Avatar without an action (src/components/MessageList.tsx:635,713), and the Contacts editor is separate (src/components/mail/Contacts.tsx:317,443). Proposal: Make the sender name and avatar in Reader open PersonCard. For an external person, it shows the contact or offers Add to contacts as the primary action. (effort small)

items.title: Stacked avatars open a people list
items.detail: Reference: In Slack, tapping the reply avatars or reaction faces shows who it was. In Google Docs, tapping stacked avatars lists the people. Today: Thread reply avatars and poll voter avatars are decorative (src/components/chat/Message.tsx:318,372). Proposal: Tapping a stack opens a small sheet listing those people. Each row opens PersonCard. (effort small)

items.title: Search people directly
items.detail: Reference: Slack has a People directory and lets you search people in the quick switcher, with results opening the profile. Today: The Teams directory search lists members, but tapping a row opens an action menu instead of a profile (src/components/teams/TeamsApp.tsx:305,341). Proposal: Show people in global search or the quick switcher. Selecting one opens PersonCard, and the team row tap opens the same card with team actions below. (effort medium)

items.title: Multiple domains per company (Google Workspace model): Settings > Domains with primary + secondary, aliases per person, From picker; brands optional on top
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct: brand was only an example; companies have several domains. Today ws.domains is a list but no UI adds a second one and 21 places read domains[0].

items.title: Search bar in Settings (and in every app) that jumps straight to a page or setting
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct: just a thought, search in everything to go directly to certain pages. Today: global palette (Cmd+K / magnifier) finds apps, people, items but not settings; Settings has no search field.

items.title: MCP connector exists (23 tools): add Drive, Meet, Projects, Teams, people tools; edit/cancel events; a visible Connect to Claude/ChatGPT page
items.detail: From the user, 15 Oct. Exists: server/connector.ts, server/mcpTools.ts (OAuth, per-person permissions, admin switch). Missing: Drive, Meet, Projects, Teams, people tools; update/cancel event; discoverable setup page.

items.title: Domains follow-up: delivery, readiness and daily routing check for non-primary domains; real send/receive test per domain
items.detail: From the domains build, 15 Oct.

items.title: New message sheet rows run off the right edge (New channel subtitle and pick circles clipped)
items.detail: Give .nm-list grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) and min-width:0 on .nm-row so .nm-sub ellipsizes. (src/mobile/chat.css:656-659; src/components/ChatApp.tsx:1300 (.nm-sub nowrap)) Evidence: phone375__010: the subtitle is cut at x=375 and the radio circles are half off screen. .nm-list is display:grid with no column template.

items.title: 'To:' in the New message sheet sits 4px from the edge, not on the 16px gutter
